entries.line: A black-haired Aspirant, Guinevere's partner in a legendary undefeated pair.
entries.short: A black-haired girl who fights from above with a staff. Her magic hits whatever reaches for Guinevere's back. Together they have never lost.
entries.summary: A black-haired Aspirant who fights from above with an orb staff, Guinevere's partner in an undefeated pair. Her father, a Shield soldier, died standing between her and an Ender; she blamed herself and kept everyone away, until Guinevere would not take no. Dragged into the void in Guinevere's place, she says the Will of the Planet showed her the end; she took its orders as cover, wore Ender armor, built the Eternal Guards and meant to die striking the Mother Matrix's open chest. Guinevere would not give her up: they struck it together, came back out of the black hole, and Vexana fought on the frontline beside her with her three giants.

entries.name: Vexana's father

facts.t: The small screwdriver Vexana uses had been his.
He was a soldier of the Shield of Dawnbreak who kept the big guns on the city wall working.
He came home at dusk, set his boots by the door toes to the wall, and folded his uniform over the chair with square corners.
He stewed his tea until it was black and called it soldier's tea, saying that is how you know it is working.
He hummed the same old march while he worked and always stopped in the same place.
He said he would finish the march when the war did.
He taught Vexana that a bent bracket makes a gun miss, and showed her how to press one straight with two fingers.
On her birthdays he took her up the wall stair to see the stars, and carried her when her legs gave out.
He gave her a small star of her own that comes out first, before it is even dark.
In drills he told her "Stay back" and went to his gun; when the all-clear sounded he found her and said "Good."
In the real attack he came down the stair and stood between Vexana and an Ender, one hand out flat at his side, and told her to stay back.
He stayed facing the Ender while a soldier carried Vexana away, and the smoke closed over him.
A soldier from the wall told Vexana the Ender never got past him while he stood.
The home's record lists him as killed in action.
He kept spare brass collars in his toolbox for the gun sights on the city wall.
Vexana says he liked the stars.
His toolbox, which Vexana keeps by her desk, still smells of gun oil.
On the day of the shelter by the wall he told Vexana to stay back.
When an Ender found her, he turned back from his gun and planted himself between them.
"Stay back" was the last thing he ever said to her.
He stayed as a soldier carried Vexana away down the street.
He pressed bent brackets straight; Vexana smooths her folded clothes the same slow way.
In the gun pit on the city wall he held out his hand for tools without looking, and Vexana put the right one in it.
He and Vexana lived in the Shield houses in the shadow of the city wall.
On her birthdays he took her up the wall stair, named the bright stars after guns, and gave her one small low star.
A soldier said the Ender never got past him while he stood.
He stood until he fell.
He stood on the wall before dawn, oiling the guns so the street behind him could sleep.
Vexana tells Obsidia he fought the Enders.
When her legs gave out halfway up the wall stair, he carried her the rest of the way.
His toolbox, set beside her cot in the Shield's home, was all of him that came back to her.
He led Vexana up the wall stair at home, and at the top he always pointed out over the dead ground and told her to look.
He gave her a small star in the sky over the dead ground.
His screwdriver lies wiped clean in its place in the toolbox in Vexana's room.
He tried each sight on the wall with his fingers.
He hummed a march in the gun pit and always stopped in the same place.
He said of the march, "I'll finish it when the war does."
He once stood in a street by the wall with one Ender in front of him and his daughter behind him.
A soldier told Vexana beside her cot that the Ender never got past him, not while he stood.
Vexana says he was a soldier until his last breath and died saving her.

Guinevere thinks his words, 'Stay back', are the ones Vexana shouted at her in the corridor.

entries.summary: Vexana's father was a Shield soldier who kept the big guns on the city wall working and raised her in the Shield houses under it. He stewed soldier's tea, hummed a march he said he would finish when the war did, taught her to press a bent bracket straight with two fingers and gave her a small star of her own on her birthdays. When an Ender came over the wall, he stood between it and her and told her "Stay back," the last thing he ever said to her. A soldier said it never got past him while he stood; the record lists him killed in action, and his toolbox is all of him that came back.

entries.name: Will of the Planet

facts.t: Ruby's lesson says some worlds grow a will of their own as they age, even far ones like Dawnbreak.
The lesson says Oro's will is Balance too.
Oro's technicians say the will of the planet might not like Angela getting in the way.
Ruby tells Angela she does not know what they mean by it and not to say it out loud.
Chang'e says the Academy thinks it is a mind, and that it is behind the Enders.
Chang'e says it may be the planet's own mind.
Chang'e cites a rule from the oldest records: a planet that holds Balance sends the Enders when a people grows strong enough to endanger others.
Chang'e says she cannot say that rule is what happened here, and calls it theory.
Chang'e says the readings suggest it has a body too, which they call the Mother Matrix.
Chang'e says to defeat it they must destroy the Enders' Control Core, hidden in its dark void.
Guinevere calls it some Will in the dark that sends claws and thinks it gets to decide what happens next.
Chang'e taught that to defeat it, the Enders' Control Core hidden in its dark void must be destroyed.
It breaks into Vexana's memory through a tear in the sky: a hand as big as the tree, then an arm and a head.
It is armored in dark violet and crowned with tall spikes and horns, with two violet eyes and a thin streak of light running sideways from one of them.
Its shadow drains the color out of the memory; everything under it goes violet, then black.
Chang'e called it the mind behind the Enders. Nobody had ever seen it.
It has no mouth; its word "Look" comes out of the dark itself.
In the vision, it tells Vexana she has reached the end of her future, that she shall witness life's destruction, and that this is no judgment but the universe's predetermined execution.
Asked if this is the only way to protect Guinevere, it gives no answer and draws back into the dark like a tide.
Vexana reasons that it sends every Ender, knows where they will strike, and has no need to lie to her.
When a door home opens, Vexana thinks it is letting her choose.
Its voice speaks to Vexana inside the cold point in her chest.
Its orders give a place and a time, never a reason.
It sends Vexana only to empty places outside the dome and keeps her from people; she does not know why.
It gives Vexana orders through the cold point: "The body. Now."
Every door in the dark is the Will's.
Obsidia says the Will of the Planet is the mind and the Mother Matrix is its body.
Obsidia says each Ender's core is where the Will's thread ends. Enders hear only the Will.
Obsidia says the Will sees through every Ender's eyes.
Obsidia says the planet's will looked at its humans, found them too prosperous and sent for the Enders.
Obsidia says it does not hate humans: flesh does not hate a splinter, it pushes it out.
Obsidia says it is one being that serves every world that holds Balance. On each one it is that world's will, made able to move.
Obsidia thinks it was born of a Twilight Orb bursting open, but says she cannot ask it.
Obsidia says that when Enders die in numbers, the Will goes dark for a while, then stirs again and sends more.
It orders Vexana to the gate: "The gate. Now."
Obsidia says the Will opens the doors into the void.
Obsidia says the Will feels each Ender's thread snap, and too many at once make a wound more than it can carry.
Vexana thinks the Will was hurt when Chang'e's lines all stopped at once.
Chang'e tells her class: "We think it is a mind. The Will of the Planet."
Obsidia thinks it knew what Vexana was from the first hour.
Obsidia reads in the pulse that when the body began its door, the Will's first move was to take one of the two girls who fought as one, so the other would break.
Doors cost it dearly inside the humans' dome.
In the vision it told Vexana, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future."
It went through Vexana's memories the way it looks out through an Ender's eyes.
It let Vexana keep her mind and her star, because, Obsidia thinks, a light is easy to watch.
It sent Vexana only to empty places at hours when nobody looked. Obsidia thinks it was saving her face.
It saw the plate and cracked cores Vexana carried home, and let them pass, because to it the end was settled.
Obsidia reads that it planned to show Vexana's face by day among its Enders, so the humans would stop believing.
It planned to send Vexana where Guinevere would follow, then give her one order with Guinevere in front of her.
Its orders open a door in the dark for Vexana. On the eve of the attack it wanted only her eyes.
Its orders come to Vexana as a voice inside her: a place and a time, never a why.
Teacher Chang'e taught that the Will of the Planet sends the Enders and that the readings suggest it has a body.
A voice from everywhere says, "The gateway is near completion. Soon, you Aspirants will meet your end."
The voice orders, "Vexana. Execute purge protocol."
Its mark let go of Vexana the way a hand lets go of a tool it has finished with.
Vexana realizes it had seen the rooftop, the tree and Guinevere in her memories, and knew about her star.
Vexana concludes it never needed her loyal, only used.
Its doors opened through the cold point in Vexana, always where it sent her.
Vexana says it showed her a 'future' that Guinevere must never know.
Guinevere says there is nothing to fear in it and she would snatch Vexana right back.
Obsidia calls the Mother Matrix the Will's body.

entries.line: The will some worlds grow of their own as they age.
entries.short: Ruby's lesson says some worlds grow a will of their own as they age, even far ones like Dawnbreak. Oro's will, it says, is Balance.
entries.summary: Chang'e says the Academy thinks it is a mind, the planet's own, behind the Enders, and that the readings suggest it has a body, the Mother Matrix. Obsidia says it is one being that serves every world that holds Balance, sees through every Ender's eyes, and sent for them because it found its humans too prosperous. It marks Vexana, shows her a vision of the end in which it appears as a giant in dark violet armor, and gives her orders through a cold point in her chest: a place and a time, never a reason. In the end Vexana sees it never needed her loyal, only used.

entries.line: Machines built like people.
entries.short: Machines built like people. On Oro they stand in rows: hundreds of the same girl.
entries.summary: Androids are machines built like people, and Angela is one. Oro's Cosmic Reapers, the androids of Project Angel, are hundreds of the same girl. On the avenue, androids with Angela's face lay around her in the smoke; they had come to fire on the city, and so had she.

facts.t: Black Enders with long thin limbs come down out of the orange sky onto the dome and in through the broken panels.
Fanny fights them in the air while Layla shoots whatever turns toward Fanny's back.
Fanny's blade sweeps through the last of them high in the sky.

entries.line: Black Enders with long thin limbs.
entries.short: Black Enders with long thin limbs. They come down out of the orange sky onto the dome and in through its broken panels.
entries.summary: A kind of Ender, black, with long thin limbs. In the Northeastern sector they come down out of the orange sky onto the dome and in through the broken panels. Fanny goes up to fight them in the air while Layla shoots whatever turns toward her back, and Fanny's long blade sweeps through the last of them high in the sky.

entries.name: Cosmic Reapers

facts.t: The androids of Project Angel stand in rows in a long hall of tall white windows below the Laboratory.
They are hundreds of the same girl, with animal ears. When woken, their eyes glow magenta.
The soldiers call them Cosmic Reapers. They do what they are told and nothing else.
Every one of them wakes with magenta eyes.
Seven of them, all the same girl with magenta eyes, train beside Angela on the Training Field.
One does not turn its head when Angela says good morning.
They strike when told and take their blows.
In the hangar the android company waits in columns: girls with magenta eyes.
They stand in silent rows in the dark hold of Oro's black ship, then hover above the city.
They walk out of the ship's hatch onto a burning street in Terrinia, their eyes magenta.
They strike at the students in S·L·K jackets.
In the hold their eyes were shut, then every eye opened at once, magenta, when light poured in.
Pink light crackles in their open palms.
They carry pink blades at their wrists.
Ruby cuts down every one of them.
They all have Angela's face.
Ruby calls them the start of Oro's plan to take over Dawnbreak.
Lesley fears Oro may send more of them.

entries.short: Oro's android soldiers from Project Angel: hundreds of the same girl, with animal ears and magenta eyes. They do only what they are told.
entries.summary: The Cosmic Reapers are the androids of Project Angel, hundreds of the same girl with animal ears, standing in rows below Oro's Laboratory. Woken, their eyes glow magenta; they strike when told, take their blows and do nothing else. Oro's black ship carries them to burning Terrinia, where they strike at Selrick's students with pink blades at their wrists until Ruby cuts down every one. They all have Angela's face, and Ruby calls them the start of Oro's plan to take over Dawnbreak.

entries.name: Enders

facts.t: Obsidia's Enders are living machines, tall and gray, made to destroy. They do not think.
Something vast and cold made them to kill on instinct.
They sleep in the nest until needed.
After the Catastrophe of 978 they were everywhere.
They are huge living machines that came from the sky with one purpose: to wipe out humanity. They nearly did.
Terrinia's dome, the Defensive Bubble, keeps them out.
People learned to rebuild dead Enders into armored mecha suits.
Joe teaches that they expose their weak spots only when they launch attacks, and they do not strike easily.
Joe teaches that plain Enders are the lowest of three ranks and kill the most, because there are the most.
Joe teaches that when hurt badly they go quiet for weeks, a lull, and a lull always ends.
A real Ender at the breach is far bigger than the three-meter VR Enders, and its gray plates grind together.
Layla says that before the breach she felt Enders were nothing more than target practice.
After the breach the Enders no longer come in waves, only in handfuls.
Ruby's lesson says that long ago Oro fought a terrible war with the Enders, and they never came back.
Dawnbreak is at war with the Enders again.
Ruby's father says Dawnbreak's people make weapons from the Enders' dead.
Selrick's Combat Division trains students to fight them.
Instructors on the field roster fight them outside the dome.
In Lesley's dream their roar never stops for breath.
A radio report says they were seen again past the edge of the map: giants that come in groups and break cities.
The one that broke Lesley's house was a tall gray shape whose head was higher than the roof.
A Shield soldier says they come in groups from out beyond the road leaving the city.
At the station three came out of the grass, taller than the wall, and rounds sparked off their shells.
When one strikes, its chest comes apart in plates and shows a burning core.
One crossed the station wall in a single stride, and the earth shook.
The research base studied gray plates from dead Enders to learn how they worked, without result so far.
Lesley's file says her family died in an Ender attack.
Three Enders walk into the old rail yard among the rusted wagons.
A round in the middle of the core kills an Ender and burns the core black.
When an Ender swings its arm, its chest splits open and its core blazes.
The lab handles anything taken off an Ender only with tongs or gloves.
The Shield thinks they can hear its signals.
Their chests split open when they strike, and that is when a round can go in.
On the night the base fell their swarms lean on Lesley's district and hold the Shield at the edge.
After the base fell their raids thin, then stop for a long time.
Years later they come back at night.
They are tall and gray.
They fill the avenue from wall to wall.
Two more big ones come over the roofs before dawn and are brought down.
At the fish market they drop through a tear in the dome.
A claw catches at Guinevere's boot over the lip of the tear.
Guinevere's father lost his wife to them.
The Shield of Dawnbreak is the defense force that fights them.
Before the attack, an Ender was only a word in drills to young Vexana.
One that came over the city wall was tall and gray, with claws.
In the cadets' third week, Enders were loose in a far ward of the city.
A real Ender's chest plates open when it swings, which the steel dummies copy.
In the raid at the dome's foot they climbed into the city through a split low in the dome.
When one swings, its chest opens, and a punch to the core inside stops it.
Chang'e cites the oldest records: a planet that holds Balance sends the Enders against a people grown strong enough to endanger others.
Chang'e says the Enders are what the Will of the Planet sends.
Outside the dome they come out of portals.
Academy screens read a signal off every Ender near the dome, and in a lull every signal stops at the same moment.
Selena builds a mecha suit design out of Ender plating.
Since the newcomers came, their raids have grown fiercer and come nearer the Academy's own waterfront.
An Ender's chest plates split open for a strike.
The ones in the corridor are tall, on long legs, with claws as long as an arm.
One drags a dead Ender's arm toward a broken window.
They come from the void, the dark behind the world.
When badly hurt they go quiet for a while; every win the Academy had this year ended in such a lull.
Tall gray Enders with a violet glow along their plates fall in at Vexana's sides without touching her or making a sound.
Vexana tells them they follow the Will's mark in her, not her.
They cross the void in long silent lines, leaning toward where they mean to go.
Far off in the void they lie in rows, still as stones.
Each feels the pulse at once in every cell, and it tells them where to go and what to do.
They know nothing at all and never know when Obsidia looks out through their eyes.
Thousands of them stand still and gray in the Citadel's holds.
When one died on that world, a light burned in its breaking core; in all Obsidia's ages none had died like that before.
The Enders at Vexana's side never turn their heads.
Obsidia says the other Enders perished in ever-ending war, and the body made more.
Obsidia says they hunger and hear the pulse, nothing else. Each one is a limb of the body, sent far from it.
Obsidia says each has a shell of metal outside, the body's own living cells under it, and a core in the chest.
Obsidia says what they see runs back up the line to the Will.
Gray Enders stand along the Citadel's edge facing the storm, and let Vexana by.
Obsidia says some wait in the rows for ages. The dark slows them and they need nothing.
New ones are made in the nest: metal drifts to a swelling shape on a tissue rope, glows red where it touches and closes over it into a shell.
Obsidia says that when one is killed, its core breaks and the Will's thread in it snaps.
Obsidia says she has watched Enders with nothing left to kill turn on each other until the body unmade them.
The one that finds young Selena is tall and gray, taller than doorways, with violet light in the seams of its shell.
A Shield notice says Enders are living machines with a gray metal shell over living purple tissue, and that they do not attack each other.
Before a raid Selena feels the Enders' hum gather in her bones a day early.
Black Enders came out of an orange sky into the Northeastern breach.
Obsidia sees through the eyes of a gray Ender standing on her prow.
Obsidia says the Enders cannot learn, while the humans kill them faster year by year.
Enders die of the humans' light.
Tall and gray, they leap through purple portals over the waterfront and drop onto the warehouse roofs.
On the map every one turns inland for the Academy's wards.
They move with Vexana as if she led them, by the Will's mark.
Not one of them turns its head when Vexana's star beeps.
They run beside Vexana and none of them touches her.
After the Guard takes the Matrix's shot, every Ender on the platforms turns its head toward the west.
They keep their distance from Vexana, never within a claw's reach, until the mark lets go and they close in to kill.
Their chests open when they strike, and a shot into the open chest kills them.
One's chest splits as it strikes, and Guinevere puts her fist through the core.
They peel off the Matrix's wings by the dozen and drop at Guinevere and Vexana.
Destroying the Enders was once Vexana's only reason to go on.
Obsidia sees through the eyes of the gray Enders on her outer blocks.
The Enders on the platforms showed Obsidia everything and understood none of it.
Obsidia saw every Ender on the platforms turn on Vexana.
Every Ender carries a small piece of the Citadel's hum.
They drop by the hundred from the bellies of small ships and leap from the Citadel's lowest towers.
An Ender lifts its arm before it strikes, and its chest plates split open as it does.
Once the field is up, they walk up from the water in no hurry.
A plain round rings off Ender plate and goes only into an open core.
They never strike easily.
Their chest plates are shut except while they strike.
From the lift of an Ender's arm to the split of its chest plates is always a count of three.
Gray Enders stand in rows in the Citadel's open holds without moving.
They keep coming up out of the water after the field dies.
Selena thinks every suit at the Academy was built from Enders.

entries.line: Tall gray living machines made to destroy.
entries.short: Living machines, tall and gray, made to destroy. They do not think; something vast and cold made them to kill on instinct.
entries.summary: Enders are huge living machines that came from the sky after the Catastrophe of 978 to wipe out humanity, and nearly did. Under a gray metal shell they have living purple tissue and a core in the chest, which shows only when they strike: then a round or a fist can go in. Chang'e says the Will of the Planet sends them; Obsidia says each is a limb of the Mother Matrix, made in the nest, hearing only the Will. People learned to rebuild dead Enders into mecha suits, and every suit at the Academy was built from them.

official.text: When a planet with the Will of Balance finds that the existence of a certain population is prosperous enough to endanger the survival of others, it will send the Enders to wreak havoc on it with the aim to achieve balance. The Enders, who usually appear near the target population, have a solid metal shell and expose their weak spots only when they launch attacks. The Enders don't strike easily. They represent the Will of the Planet, which enters a coma once the Enders are damaged. The Enders are classified into three ranks: Ultimate Enders, Super Enders, and Enders. Ultimate Enders can release Super Enders and Enders, which though not as lethal as the Ultimate Enders, are the main killing forces due to their large number.

entries.name: feeders

facts.t: Gray Enders tear girders out of fallen houses and drag dead Enders out of the weeds, then carry it all back through the door.
Vexana calls them feeders, Enders that carry metal home; she does not know where the metal goes.
Two of them haul off an empty Aspirant suit by the legs.
They go wherever the cold point sends them.
The door takes Vexana's sack of plates along with their scrap.
On one errand they tear cable out of an old pumping station.
At the rail yards they tear at a fallen crane.
None of them looks up at the sky.
Out in the dead ground Vexana watched two feeders drag the scorched suit out of a ditch by the legs.
The feeders go off into the dark with the night's girders. Vexana has never followed them.
They tear girders out of fallen houses.
Vexana learns that their metal goes to the nest and comes back as new Enders.
On the eve of the attack no feeders come out of the dark to go with Vexana, because the Will wants only her eyes.

Enders that carry metal home.

entries.line: Enders that carry metal home through the door.
entries.short: Vexana's name for gray Enders that tear girders and dead Enders out of the ruins and carry the metal back through the door.
entries.summary: Feeders are gray Enders that tear girders out of fallen houses, cable out of an old pumping station and dead Enders out of the weeds, and carry it all back through the door; two of them once hauled off an empty Aspirant suit by the legs. Vexana names them and works beside them on her errands, and none of them looks up at the sky. In the nest she learns where their metal goes: it comes back as new Enders. On the eve of the attack none come out with her, because the Will wants only her eyes.

entries.name: giant Enders

facts.t: A giant shape moves in the smoke over the dome's western edge.
A giant Ender stands over the roofs of burning Terrinia, taller than any tower.
One steps down the avenue, shaking the ground; Ruby and Angela fight it together until it goes down.
Fanny and Layla hold a ward against another giant.
Fanny says she watched the newcomers fight a giant for the city.
On the day the black ships landed, Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front beside Lesley's squads until dark.

entries.line: Enders taller than towers.
entries.short: Enders of giant size. One stands over the roofs of burning Terrinia, taller than any tower.
entries.summary: Giant Enders are Enders taller than any tower, and their steps shake the ground. In burning Terrinia, Ruby and Angela fight one together until it goes down, while Fanny and Layla hold a ward against another. On the day the black ships landed, Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front beside Lesley's squads until dark.

entries.name: long-legged Enders

facts.t: Four of them step out of the smoke, taller than the morning's Enders, on long jointed legs like spiders standing up.
They come close behind Selena and do not reach for her.
They charge at Guinevere together, and their legs tangle in the narrow cut.
All four lie dead before the gap, one across another, so the rest must climb them.

rel.t: They are a taller kind of Ender.

entries.line: Tall Enders on jointed legs like standing spiders.
entries.short: Tall Enders on long jointed legs, like spiders standing up. Four of them step out of the smoke on the bay road.
entries.summary: Four Enders taller than the morning's, on long jointed legs like spiders standing up. They step out of the smoke on the bay road and walk close behind Selena without reaching for her. Then they charge Guinevere together, and their legs tangle in the narrow mouth of the cut. All four end up dead before the gap, one across another, so everything behind must climb them.

entries.name: Mother Matrix

facts.t: Something vast and cold made Obsidia's kind to kill on instinct.
When Obsidia woke with her question about what her kind are for, the thing that made her had no answer.
Chang'e says the readings suggest the Will of the Planet has a body, something vast far out where nobody can see, and they call it the Mother Matrix.
In the Will's vision, something vast and winged comes down through a tear in the sky over the Academy's tower.
Chang'e called it the Will's body, as far as her readings could tell.
Vexana plans to be within reach when it opens its chest to fire, and strike its open core.
In the void it lies vast, unlit and unmoving, at the far edge of rows of still Enders.
Vexana thinks the gateway will one day be wide enough for it to pass.
Obsidia sees it as the body that made her kind; it opened the way for her ship.
Obsidia means to go down to it to be healed.
Its signal, the pulse, runs one line down to every Ender and tells them where to go and what to do.
It lies as still as the Citadel's holds.
When it began the gateway, its pulse changed and called its commander in.
Its two violet eyes glow high in a horned head crowned with tall spikes. Purple wings lie folded along its sides.
A thin streak of light runs sideways from one eye.
Vexana knows that streak from a memory, where she watched it rise through a blue sky over Guinevere's head.
Its eyes look at nothing.
Its chest is shut behind great plates that meet in one seam, longer than the Academy's tower is tall, with a dim magenta glow.
Strands of living violet tissue come out of its seam and heal Obsidia.
Obsidia says it sees nothing for itself. It bears the Enders and carries the Will's command, with no wants and no after.
Obsidia says it does not live. It works.
Obsidia says it made the Enders and mends her by one rule: free will is a flaw that must be corrected.
Obsidia says that in a purge the body rises in the void and the nest fills.
Obsidia says that if a people fight until the purge stalls, the body opens a great door and comes down itself.
Obsidia says so many Enders broken at once at the breach is the step that brings the body down.
It lies vast and still beside the crack. Nothing on it moves.
Obsidia says the gate is the body's door, so the body goes through first.
Its purple tissue spreads under the rows like roots, out from its vast flank.
Obsidia says she has asked the body about what comes after, and it has no after to answer with.
Chang'e says the readings suggest the Will has a body, which they call the Mother Matrix.
Selena's cells know what the name Mother Matrix means, though she has never heard it.
Selena will not return to a Mother Matrix ruled by nothing but slaughter and control.
Obsidia calls it the body. Its first wave will come through the door once the door is wide enough.
For years its raids came down on the humans' world, until only one city was left.
Obsidia thinks it cannot answer a people that learns, because it has no mind to learn with.
The door is the body's, and it passes one at a time, so the body goes through first.
After the humans broke its army at a hole in their dome, it began the door and called Obsidia in.
The nest where Selena grew is pressed into its tissue.
In all of Vexana's weeks in the dark its bulk never moved, until the day before the attack, when its edge slid toward the crack.
Chang'e guesses from her readings that something larger is coming through after the Enders.
A huge clawed hand plated in violet comes through first, then a horned head crowned with spikes, then wings each as wide as a ward.
Only half of it is through, and that half fills the sky over the bay.
Nobody had ever seen it. Teacher Chang'e named it from the readings.
Its chest plates split and it fires a white beam across the city at Guinevere.
Whole, it shows a horned head under a crown of spikes, two glowing violet eyes, great wings, and a chest shut plate over plate.
Its eyes once looked down at Vexana out of the torn sky over the tree.
When it fires, its chest plates split and a magenta core blazes in the gap.
Enders drop off its wings onto the stair and over the gap.
After it fires, its plates close and it needs time to gather again.
It hangs right in front of the Singularity, its chest before the middle of the star.
It fired three times that day, and each time Vexana was in front of it.
It sweeps a hand bigger than the platform across the sky at the two girls.
When the volley strikes its crown, its eyes and one arm turn to the platform, and its chest opens.
Struck in the open chest, it staggers back into the light at the star's edge, and its chest plates grind shut over the wound.
Guinevere says they stopped the Matrix's invasion and saved the world.
It hangs at the edge of the Singularity, half in its light, wings flung wide, its chest shut over the wound.
Struck at the chest by the two returning lights, it goes slowly back into the star until the glow closes over it.
Fanny thinks of it as pushed back, not dead.
Selena calls it big and useless.
Obsidia calls it the body; it grew her throne for her when she woke.
It withdraws below the Citadel's keel with its wings half folded, magenta glowing on the seam where its chest plates shut over the wound, back into the dark where it heals.
It fired a beam at a machine of Ender plates that stood in front of it.
It gave way before the two lights that came back out of the black point.
On every world Obsidia helped end, nothing had wounded the Will's body until two human girls did.
After the battle its signature still sits faint behind the Singularity's light.
Chang'e says it is not dead, only gone back.

entries.line: The vast, cold thing that made the Enders.

entries.summary: The Mother Matrix is the Will of the Planet's body, Obsidia says: it bears the Enders and carries the Will's command, with no wants and no after. entries.name: the black-and-gold giant

facts.t: It is a giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms.
It walks without hurry, like a machine doing what it was told.
Its chest plates open and light gathers behind them, gold, then white.
Its light comes down on Chang'e's parents and leaves a crater with nothing in it.
While swarms hold the Shield at the edge, it walks through the middle of the city toward the base.
It fires a white beam down on the base's yard, then walks away into the dark.
Years later a giant, gold and black and taller than any tower on the waterfront, stops at the top of the avenue.
Chang'e thinks it is the same one.
It cannot fire with its chest plates shut; the light behind them is the way in.
Lesley's round and Chang'e's crescent go into its open chest together, and it bursts white from inside.
It falls across the top of the avenue, over streets already empty.
Lesley never found out why it went for the base.
It is black and gold, taller than the towers around it, and walks through the middle of the fire.
Its hum reaches Selena across the whole city and rings in her bones.
A white light opens in its chest, and far off a street goes white, then dark.
It turns back into the smoke.

weapons.name: Chest light
weapons.note: Gathers gold, then white, behind its opening chest plates and fires down. It cannot fire with the plates shut.

rows: Black and gold, hundreds of meters tall, on tall thin legs, with curved blades hanging from its arms
Chang'e's parents, on the night the base fell
Lesley's round and Chang'e's crescent, together

rel.t: A giant Ender.
It killed her parents.
She thinks it is the giant that killed her parents.
She helps bring it down.
An Ender of giant size.

entries.line: A black-and-gold giant Ender with blades on its arms.
entries.short: A giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms. It walks without hurry.
entries.summary: A giant Ender hundreds of meters tall, black and gold, on tall thin legs, with huge curved blades hanging from its arms. On the night the base fell it walked through the middle of the city, killed Chang'e's parents with the light from its chest and fired a white beam down on the base's yard. Years later a black-and-gold giant, which Chang'e thinks is the same one, stops at the top of the avenue, and Lesley's round and Chang'e's crescent go into its open chest together, so it bursts white from inside. Lesley never finds out why it went for the base.

entries.name: the Ender at the breach

facts.t: It forces its head and shoulders through the hole in the dome. It is tall enough to look into a second-floor window.
Its gray plates grind together with a sound Layla feels in her back teeth.
When it heaves, the front of the corner building comes down in a slab onto Joe.
It never even looked at Joe.
Its chest is plated shut, so the neck is the only opening.
As it swings at Fanny, its chest plates split and its core glows.
Layla's bolt goes into its core. Its chest blows open and it sags against the dome.

rel.t: It is one of the Enders at the breach.
Its heave brings down the slab that hurts Joe.

entries.line: The Ender that forced its way through the hole in the dome.
entries.short: An Ender forcing its head and shoulders through the hole in the dome, tall enough to look into a second-floor window.
entries.summary: A gray Ender that forced its head and shoulders through the hole in the dome, tall enough to look into a second-floor window, its plates grinding. When it heaved, the front of a corner building came down on Professor Joe, though it never even looked at him. Its chest was plated shut, but as it swung at Fanny its plates split and its core glowed, and Layla's bolt went in and blew its chest open.

entries.name: the Ender at the wall

facts.t: It came over the city wall in the attack, tall and gray, smoke running off its shoulders and a torn line of washing hanging from one claw.
It did not look at Vexana the way a person looks; it only stopped.
It raised its claw at her.
A soldier said it never got past Vexana's father while he stood.
Vexana remembers her father's back between her and its raised claw.

rel.t: He stood between it and Vexana.

entries.line: The Ender that came over the city wall in Vexana's childhood.
entries.short: A tall gray Ender that came over the city wall in the attack, a torn line of washing hanging from one claw. It raised that claw at young Vexana.
entries.summary: A tall gray Ender that came over the city wall in the attack of Vexana's childhood, smoke running off its shoulders and a torn line of washing hanging from one claw. It did not look at young Vexana the way a person looks; it only stopped, and raised its claw. Her father stood between them, and a soldier later said it never got past him while he stood.

entries.name: the Ender on the deck

facts.t: It climbs the tower's face hand over hand, straight toward the console.
It bursts the glass and hauls itself half into the deck.
It is three times Chang'e's height, its chest plated shut.
It bends toward Chang'e but does not strike at once.
Its claw strikes Mr. Bunny instead of Chang'e.
Lesley's round goes into its open core, and it falls away down the tower.

rel.t: It bends to strike at Chang'e.

entries.line: An Ender that climbs the tower to the command deck.
entries.short: An Ender that climbs the tower's face hand over hand and bursts into the command deck, three times Chang'e's height.
entries.summary: An Ender three times Chang'e's height that climbed the tower's face hand over hand, burst the glass and hauled itself half into the command deck. It bent toward Chang'e but did not strike at once. When it did, its claw hit Mr. Bunny instead of her, and Lesley's round went into its open core, so it fell away down the tower.

entries.name: the Ender that took Vexana

facts.t: Its shadow, edged in purple light, rises over Guinevere's from behind, its claw raised.
It comes without any sound at all.
It reaches out of a burning purple door in the white wall: a long gray leg and a claw of long blades.
Its claw closes on Vexana's hand, the hand that pushed Guinevere.
It came out of the wall for Guinevere's open back and missed.
It drags Vexana a long way through the void, and her blows do not loosen its grip.
Then it lets go and leaves without looking back, its violet glow shrinking to a point.

rel.t: It is one of the Enders.
It takes Vexana into the void.

entries.line: The Ender that reached out of a burning purple door in the wall.
entries.short: An Ender that reaches without a sound out of a burning purple door in the wall, claw raised at Guinevere's back, and closes it on Vexana's hand.
entries.summary: An Ender that came without any sound out of a burning purple door in the white wall, a long gray leg and a claw of long blades, reaching for Guinevere's open back. It missed, and its claw closed on Vexana's hand, the hand that had pushed Guinevere. It dragged Vexana a long way through the void without loosening its grip, then let go and left without looking back, its violet glow shrinking to a point.

entries.name: the gold giant

facts.t: Out on the sand, something gold stands up, leans its long head into the dome and breaks it apart in a ring.
None of Joe's three ranks had been gold.
It stands taller than the towers.
Light gathers in its chest.
It lowers its head through the broken dome, and its shadow covers the little girl.
It fires a beam of gold light from its chest that burns a line down the avenue.
Layla works out that its chest opens when it fires and its glow doubles every four seconds.
Its chest opens and it fires at Fanny.
Layla's full charge splits its gold beam and goes into its open chest.
Everything it had gathered goes off inside it.
It lies in burning pieces on the sand.
It broke a gap in the dome wide enough for a truck.

weapons.name: Gold beam
weapons.note: Fired from its chest, it burns a line down the avenue. Its glow doubles every four seconds as it gathers.

rows: Gold, with a long head, taller than the towers
Layla's full charge, into its open chest

rel.t: It breaks the dome apart in a ring.
It is an Ender that fits none of Joe's three ranks.

entries.line: A gold giant that broke the dome apart in a ring.
entries.short: Something gold that stands up on the sand and breaks the dome apart in a ring. It is taller than the towers and fits none of Joe's ranks.
entries.summary: A gold giant, taller than the towers, that stood up on the sand, leaned its long head into the dome and broke it apart in a ring, leaving a gap wide enough for a truck. None of Professor Joe's three Ender ranks had been gold. It fired a gold beam from its chest down the avenue, and Layla worked out that its chest opens when it fires and its glow doubles every four seconds. Her full charge split its beam and went into its open chest, everything it had gathered went off inside it, and it lay in burning pieces on the sand.

entries.name: the human-faced shells

facts.t: A short row apart from the rest, past the largest shells. Its shells are not gray.
They have smooth human faces with shut eyes. Some are no bigger than a child, one has folded hands, one is split open from the inside and empty.
Obsidia says she shaped them toward human likeness. Some broke when the body first moved them, and none held a self.

rows: A row of the nest, past the largest shells

rel.t: They lie in a row of the nest.
She shaped them.

entries.line: A row of Ender shells with human faces in the nest.
entries.short: A short row of shells in the nest that are not gray. They have smooth human faces with shut eyes, and Obsidia shaped them.
entries.summary: A short row in the nest, past the largest shells and apart from the rest. The shells are not gray: they have smooth human faces with shut eyes, some no bigger than a child, one with folded hands, one split open from the inside and empty. Obsidia says she shaped them toward human likeness, that some broke when the body first moved them, and that none held a self.

entries.name: the tall gray Ender

facts.t: Behind a swarm of black things with too many limbs walks a gray Ender taller than a tower.
As the sun sinks, the swarm draws back and the tall one goes with it.

rel.t: It walks behind the swarm outside the dome.

entries.line: A gray Ender taller than a tower.
entries.short: A gray Ender taller than a tower, walking behind a swarm outside the dome.
entries.summary: A single gray Ender taller than a tower. It walks behind a swarm of black things with too many limbs, out in the open outside the dome, while Layla and Fanny fight back to back. As the sun sinks, the swarm draws back and the tall one goes with it.

entries.name: Ultimate Enders

facts.t: Joe teaches that Ultimate Enders are the deadliest rank and release the other two.
Layla runs through this rank when the gold giant appears and finds it does not fit.
The largest shells in the nest are as tall as towers, with open chests holding smaller folded shapes.
Obsidia says the large ones carry the others in and let them out where the fighting is.
They stand in the holds of the Storm Citadel with their chests open, each packed with lesser Enders, and new heavier plate has closed over their shoulders.
When Obsidia approves the augmentation, their chests swing shut.

rel.t: The highest of Joe's three ranks.
They are the deadliest kind of Ender.
The largest kind of Ender.
They wait in its holds.
They are a kind of Ender that carries lesser Enders.
Obsidia approves their augmentation.
She approves their augmentation.

entries.line: The highest and deadliest rank of Enders.
entries.short: The deadliest of the three Ender ranks Professor Joe teaches. They release the other two.
entries.summary: Ultimate Enders are the deadliest of Joe's three Ender ranks, and they release the other two. In the nest their shells grow as tall as towers, with open chests holding smaller folded shapes; Obsidia says they carry the others in and let them out where the fighting is. In the Storm Citadel's holds they stand packed with lesser Enders under new, heavier plate, and their chests swing shut when Obsidia approves the augmentation.

entries.name: Ultra Enders

facts.t: The siren says Ultra Enders are attacking the defense sphere in Terrinia's Northeastern sector.
Roger asks whether Ultra means Ultimate. Nobody answers.
Layla remembers that the siren said Ultra and that nobody answered Roger.

rel.t: They attack the dome over Terrinia's Northeastern sector.

entries.line: Enders named Ultra by the siren.
entries.short: Enders the siren calls Ultra, attacking the dome in the Northeastern sector. Roger asks if Ultra means Ultimate. Nobody answers.
entries.summary: The name the siren gives the Enders attacking the defense sphere in Terrinia's Northeastern sector. Roger asks whether Ultra means Ultimate, and nobody answers. Layla knows only three ranks: Plain, Super and Ultimate, the deadliest. The siren said Ultra, and nobody ever answered Roger.

entries.name: Angela's awakening

facts.t: On the last night a bar crosses the screen beside the chosen name, SUCCESS comes up, and Ruby presses the key.
The android opens her eyes. Every other android woke magenta. Hers are blue.
Ruby names her Angela.
It happened a few weeks before Angela hears the technicians.

rel.t: It happens in the Laboratory.

entries.line: The night the android Ruby built first opens her eyes.
entries.short: The night the android Ruby built opens her eyes. Every other android woke magenta; hers are blue. Ruby names her Angela.
entries.summary: On the last night of work in the Laboratory on Oro, a bar crosses the screen beside the name Ruby chose, SUCCESS comes up, and Ruby presses the key. The android opens her eyes. Every other android woke with magenta eyes; hers are blue. Ruby names her Angela.

entries.name: Chang'e's glass chamber test

facts.t: Chang'e sealed a lit core in a glass chamber and pumped out the air; every needle on her dials fell to nothing, but the light held.

rows: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole

rel.t: Her paper reports it.

entries.line: Chang'e's test of a lit core in a glass chamber with no air.
entries.short: Chang'e sealed a lit core in a glass chamber and pumped out the air. Every needle on her dials fell to nothing, but the light held.
entries.summary: A test Chang'e reports in her paper On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole. She sealed a lit core in a glass chamber and pumped out the air. Every needle on her dials fell to nothing, but the light held. From it the paper argues that an Aspirant's light would shine on even inside a black hole and find its way home.

entries.name: Chang'e's lesson on the Will

facts.t: Chang'e opened by asking who sends the Enders.
She taught the theory of the Will of the Planet, Balance, the Mother Matrix and the Control Core.
She explained the portals and the void.
She admitted nobody can get near the void.
She refused to explain her untested black hole idea.
She ended with "The Aspirant power is strong."
Vexana recalls her teacher saying nobody can get near the dark.
Chang'e says they think the Will of the Planet is a mind, with a body they call the Mother Matrix.
Chang'e speaks of a dark called the void that nobody can get near.
Selena thinks it got near her fine that morning, at a bus stop.

rel.t: It was taught in her classroom.
Chang'e teaches it.

entries.line: Chang'e's class on who sends the Enders.
entries.short: Chang'e's class on who sends the Enders: the Will of the Planet, Balance, the Mother Matrix, the Control Core, the portals and the void.
entries.summary: Chang'e opened the lesson by asking who sends the Enders. She taught the theory of the Will of the Planet, which they think is a mind with a body they call the Mother Matrix, along with Balance and the Enders' Control Core. She explained the portals and the void, admitted nobody can get near the void, and refused to explain her untested black hole idea. She ended with "The Aspirant power is strong." Guinevere and Vexana sat at the back with their new badges, and Selena thought the dark had got near her fine that morning, at a bus stop.

entries.name: Fanny's assessment

facts.t: Fanny's assessment is held in the VR Battlefield.
She pulls a simulated civilian clear first, at a cost of eleven seconds.
She fights with her back to a narrow alley.
Her time, 3:39, goes above Layla's 3:41 on the rankings board.
Layla reruns it five times without saving the civilian. Her best is 3:40.
Layla works out that without the civilian, Fanny did it in 3:28.
Roger says Fanny broke a record nobody had ever broken, on her first day.

rows: 3:39, with eleven seconds spent saving a civilian

rel.t: It takes place in the VR Battlefield.

entries.line: Fanny's first run in the VR Battlefield.
entries.short: Fanny's entrance run in the VR Battlefield. She saves a simulated civilian first, and her 3:39 still beats Layla's 3:41 on the board.
entries.summary: Fanny's assessment was held in the VR Battlefield. She pulled a simulated civilian clear first, at a cost of eleven seconds, and fought with her back to a narrow alley. Her time, 3:39, went above Layla's 3:41 on the rankings board. Layla reran it five times without saving the civilian, and her best was 3:40; she worked out that without the civilian Fanny had done it in 3:28. Roger said Fanny broke a record nobody had ever broken, on her first day.

entries.name: Guinevere's block

facts.t: Guinevere drops between Vexana and the Matrix, crosses her arms, and her drones fling themselves in front of her.
The light hits the drones first and her second. Her boots slide back and stop, and she holds.
The light dies and the Matrix's plates close.
Vexana's chance at the open chest passes while Guinevere's back stands between them.

entries.line: Guinevere takes the Mother Matrix's light to shield Vexana.
entries.short: Guinevere drops between Vexana and the Mother Matrix and takes its light, her drones first and herself second. Her boots slide back, but she holds.
entries.summary: When the Mother Matrix's chest opened over the kneeling Vexana, Guinevere dropped between them and crossed her arms, and her drones flung themselves in front of her. The light hit the drones first and her second. Her boots slid back and stopped, and she held. Then the light died and the Matrix's plates closed. Vexana's chance at the open chest, the moment her plan was made for, passed while Guinevere's back stood between them.

entries.name: Joe's lecture on Enders

facts.t: Joe opens a gold-covered book, and a life-size VR Ender fills the wall.
He teaches that Enders show their weak spots only when they attack.
He teaches the three Ender ranks.
He teaches the lull.
His last slide is the recording of the Storm Citadel.
Its last slide was a shaking recording of a ship of black blades over a city in a red sky; Vexana watched it with Guinevere beside her.

rel.t: Joe taught it.

entries.line: Professor Joe's Combat Division class on how Enders fight.
entries.short: Professor Joe's class on Enders: they show their weak spots only when they attack, come in three ranks, and go quiet for a lull when badly hurt.
entries.summary: Professor Joe opened a gold-covered book, and a life-size VR Ender filled the wall. He taught that Enders show their weak spots only when they attack, that they come in three ranks, and that hurting them badly brings a lull. His last slide was a shaking recording of the Storm Citadel, a ship of black blades over a city in a red sky. Vexana watched it with Guinevere beside her.

entries.name: Lesley's birthday

facts.t: Years later Lesley still plays the recording of it after her dream.
Lesley tells Chang'e she does not have a birthday.
Chang'e decides to find it.
On the birthday night Chang'e sets a second chair under the lamp and waits by the door with the eye in her pocket.
There are no decorations: two chairs, a lamp and a robot with a lens.
Chang'e gives Lesley the eye and says 'Happy Birthday, Lesley!'
Lesley had not known it was her birthday.
The eye lights.
This year Lesley knows which date is hers; it is two weeks off.
She tells nobody, thinking last year was enough.
Chang'e finishes the rifle the night before.
Nobody mentions it all day, which Lesley thinks is correct.
At dusk Chang'e takes her sleeve: her shift ended four minutes ago.
Chang'e unveils the rifle and tells Lesley she will be the best sniper ever.
Chang'e laughs so hard at Lesley's answer that she sits down on the floor.

rows: An eye, then a year later a rifle
The lab at the research base
entries.line: Lesley's birthdays, and the gifts Chang'e gave her on them.
entries.short: A birthday from Lesley's past. After her dream she still plays its recording: Chang'e, small and beaming, setting an eye in her palm.
entries.summary: Lesley told Chang'e she did not have a birthday, so Chang'e decided to find it. On the night there were no decorations, only two chairs, a lamp and a robot with a lens; Chang'e gave Lesley the eye and said "Happy Birthday, Lesley!" Lesley had not known it was her birthday, and the eye lit. A year later Lesley knew her date and told nobody. At dusk Chang'e took her sleeve and unveiled a rifle she had finished the night before, saying Lesley would be the best sniper ever, and Lesley's answer made her laugh so hard she sat down on the floor. Years later Lesley still plays the recording of the first one.

entries.name: Lesley's secret mission

facts.t: The Shield sends Lesley on a top secret mission because the whole core piece makes her its most valuable shot; she will learn where on the road.
It has no radio and no letters, since the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals.
For its nine days no word comes from Lesley.
It is over when she rides back, and she will never tell anyone what it was.
Years later she still cannot tell Chang'e what it was.

rel.t: A Shield mission.

entries.line: A top secret Shield mission Lesley is sent on, with no radio and no letters.
entries.short: A top secret Shield mission for Lesley, now its most valuable shot. It has no radio and no letters: the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals.
entries.summary: Because Lesley brought in a core piece whole, the Shield calls her its most valuable shot and sends her on a top secret mission; she will learn where on the road. It has no radio and no letters, since the Shield thinks the Enders can hear its signals. For nine days no word comes from her. It is over when she rides back, and she will never tell anyone what it was. Years later she still cannot tell Chang'e.

entries.name: Oro's war with the Enders

facts.t: Ruby's lesson says that long ago Oro fought a terrible war with the Enders. Since then nobody on Oro may grow strong enough to upset the order, and the Enders never came back.

rel.t: It was fought by Oro.

entries.line: A terrible war Oro fought with the Enders long ago.
entries.short: Ruby's lesson says Oro once fought a terrible war with the Enders. Since then nobody on Oro may grow strong enough to upset the order.
entries.summary: Ruby's lessons say that long ago Oro fought a terrible war with the Enders. Since then nobody on Oro may grow strong enough to upset the order, and her tutor reminds her that this includes the heir. That, the lesson says, is why the Enders never came back.

entries.name: Ruby's summons

facts.t: The summons comes the morning after Ruby watches the dark ship.
Ruby knows nobody is called to the Council hall to be praised.
Her father rebukes her for laughing alone.
His boot comes down on her tears.
After he leaves, she whispers that she has a plan.

rel.t: It takes place in the Council hall.

entries.line: Ruby is called to the Council hall and rebuked by her father.
entries.short: The morning after Ruby watches a dark ship cross the windows, she is called to the Council hall. Her father rebukes her for laughing alone.
entries.summary: The summons came the morning after Ruby watched a dark ship cross the high windows, and she knew nobody is called to the Council hall to be praised. She stood in a circle of light while her father stood outside it and rebuked her for laughing alone. When her tears fell, his boot came down on them. After he left, she whispered that she had a plan, though she had none yet.

entries.name: Selena's naming

facts.t: Selena is a name she chose for herself.
In Obsidia's mouth the name sounds owned.
Days after the night of the mud, at a window running with rain, she gave herself a name, and Karina said 'Selena it is.'

entries.line: The day Selena chose her own name.
entries.short: Selena chose her own name. Days after Karina found her, at a rainy window, she said it, and Karina said "Selena it is."
entries.summary: Selena is a name she chose for herself. Days after the night of the mud, at a window running with rain, she gave herself the name, and Karina said "Selena it is." She would rather live by that name than remain someone else's pawn. In Obsidia's mouth the name sounds owned.

entries.name: Selena's sales to Vexana

facts.t: Not long after the missing board went up, Vexana stepped out of the dark into Selena's lamp at the crews' yard.
All Selena said about her changed hair was "Nice hair."
Selena sells openly, because Vexana cannot tell on her without telling on herself, and she pays in places.
Selena tells her most people think she is dead but her partner does not, only to watch her face.
The first sack held a knee and a shoulder, then the other knee and a thigh, then two forearms and a hip, then cores.
Four cracked cores came over the weeks. Selena never asked what the other three were for.

rows: Places where whole downed Enders lie, where no crew has been yet

rel.t: They met at the crews' yard.

entries.line: Selena sells Ender salvage to the missing Vexana, paid in places.
entries.short: The missing Vexana steps into Selena's lamp at the crews' yard. Selena sells her Ender parts, and Vexana pays in places where whole Enders lie.
entries.summary: Not long after the missing board went up, Vexana stepped out of the dark into Selena's lamp at the crews' yard. Selena sold to her openly, since Vexana could not tell on her without telling on herself, and Vexana paid in places. The sacks held a knee and a shoulder, then the other knee and a thigh, then two forearms and a hip, then cores. Four cracked cores came over the weeks, and Selena never asked what the other three were for. She told Vexana most people thought she was dead but her partner did not, only to watch her face. All she said about the changed hair was "Nice hair."

entries.name: Selena's trade with the Enders

facts.t: Unable to cut or outrun the pull, Selena decides it has a price, like everything else in the city.
Her first message reads: "Not coming back. Let's trade."
Under it she puts the Academy's dull routines, last year's suit specifications, how aspirant power drives a suit, and how strong suits run by kind and rank.
She types the hour the shore ward changes its watch and deletes it. She names no one.
She tells herself the rest was stale.
In answer a place comes into her head: a ditch in the dead ground with a downed Ender, which she strips and sells.
She decides it is not a leash but a market.
Put together, what she sold shows every Academy suit from the inside, enough to build a weapon against them all.
After each report the pull eased for a while and a ditch with a downed Ender came into her head.
Then her reports get nothing back, and she stops sending.

rel.t: Selena's own dealings.

entries.line: Selena sells what she knows of the Academy, up the pull in her cells.
entries.short: Unable to cut or outrun the pull in her cells, Selena sends it Academy secrets. In answer, a place where a downed Ender lies comes into her head.
entries.summary: Unable to cut or outrun the pull, Selena decided it had a price, like everything else in the city. Her first message read "Not coming back. Let's trade." Under it went the Academy's dull routines, last year's suit specifications, how aspirant power drives a suit and how strong suits run by kind and rank. She deleted the shore ward's watch hour, named no one, and told herself the rest was stale. In answer a ditch with a downed Ender came into her head, which she stripped and sold. Put together, what she sold shows every Academy suit from the inside. Then her reports got nothing back, and she stopped sending.

entries.name: Silverbolt's first run

facts.t: The first big storm after the rebuild comes in off the bay at dusk.
Selena rides past the last lit streets into roofless blocks.
The frame clears a gap between two roofs, and the rebuilt hind leg holds.
A laugh comes out of her that she never had to copy.
She thinks nobody can call her back.
In a lightning flash she names the machine Silverbolt.
Later she remembers laughing on that run and thinking nobody could call her back.

entries.line: Selena's first storm ride on her rebuilt machine.
entries.short: In the first big storm after the rebuild, Selena rides her machine over roofless blocks, laughing, and names it Silverbolt in a lightning flash.
entries.summary: The first big storm after the rebuild came in off the bay at dusk. Selena rode the frame past the last lit streets into roofless blocks, and it cleared a gap between two roofs; the rebuilt hind leg held. A laugh came out of her that she never had to copy, and she thought nobody could call her back. In a lightning flash she named the machine Silverbolt. Later, with the pull in her cells, she remembers that run and that thought.

entries.name: Team-Up Day

facts.t: A banner over the courtyard read THE ASPIRANTS TEAM-UP DAY.
It is the day the preparatory course ends and cadets ask each other to be partners.
All morning nobody asked Guinevere.
Layla turned a boy away from the upper walk.
Vexana told Guinevere she was strong.
Vexana refused to be Guinevere's partner.
On it Guinevere crossed the courtyard in six strides and asked Vexana to be her partner.
Vexana said no.
Guinevere asked again the next day on the stairs and kept asking until the answer changed.

rel.t: It is held in the Academy courtyard.
It took place at the Academy.

entries.line: The day the preparatory course ends and cadets choose partners.
entries.short: The day the preparatory course ends, when cadets ask each other to be partners. A banner over the courtyard reads THE ASPIRANTS TEAM-UP DAY.
entries.summary: The Aspirants Team-Up Day ends the preparatory course, and cadets ask each other to be partners under a banner over the courtyard. All morning nobody asked Guinevere, and Layla turned a boy away from the upper walk. Then Guinevere crossed the courtyard in six strides and asked Vexana. Vexana told her she was strong, but said no. Guinevere asked again the next day on the stairs, and kept asking until the answer changed.

entries.name: the augmentation

facts.t: The Ultimate Enders in the holds have their chests packed with lesser Enders and new, heavier plate over their shoulders.
Obsidia says, "Augmentation approved."
The chests swing shut, ready for the morning.

entries.line: Obsidia's upgrade of the Ultimate Enders on the eve of the attack.
entries.short: Obsidia's upgrade of the Ultimate Enders: their chests packed with lesser Enders, heavier plate on their shoulders.
entries.summary: On the day before the attack, the Ultimate Enders stood in the Storm Citadel's holds with their chests open, each packed with lesser Enders. New plate, heavier than before, had closed over their shoulders. "Augmentation approved," said Obsidia. Along the holds the chests swung shut, ready for the morning, when the door would be wide enough for the body's first wave.

entries.name: the Balance Keepers' landings

facts.t: Between training days the Balance Keepers take Angela from planet to planet. With her in their ranks they have not lost a landing.
At each landing she is allowed a ramp's length to look at a strange sky, then the Laboratory door closes again.
After the sixth return Ruby falls asleep at her bench.

rel.t: They are the Balance Keepers' missions.

entries.line: Angela's missions with Oro's special forces, from planet to planet.
entries.short: Missions on which the Balance Keepers take Angela from planet to planet. With her in their ranks they never lose a landing.
entries.summary: Between training days, the Balance Keepers, Oro's special forces, took Angela in black ships from planet to planet. With her in their ranks they did not lose a landing. At each one she was allowed the length of a ramp to look at a strange sky, and then the Laboratory door closed again. After the sixth return Ruby fell asleep at her bench.

entries.name: the Best Aspirant Duo ceremony

facts.t: The patrons had the front row, and the HOUSE BAROQUE chair was empty.
The Academy's first Best Aspirant Duo badges went to Guinevere and Vexana.
Lesley's whole speech was "Undefeated."
Guinevere shouted "We're the best partners in The Aspirants!"
The camera droid took the hand-in-hand picture they kept.
Since it, Vexana sets Guinevere's bow straight every morning.
The House's seat stayed empty at it, with Hester two rows behind.
Before the photo Vexana straightened Guinevere's bow; they stood hand in hand with badges of honor while Lesley smiled and the others cheered.
Students pour out of the hall cheering. A pink-haired girl holds a new badge over her head.
Selena misses it.
Two girls with new badges still pinned on sit at the back of Chang'e's lesson, one pink-haired and one black-haired.
Selena keeps those two girls, and everyone else, out of her report.
On the day of the badges, Vexana reached over without a word to straighten Guinevere's crooked bow, and the whole hall cheered while their hands were clasped.

entries.name: the breaking of Angela's shield

facts.t: The trainers raise the Training Droid's setting from four to six because Angela will not strike.
A month later the setting is nine, and the fist cracks her shield from edge to edge.
Angela says the warmth is disappearing as she goes down.
She wakes face down on the Laboratory table with her back panel open, and reboots.
Afterward her left shoulder throws blue sparks.

rel.t: It happens on the Training Field.

entries.line: The day the Training Droid's fist cracks Angela's shield.
entries.short: Because Angela will not strike, the trainers keep raising the Training Droid's setting. At nine, its fist cracks her shield from edge to edge.
entries.summary: Angela would only block, never strike, so the trainers raised the Training Droid's setting from four to six. A month later it stood at nine, and the fist cracked her shield from edge to edge. As she went down, she said the warmth was disappearing. She woke face down on the Laboratory table with her back panel open and rebooted. Afterward her left shoulder threw blue sparks.

entries.name: the Catastrophe

facts.t: The Catastrophe came in 978. In the years after it, the Enders were everywhere.
Nobody has lived in the streets of the dead ground since it.
Vexana names the stage of small doors and Enders coming through: the Catastrophe.
Obsidia says it is the humans' name for it. The Enders die in numbers and the Will goes dark for a while, then sends more.

rel.t: It emptied those streets.
Obsidia's account makes it a stage of the purge.

entries.line: The great Ender onslaught of 978.
entries.short: The disaster of 978. In the years after it the Enders were everywhere, and they nearly wiped out humanity.
entries.summary: The Catastrophe came in 978. In the years after it the Enders were everywhere, and nobody has lived in the streets of the dead ground since. Obsidia tells Vexana it is the humans' name for one stage of the purge, when small doors open near a people and Enders come through. She says the Enders die in numbers and the Will goes dark for a while, then sends more.

entries.name: the chocolate day

facts.t: The whole Academy trades chocolate. Layla carries nineteen boxes.
Fanny has twenty-six boxes stacked behind her.
Fanny gives Layla a pink box with a teal ribbon, for her teammate.
That night Layla puts the box beside her trophy, ribbon facing the room.

entries.name: the Citadel's crossing

facts.t: It wore Obsidia's shell into fine cracks.
The storm drew in around the ship and the crossing began.
Stars slid past, far apart and cold.
It ends before the crack of sky.

rel.t: It is the Citadel's journey.

entries.line: The Storm Citadel's voyage across the dark to the crack of sky.
entries.short: The Storm Citadel's voyage across the dark to the crack of sky. The journey wears Obsidia's shell into fine cracks.
entries.summary: When the Mother Matrix called its commander in, the storm drew in around the Storm Citadel and the crossing began. The ship crossed the dark while stars slid past, far apart and cold. It ended before the crack of sky, and it wore Obsidia's shell into fine cracks.

entries.name: the dawn raid

facts.t: One dawn an Ender crossed the station wall in one stride.
The soldiers fell back to the bunker line while Lesley lay flat on the wall walk and loaded.
Lesley fired once into its core and killed it, saving the youngest soldier.
Asked to report, she said: 'Another threat eliminated.'
That night she chalked her own stroke on the armory door.

entries.short: One dawn an Ender crosses the station wall in one stride. Lesley, lying on the wall walk, kills it with one shot into its core.

She fired once into its core and killed it, saving the youngest soldier. Asked to report, she said "Another threat eliminated." That night she chalked her own stroke on the armory door.

entries.name: the day at the office door

facts.t: On the rest day after the trial, Hester drove Guinevere home at first light.
Guinevere waited all day on the bench across from her father's half-open office door.
Morning passed; men with ledgers went in and out, and the door stayed as it was.
At dusk she held the paper up and said "Father. I took the top score."
He answered only "Stop being so stubborn and focus more on the family business!" and left.
Guinevere asked Hester to take her back to the Academy.
Guinevere later remembers sitting all day on the bench with the paper on her knee.

rel.t: It happened at the House.

entries.line: Guinevere's day waiting outside her father's office door.
entries.short: On the rest day after the trial, Guinevere waits all day outside her father's half-open office door to tell him she took the top score.
entries.summary: On the rest day after the final trial, Hester drove Guinevere home at first light. She waited all day on the bench across from her father's half-open office door, the paper on her knee, while men with ledgers went in and out. At dusk she held the paper up and said "Father. I took the top score." He answered only "Stop being so stubborn and focus more on the family business!" and left. Guinevere asked Hester to take her back to the Academy.

entries.name: the day of the tree

facts.t: On the day of the ceremony Guinevere lay with her head in Vexana's lap under a yellowing tree on the lawn.
Guinevere told the story of the wings of light.
Vexana spoke of her father for the first time.
Guinevere vowed to find a way to destroy the Control Core.
That evening Vexana went alone to the library and found Chang'e's paper.
Vexana calls it the day of the tree; by then it was last year.

entries.summary: On the day of the ceremony Guinevere lay with her head in Vexana's lap under a yellowing tree on the Academy lawn. She told the story of the wings of light, Vexana spoke of her father for the first time, and Guinevere vowed to find a way to destroy the Control Core. That evening Vexana went alone to the library and found Chang'e's paper. Vexana calls it the day of the tree.

facts.t: Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela stand at the front in combat suits; the other students line the walls.
Lesley declares Ruby and Angela Aspirants as of today and says the four stand together.

She speaks of trusting each other to gain limitless strength.
Vexana waits by the door and Guinevere waves from along the wall.
Layla stands under the five great stars during the last words of the speech.
Newcomers became Aspirants in the Academy hall.
Ruby held her scythe point-down before Lesley.
Lesley gave a speech.
Layla answered Guinevere's wave with two fingers.
Lesley gave a speech about trust to Layla, Fanny, Ruby and Angela in their combat suits, in the hall under the five great stars.
On its last words Guinevere waved at Vexana with her whole arm, and afterward towed her out by the sleeve.

Lesley declared Ruby and Angela Aspirants as of that day, said the four stand together, and spoke of trusting each other to gain limitless strength; at dawn she had rehearsed it under her breath, twice. On the last words Guinevere waved at Vexana by the door with her whole arm, and Layla answered her wave with two fingers. Afterward Guinevere towed Vexana out by the sleeve.

entries.name: the death of Vexana's father
aka: the attack on the wall houses
the stand in the street by the wall
the attack on the Shield houses

facts.t: One evening the bell rang while the tea was stewing, and every gun on the city wall began to fire at once.
Vexana's father carried her to the shelter himself, told her to stay back and ran to his gun.
The all-clear did not sound, and her father did not come.
Vexana slipped out of the shelter and ran through the smoke toward the wall stair.
An Ender that had come over the wall stepped out of a side lane a few steps from her.
Her father came down the stair and stood between her and the Ender.
A soldier carried Vexana away while her father stayed, and the smoke closed over him.
Behind them the wall guns kept firing, but her father's gun stayed quiet.
A soldier later said the Ender never got past her father while he stood.
Her father was recorded as killed in action.
The shelter by the wall shook with every blast; Vexana slipped out to find her father, and an Ender found her first.
He turned back from his gun and stood between them.
His last words to her were "Stay back."
A soldier carried her off while her father stayed; her hands closed into fists.
Since that day Vexana has wished it had been her instead.
A soldier said the Ender never got past him while he stood.
Vexana's father once stood in a street by the wall with one Ender in front of him and his daughter behind.
A soldier told Vexana at her cot that the Ender never got past him, not while he stood.
Vexana says her ignorance and foolishness led to her father's death, and that he died saving her.
She says he told her to stay back at the shelter door; she did not, so he came back for her.

Her father came down the stair and stood between them, and a soldier carried her away while he stayed. His gun went quiet, and he was recorded as killed in action; a soldier said the Ender never got past him while he stood. Vexana blames her own foolishness, and has wished ever since it had been her instead.

entries.name: the defense of the bay road cut

facts.t: Lesley orders the powerless frontline to pull back into the cut and hold it.
Fanny builds the wall with one gap.
They hold the street for minutes.
Soldiers and Aspirants strike on Layla's count.
After the field dies they fight on, giants on the road, drones high, cannon and blades from the heap.
The Enders keep coming up out of the water.

entries.summary: When the frontline lost its power, Lesley ordered it back into the bay road cut and told it to hold. Fanny built a wall across the street with one gap, so the Enders had to come through one at a time. Soldiers and Aspirants struck on Layla's count, and they held the street for minutes. After the field died they fought on: Vexana's giants on the road, Guinevere's drones high, Fanny's blades and Layla's cannon from the heap. The Enders kept coming up out of the water.

entries.name: the destruction of the Storm Citadel

facts.t: After Selena cuts the throne, explosions go off deep in the ship and it tilts.
Its storm thins, it sinks, and the wind carries it back out over the bay.
It drifts into the mouth and blows up inside, and light tears across the portal.
Nothing of it comes down on the city.
From above, Selena sees it drawn into the dark and burst.

entries.short: After Selena cuts the throne, explosions go off deep in the Storm Citadel and the whole ship tilts.
entries.summary: After Selena cut the throne, explosions went off deep in the Storm Citadel and it tilted. Its storm thinned, it sank, and the wind carried it back out over the bay. It drifted into the mouth and blew up inside, and light tore across the portal. Nothing of it came down on the city. From above, Selena saw it drawn into the dark and burst.

entries.name: the duel in the throne hall
aka: the duel of Selena and Obsidia

facts.t: Selena's face makes a declaration of war on her maker.
Obsidia keeps Selena at her weapon's length and drives her up the stairs.
Selena cuts the throne instead of taking it.
From the street, two lights are seen meeting and breaking apart in the burning hull.
Vexana does not know who is winning.
The two lights leave the hull and climb into the sky over the bay.
Selena cuts Obsidia's cheek.
Obsidia's weapon goes through Selena's side.
Selena is blasted out of the Citadel and Obsidia follows.
The stretch ends with Selena charging Obsidia's open arms; the outcome is not told.
