entries.short: In the throne hall Selena turns on her maker. Obsidia keeps her at her weapon's length and drives her up the stairs.
entries.summary: In the throne hall Selena's face made a declaration of war on her maker. Obsidia kept her at her weapon's length and drove her up the stairs, and Selena cut the throne instead of taking it. Selena cut Obsidia's cheek. Obsidia's weapon went through Selena's side, and a point-blank shot blasted Selena out of the Citadel; Obsidia followed. From the street two lights were seen meeting in the burning hull, then climbing into the sky over the bay. It ends with Selena charging Obsidia's open arms. The book does not tell who wins.

entries.name: the dusk raid

facts.t: The first raid Lesley saw: three Enders walked out of the grass at dusk, taller than the wall, and rounds sparked off them.
A gunner shot one through its open core and the other two drew back.
From it Lesley learned that an Ender's chest opens only when it hits.

entries.name: the escape from Oro

facts.t: Ruby and Angela are charged with treason against Oro and locked up to await the Council's sentence.
Angela pries the cell door's seam open and plugs her wrist into the lock's wires.
Ruby's code runs down Angela's arm and the lock clicks.
An alarm rings through the facility as they slip out.
Ruby's father tells the Council 'All normal.'
He stops the alarm with his hand on the panel.
Angela counts the alarm; at eleven it stops, and no boots come.
They retrace the turns to the empty launch bay, Ruby takes her scythe and her code opens the bay doors.
Their ship rises and leaves Oro behind.
Ruby wonders why the alarm stopped.

entries.line: Ruby and Angela's breakout from their cell on Oro.
entries.short: Charged with treason against Oro, Ruby and Angela break out of their cell, reach the launch bay and leave Oro behind in their ship.
entries.summary: Charged with treason against Oro, Ruby and Angela were locked up to await the Council's sentence. Angela pried the cell door's seam open and plugged her wrist into the lock's wires, and Ruby's code ran down her arm until the lock clicked. An alarm rang as they slipped out, but Ruby's father told the Council "All normal" and stopped it with his hand on the panel; Angela counted to eleven, and no boots came. At the empty launch bay Ruby took her scythe, her code opened the doors, and their ship left Oro behind. Ruby wonders why the alarm stopped.

entries.name: the fall of the research base

facts.t: On the evening of the first light the alarm sounds and half the city is burning.
Small flying craft attack the base's grounds and set the storehouse on fire.
A giant Ender walks through the middle of the city.
Its light kills Chang'e's parents as they stand between it and her.
Swarms of Enders hold the Shield at the city's edge.
Lesley calls it a decoy: the edge is held so the giant can walk in.
The giant fires on the base's yard and walks away.
Lesley arrives minutes late and saves Chang'e from an Ender at the crater.
Nobody finds out why the giant went for the base.
It happens in Terrinia, the year the base fell. The sirens go and Karina leaves.
Half the city burns, the far half where the research base stands.
A black and gold giant, taller than the towers, walks through the fire.
A white light opens in the giant's chest, a street far off goes white, then dark.
Years after the fall, scaffolds go up on the base's ruins.
Since that night Lesley carried the words of her vow to keep Chang'e safe.

The giant's light killed Chang'e's parents as they stood between it and her, and it fired on the base's yard and walked away. Lesley arrived minutes late and saved Chang'e from an Ender at the crater. Nobody ever found out why the giant went for the base. Years later scaffolds went up on its ruins.

entries.name: the falling rack

facts.t: For weeks Chang'e followed Lesley's rounds, lately hiding as if waiting to be looked for.
Hiding, Chang'e bumps the shelving.
The strap snaps.
Lesley catches a fistful of Chang'e's coat and pulls her clear of a rack taller than Lesley.
Chang'e holds Lesley's arm and calls her Sis.
Lesley does not pull her arm away.

entries.line: The day Lesley pulls Chang'e clear of a falling rack.
entries.short: Hiding from Lesley, Chang'e bumps the shelving and a strap snaps. Lesley pulls her clear of a falling rack, and Chang'e calls her Sis.
entries.summary: For weeks Chang'e followed Lesley's rounds, lately hiding as if waiting to be looked for. One day, hiding, she bumped the shelving and the strap snapped. Lesley caught a fistful of her coat and pulled her clear of a rack taller than Lesley. Chang'e held Lesley's arm and called her Sis, and Lesley did not pull her arm away.

entries.name: the fight over the gap

facts.t: Wings of aspirant power open on both of them and they rise at each other.
Light bursts white and gold between them.
Guinevere falls, her wings gone out.
Falling, she says, "Don't let me be alone in this world."
Vexana turned her staff aside at the last meter.
Guinevere's hand was open, never a fist, and the staff went past her ear. They passed so close their wings brushed.
No blow landed on either of them.
Vexana dived, opened a door of the void under Guinevere and caught her wrist.
She laid Guinevere behind a low wall three streets west.
Guinevere realizes later that Vexana missed on purpose.

facts.t: Obsidia had planned to go in herself once the mouth was clear if the body failed.

Enders drop over the bay by the hundred.
They come down on the waterfront, the bay road, the wards and inland towers near the dome's edge.

The Storm Citadel comes down over the Academy.
Lesley thinks of it as the second front.

entries.name: the first entrance assessment

facts.t: Lesley walks the children's homes with stamped sheets and tells the children she chooses to come.

Past the line goes to the Combat Division's preparatory course, short of it to the Support Division; no name goes on a list before the queue is done.
One boy runs back to the gate before his needle settles.
The Combat Division's first intake lists Layla, Guinevere of House Baroque and Vexana.
It tests children Guinevere's age for aspirant power, and nobody can buy a pass.
Children go in with bags over their shoulders; Guinevere's guard detail cannot follow her inside.
On its morning Vexana walked across the city to it alone, her toolbox in a cloth bag.
About a hundred children queued the length of the Academy yard.
Each child put a hand in a glove wired to a dial that read aspirant power, and Chang'e read the needle.
Some children snatched their hands back at the hum, and one boy ran back toward the gate.
Layla's needle hit the stop.
A needle past the line sent a child through the far door to the Combat Division's preparatory course; the rest went left to the Support Division.
Lesley asked each passing child for a name and a reason for being there.
Guinevere rode to the gate in the long car on its morning.
The gate clanged shut behind her, and she turned to find Hester through the bars.

The count passes a hundred, two hundred and six, two hundred and forty-one, three hundred.
The frame hums for the first time.
The light does not shake; it holds.
The family plans to repeat it the next days, and then for Lesley.
Lesley, still away, guesses it came without her or is coming that night.
The notebook records it: held past three hundred, no shaking, C.'s hand on the plate.
Chang'e wants the Academy built where the first light was.

entries.summary: The first light is the moment the light in the frame's core held for good. Chang'e kept her palm on the copper plate while her mother counted past three hundred. The light did not shake, and the frame hummed for the first time. Lesley was away and missed it. Her mother's notebook records it on its last page, and later Chang'e wanted the Academy built where it happened.

entries.name: the fish-market raid

facts.t: It is the only time Guinevere has talked to Layla.
It is a raid on a shore ward, weeks before the ceremony.
Joe sends the Layla-Fanny Team west and Guinevere and Vexana east.
Enders drop through a tear in the dome over the stalls.
Around the thirtieth minute Guinevere's wings go out, and Vexana catches her.
After the last Ender falls a medic tapes Guinevere's wrist, and one drone is found broken.
Guinevere blamed a crosswind for her fall on a roof in it, but Vexana knew there was no wind on that roof.
One of Guinevere's drones was damaged in it, a cat ear bent flat and the bracket under it twisted.
On the night after it the drone lay open under Vexana's lamp, beside her phone.
Guinevere calls her fall that day a lady's refinement.
Weeks passed after it before the newcomers became Aspirants.
Since the fish market, Vexana has kept a step nearer Guinevere's back.

entries.line: A raid on a shore ward, where the dome tore over the fish stalls.
entries.short: A raid on the fish market, weeks before the newcomers became Aspirants. Enders drop through a tear in the dome over the stalls.
entries.summary: A raid on a shore ward, weeks before the newcomers became Aspirants. Professor Joe sent the Layla-Fanny Team to the west end and Guinevere and Vexana to the east, and Enders dropped through a tear in the dome over the stalls. Around the thirtieth minute Guinevere's wings went out on a roof, and Vexana caught her. Guinevere blamed a crosswind, but there was no wind on that roof. One of her drones came back broken. Ever since, Vexana has kept a step nearer Guinevere's back.

entries.name: the founding of Selrick Academy

facts.t: On a bright morning the old gate opens under the name SELRICK ACADEMY.
Lesley becomes Chief Combat Instructor and Chang'e director of the Science Division.
The instructors fly suits in a line over the gate, the crowd and the roofs toward the water.
People cheer along the fence.
Lesley salutes Chang'e; Chang'e salutes back with the wrong hand.
From the House on the hill Guinevere sees the figures cross the sky on wings of light.
Guards shouted in the yard of the House; Guinevere ran out onto the terrace and saw people flying over the hill on wings of light toward the water.
She pointed with her arm straight up and said "That."
A new hall rises on the base's ruins, with the name Selrick Academy over its gate.
On the bright morning it opens, Selena is at the fence.
Figures in suits rise on wings of light, fly in a line over the city and turn toward the water.
No suit had flown over the city before that day.
People cheer.
Since the founding a caramel pudding cup has turned up outside Chang'e's lab door after every long night.

rows: The old gate of the research base, Terrinia
Lesley, Chief Combat Instructor; Chang'e, director of the Science Division
Guinevere from the House on the hill, Selena at the fence

rel.t: The Academy's opening.
It was the day the Academy opened.
The day it opened.

entries.line: The bright morning the Academy first opened its gate.
entries.short: The morning Selrick Academy opens. Its instructors fly over the city in suits on wings of light, and the crowd cheers.
entries.summary: On a bright morning the old gate opened under the name Selrick Academy, on the ruins of the research base. Lesley became Chief Combat Instructor and Chang'e director of the Science Division. The instructors flew suits in a line over the city on wings of light. No suit had flown over it before, and people cheered along the fence. Lesley saluted Chang'e, and Chang'e saluted back with the wrong hand. Young Guinevere watched from the House on the hill, and Selena from the fence.

entries.name: the Guard's block

facts.t: The Mother Matrix fires at Guinevere behind the wall.
A machine of purple plate edged in gold drops between the wall and the light with its arms up.
It holds while the beam melts the road to glass on either side.
Chang'e says it is not one of the Enders'.
It spent all of Vexana's belief on one block.
Vexana thinks: it held, and that was enough.
Guinevere half remembers a back between her and the glare, and metal shrieking.
Guinevere tells the others a machine took the Matrix's shot for her.

rows: A street west of the platforms
entries.line: A purple and gold machine takes the Mother Matrix's shot for Guinevere.
entries.short: A machine of purple plate edged in gold drops between Guinevere and the Mother Matrix's beam, and holds. Chang'e says it is not the Enders'.
entries.summary: When the Mother Matrix fired at Guinevere behind a low wall, a machine of purple plate edged in gold dropped in front of the light with its arms up. It held while the beam melted the road to glass on either side. It was Vexana's Guard, and she was inside it. It ran on her belief and spent all of it on that one block, and fire through its seams burned her left arm. Guinevere only half remembers a back between her and the glare.

entries.name: the landing in Terrinia
aka: the day the black ships landed

facts.t: Ruby's trojan is set to wake on the Dawnbreak mission.
The orders are 'Planet Dawnbreak. Save the Rioters and restore balance.'
In the evening Terrinia burns. A giant Ender stands over the roofs while Oro's black ship lets its androids out onto a street.
The androids strike at Selrick students, and students fall.
Ruby's ship comes down in the middle of a burning avenue.
Ruby tears the control unit out of Angela's back.
Ruby, in a rage, cuts down the whole android company.
Angela saves the child in the barrel from Ruby's scythe.
Ruby and Angela bring down a giant Ender together.
Oro's soldiers arrest Ruby and Angela, who go quietly so the street is not burned further.
In the same battle Fanny and Layla hold a ward on the far side of the city against a giant.
Selrick's record shows androids walking out of a hatch and a tower splitting under their fire.
Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front beside Lesley's squads until dark.

rel.t: Ruby calls the androids the start of the Council's plan.
The day the ships came.

entries.line: Oro's mission to Planet Dawnbreak and its landing in Terrinia.
entries.short: Oro's mission to Planet Dawnbreak. The orders: save the Rioters and restore balance. Ruby's trojan is set to wake during it.
entries.summary: Oro sent its android company to Planet Dawnbreak with orders to save the Rioters and restore balance. That evening Terrinia burned. A giant Ender stood over the roofs while a black ship let the androids out, and they struck at Selrick students. Ruby tore the control unit out of Angela's back and cut down the whole company, and the two brought down a giant together. Then Oro's soldiers arrested them, and they went quietly so the street would not burn more. Across the city, Layla, Fanny, Guinevere and Vexana held the line against the giants.

entries.name: the late-night calls

facts.t: Guinevere had not answered "I'm asleep" since the first night.
On the eve of the attack the hour of the call comes and goes.
On late nights Guinevere bargained: "Ten more." Vexana said, "Go to bed." Guinevere said, "Five. You can count them."
Vexana still knows the phone number by heart, in gold ink, underlined twice: For emergencies. Or anything.
To Vexana, "Go to bed" means goodnight and promises another night.
Every night, late, Vexana's voice came down the phone to tell Guinevere "Go to bed."

entries.line: Vexana's late phone calls telling Guinevere to go to bed.
entries.short: Vexana's late-night phone calls to Guinevere, telling her to go to bed.
entries.summary: Every night, late, Vexana phoned Guinevere to tell her to go to bed. Guinevere bargained, "Ten more," then "Five. You can count them." She answered "I'm asleep" on the first night, and not again until the night she said it from the training hall. To Vexana the words meant goodnight, and the promise of another night. After Vexana was taken the calls stopped. Vexana still knows Guinevere's number by heart, written in gold ink and underlined twice: For emergencies. Or anything.

entries.name: the Mother Matrix's attack

facts.t: The Singularity tears open over the bay and the morning goes dark as dusk.
The alarm goes up through the tower and sirens answer in every ward.
Enders come through purple portals inside the dome. Until then an army had to claw its way in from outside.
Every Ender turns inland for the Academy's wards.
Vexana brings the first wave down on the emptied waterfront warehouses.
The Mother Matrix comes halfway through the sky over the platforms.
Nearly half the city is rubble.
The Mother Matrix steps out whole.
Struck in the chest, the Matrix staggers back into the light at the star's edge.
The waterfront roofs still smoke from it.
Rescue lamps move through the wards it hit.

entries.line: The Mother Matrix's attack on Terrinia through the Singularity.
entries.short: The Singularity tears open over the bay. Enders pour through purple portals inside the dome and turn inland for the Academy.
entries.summary: The morning the Singularity tore open over the bay, the sky went dark as dusk and sirens rang in every ward. For the first time Enders came through purple portals inside the dome, instead of clawing in from outside, and they turned inland for the Academy's wards. The Mother Matrix itself came halfway through the sky over the platforms, then stepped out whole, and nearly half the city fell to rubble. Struck in the chest, it staggered back into the light at the star's edge.

entries.name: the newcomers' arrival
aka: the landing at the cleared lot

facts.t: A siren warns of an unknown craft descending at the city's edge.
The gate portal drops Fanny and Layla at a cleared lot by the dome's foot, where soldiers, Guinevere, Vexana and Lesley are waiting.
A black ship lands and Ruby and Angela walk down its ramp.
Fanny vouches for them.
Ruby asks Selrick for refuge.
Lesley lets them in under watch.
Chang'e sets four conditions.
Ruby accepts the conditions.
Days after the black ships landed, the gate portal dropped Guinevere and Vexana at a cleared lot by the dome's foot, at the end of a line of soldiers.
A black ship settled on the dirt and two girls came down its ramp; the one with the scythe planted it and bowed.
The girl called herself an heir.

rows: A cleared lot by the dome's foot
Days after the black ships landed

rel.t: It happened at the cleared lot.

entries.line: Ruby and Angela come down a black ship's ramp and ask Selrick for refuge.
entries.short: A black ship lands by the dome's foot, and Ruby and Angela walk down its ramp. Ruby asks Selrick for refuge.
entries.summary: A siren warned of an unknown craft coming down at the city's edge. The gate portal dropped Fanny and Layla at a cleared lot by the dome's foot, where soldiers, Guinevere, Vexana and Lesley waited. A black ship landed, and Ruby and Angela walked down its ramp. Ruby planted her scythe, bowed and called herself an heir. Fanny vouched for them, and Ruby asked Selrick for refuge. Lesley let them in under watch, and Ruby accepted Chang'e's four conditions.

entries.name: the night the Enders came back

facts.t: After a long quiet the Enders return at night, with fires across the city and sirens.
Chang'e holds the seawall shelter's doors alone.
Lesley draws an Ender off her from the lit tower window.
Mr. Bunny fights as a giant machine.
Lesley and Chang'e bring down a giant together.
They bring down two more big ones before dawn.
Later the Academy calls the two of them the First Aspirants.
Chang'e's crescents fly farther that night with Lesley at her back.
That night on the avenue Chang'e turned and looked straight up at Lesley's window.

entries.line: The night the Enders return after a long quiet, with fires across the city.
entries.short: After a long quiet the Enders come back at night. Fires burn across the city, and sirens sound.
entries.summary: After a long quiet the Enders came back at night, with fires across the city. Chang'e held the doors of the seawall shelter alone, and Mr. Bunny fought as a giant machine. Lesley drew an Ender off her from a lit tower window, and Chang'e looked straight up at that window. Together they brought down a giant, then two more big ones before dawn, and Chang'e's crescents flew farther with Lesley at her back. The Academy later calls the two of them the First Aspirants.

entries.name: the Northeastern sector breach
aka: the attack on the Northeastern sector
the Ender army's breach of the dome

facts.t: A boom shakes the hall, and Joe says the lull is over.
Ultra Enders attack the dome over the Northeastern sector and rip a breach eight meters by two. Every tutor is called through the gate portal.
Joe is struck down by a falling slab while shielding a little girl.
Layla kills the Ender at the breach with one shot through the billboard.
It is the first time Layla and Fanny join forces, and they find they work together well.
Guinevere and Vexana hold the other end of the wall.
A gold giant stands up outside and breaks the dome apart in a ring.
Layla and Fanny destroy the giant together.
They fight back to back in the open, no longer counting kills.
At sunset the swarm draws back. Most of it is still out there.
Ash lies over the avenue, and coats cover some of the shapes along the wall.
Layla's log calls the night before it "the night before the breach."
The breach took four instructors off the field roster.
An army of Enders tore a hole in the humans' dome.
Young humans in suits closed on the hole from every side and destroyed the army; more cores broke than Obsidia had ever felt at once.
Soon after, the pulse changed.
Obsidia says so many Enders broken at once by human hands, at a breach in the dome, is the step that brings the body down.
Vexana remembers the torn shell of the dome in the Northeastern sector, with Guinevere below her, fists up, drones circling.
They held their end until the last Ender fell, and the city won.
Vexana thinks the crack opened after that win.
Black Enders came out of an orange sky into the breach. Selena watched from the bell tower.
Layla's cannon flashed at one end and Fanny swung on a cable, blades lit. At the other, Guinevere punched Enders out of the air while Vexana's staff guarded her back.
Selena told herself it was research, and stayed until the last Ender fell.
Layla thinks Fanny's idea of covering came from it.
On its day a slab came down on Joe on the avenue.

rows: Four instructors off the field roster, Professor Joe among the hurt

rel.t: It happens in the Northeastern sector.
It tore a hole in the dome.
It tore the dome in the Northeastern sector.

entries.line: The Ender attack that tore the dome over the Northeastern sector.
entries.short: Ultra Enders rip a breach eight meters by two in the dome over the Northeastern sector. Every tutor is called through the gate portal.
entries.summary: Ultra Enders ripped a breach in the dome over the Northeastern sector, and every tutor went through the gate portal. A falling slab struck Professor Joe down as he shielded a little girl. Layla killed the Ender at the breach with one shot, and she and Fanny joined forces for the first time, while Guinevere and Vexana held the other end of the wall. When a gold giant broke the dome in a ring, Layla and Fanny destroyed it together. At sunset the swarm drew back. Obsidia says so many Enders broken at once by human hands is the step that brings the Mother Matrix down.

entries.name: the one-arm match

facts.t: Guinevere calls for it after finding Vexana's hidden wound.
They fight one arm each at night under the center lamp of the training hall.
Each trips the other in the same moment and they land side by side.
It ends in a draw, so both make the rule.
Once in sparring Guinevere caught Vexana's wrist and found a bandage with blood on it under the glove. Vexana had told no one.
Vexana said only, "It was mine to carry."

rel.t: It is fought in the training hall.

entries.line: A night match, one arm each, between Guinevere and Vexana.
entries.short: Guinevere's challenge after she finds a wound Vexana hid. They fight one arm each, at night, in the training hall.
entries.summary: Sparring, Guinevere caught Vexana's wrist and found a bandage with blood on it under the glove. Vexana had told no one. That night, under the center lamp of the empty training hall, they fought one arm each. If Guinevere won, Vexana would tell her first, every cut. Each hooked the other's ankle in the same moment, they landed side by side, and Vexana laughed. It was a draw, so both made the rule: partners tell each other first.

entries.name: the promise on the roof

facts.t: Guinevere asked Vexana to the roof at noon in a one-line plan.
There she gave Vexana one of the two Emblems of Hope she had made.
The stars began to glow when the two made peace.
Guinevere took a photo of them both with the stars lit.
Guinevere said "We protect this world. The two of us." and Vexana answered "A promise."
Guinevere reminds Vexana, "We made a promise to protect this world."
On a city roof with green guardrails Guinevere held out two gold stars she had made herself.
She took a phone photo of the two of them, a gold star glowing at each collar.
She said, "We protect this world. The two of us," and Vexana said, "A promise."

rows: A city roof with green guardrails
One of the two Emblems of Hope

rel.t: It happened on the dormitory roof.

entries.line: Guinevere and Vexana's promise, on a city roof, to protect this world.
entries.short: On a city roof Guinevere gives Vexana one of two gold stars she made. They promise to protect this world, the two of them.
entries.summary: After their quarrel Guinevere asked Vexana to a city roof at noon, in a one-line plan. There she gave her one of the two Emblems of Hope she had made herself. When the two made peace, the stars began to glow, and Guinevere took a phone photo of them both, a gold star lit at each collar. She said, "We protect this world. The two of us," and Vexana answered, "A promise." On the platforms, long after, Guinevere reminds Vexana of it.

entries.name: the quarrel over the gifts

facts.t: Guinevere found the returned bags and the note at her door.
Vexana told her "I am not something you buy."
Guinevere took back the bags and shut her door all the way.
All the next day she loudly did not speak to Vexana.
On the roof Vexana admitted her word had been a lie in her mouth too.

entries.line: Guinevere and Vexana's fight over the shopping bags.
entries.short: Vexana returns all the shopping bags with a note, and Guinevere takes it badly. Vexana tells her, "I am not something you buy."
entries.summary: Before dawn after the shopping trip, Vexana left every bag at Guinevere's door with a note: I cannot repay this. Guinevere called it a present. Vexana told her, "I am not something you buy." Guinevere's father answered everything with money, and that word had been used against her before. She took the bags back, shut her door all the way, and all the next day loudly did not speak to Vexana. On the roof Vexana admitted the word had been a lie in her mouth too.

entries.name: the raid at the dome's foot

facts.t: On the third day after Team-Up Day a siren sent the reserve to the dome's foot, where Enders were climbing through a split in the dome.
The singles were sent to the side streets with the order that nobody goes alone.
Guinevere ran alone up the side street that led to the split.
A claw from a doorway raked her right arm.
Vexana, who had followed a street back, reached her and held out her hand.
They fought back to back until the street held.
The pairs came up from the main road after the last Ender lay still.

rows: A side street at the dome's foot

rel.t: It was fought at the dome's foot.

entries.line: The reserve's fight at a split in the dome, three days after Team-Up Day.
entries.short: Three days after Team-Up Day, Enders climb through a split at the dome's foot, and the reserve is sent to stop them.
entries.summary: On the third day after Team-Up Day a siren sent the reserve to the dome's foot, where Enders were climbing through a split. The singles went to the side streets with one order: nobody goes alone. Guinevere ran alone up the street that led to the split, and a claw from a doorway raked her right arm. Vexana had followed a street back. She reached her and held out her hand, and they fought back to back until the street held.

entries.name: the raid of Selena's childhood

facts.t: It came at night, in rain, with Karina on shift. The whole block went down the stairs toward the shelter.
Something hit two streets over, the line broke, and the hand holding Selena's let go.
Alone in a side street, Selena met an Ender coming round the corner.
The Ender looked at her for one breath, then walked on past.
A window shard opened her forearm, and fine purple threads drew the cut shut.

rel.t: A raid on the city.

entries.line: A night raid in the rain when Selena was small.
entries.short: A raid on Selena's block when she was small. Lost from the shelter line in the rain, she meets an Ender, and it walks past her.
entries.summary: It came at night, in rain, while Karina was on shift. The whole block went down the stairs toward the shelter. Then something hit two streets over, the line broke, and the hand holding Selena's let go. Alone in a side street, she met an Ender coming round the corner. It looked at her for one breath, then walked on past. A window shard opened her forearm, and fine purple threads drew the cut shut.

entries.name: the rail yard shot

facts.t: Three Enders walk into the old rail yard, and a squad goes to ground behind a wagon.
Lesley moves her sight off the middle of the Ender's core to its edge.
A piece of the core splits away whole before the burn reaches it.
Nobody had thought it could be done.
Afterward Shield officers know Lesley by it.

rel.t: It happens at the rail yard.

entries.line: Lesley's shot that split a piece of an Ender's core away whole.
entries.short: At the old rail yard Lesley aims at the edge of an Ender's core, not its middle, and a piece of it splits away whole.
entries.summary: Three Enders walked into the old rail yard, and a squad went to ground behind a wagon. Lesley moved her sight off the middle of an Ender's core to its edge. A piece of the core split away whole before the burn reached it. Nobody had thought it could be done, and afterward Shield officers knew Lesley by that shot.

entries.name: the rebuilding

facts.t: On the fifth day of the rebuilding, Fanny and Layla carry panels up the scaffold of a ruined building in the Northeastern sector.
A crew radio says the next block is clear: nobody left to dig out.
As the shift ends, Layla asks Fanny to meet her at midnight.

rel.t: It happens in the Northeastern sector.

entries.line: The repair of the Northeastern sector after the Ender broke in.
entries.short: The work to repair the Northeastern sector. Fanny and Layla carry panels up a scaffold together.
entries.summary: After the attack on the Northeastern sector, crews rebuilt it. On the fifth day of the rebuilding, Fanny and Layla carried panels up the scaffold of a ruined building, Layla taking the other end of every one. A crew radio said the next block was clear, with nobody left to dig out, and Layla's hands stopped. As the shift ended, she asked Fanny to meet her at midnight.

entries.name: the rescue operation

facts.t: Layla marks weak points in green on her tablet and says the rescue operation is ready to go.
Lesley sends the frontline on Layla's plan, with rear support on their heels.
Fanny tells Layla to lead.
Lesley tells Layla where Guinevere is and to get to her if she can.
The team could not break through to her.

entries.line: Layla's plan to reach Guinevere through the Enders.
entries.short: Layla's plan to reach Guinevere, who has flown at the Singularity. Layla marks the Enders' weak points in green on her tablet.
entries.summary: When Guinevere flew straight at the Singularity, Layla marked the weak points in the Enders' lines in green on her tablet and said the rescue operation was ready to go. Lesley sent the frontline on Layla's plan, with rear support on their heels, and Fanny dropped her own order and told Layla to lead. Lesley told Layla where Guinevere was and to get to her if she could. The team could not break through to her.

entries.name: the return from the black hole

facts.t: Warmth comes back into Guinevere, and her hands return.
The two stars flare together, gold and violet, and their light pierces the void.
Two lights, gold and violet, shoot out of the Singularity's center.
They rise over the Matrix's crown and come down at its chest together from the city's side.
The Mother Matrix goes slowly back into the star.
Layla counts twelve seconds.
Chang'e says no reading had ever come back out of a black hole before.
The body gives way before the two lights.

rows: The black hole at the Singularity's center
entries.line: Guinevere and Vexana come back out of the black hole as two lights.
entries.short: Inside the black hole Guinevere's warmth and hands come back. The two stars flare gold and violet, and their light pierces the void.
entries.summary: After their strike the black point took Guinevere and Vexana. Inside it, warmth came back into Guinevere and her hands returned. Their two stars flared together, gold and violet, and the light pierced the void. Two lights shot out of the Singularity's center, rose over the Matrix's crown and came down at its chest together from the city's side. The body gave way, and the Mother Matrix went slowly back into the star. Every suit's power climbed again, and Chang'e says no reading had ever come back out of a black hole before.

entries.name: the reunion on the platform

facts.t: Guinevere crouches and holds out her hand, palm up.
She says, "Stay with me, Vexana."
Vexana takes the hand with her burned hand and does not let go.
Guinevere says, "As long as we're together!"
Layla lowers her cannon: "It's not a trap."
Vexana cries "Hope never dies!"
Everyone, Fanny too, says "The Aspirants always stand united!"
The two rise side by side toward the crowned head.

rows: The city platforms, above the bay
entries.line: Guinevere and Vexana join hands again on the platform.
entries.short: On the platform Guinevere holds out her hand and asks Vexana to stay with her. Vexana takes it with her burned hand.
entries.summary: Vexana told Guinevere she had seen the end that awaits them. Guinevere crouched and held out her hand, palm up. "Stay with me, Vexana," she said, and Vexana took it with her burned hand and did not let go. Layla lowered her cannon: "It's not a trap." Vexana cried "Hope never dies!" and everyone, Fanny too, answered "The Aspirants always stand united!" Then the two rose side by side toward the Mother Matrix's crowned head.

entries.name: the rooftop talk

facts.t: On a ruined roof the night of the battle, Layla admits Fanny has skill.
Fanny tells Layla about her elder brother, Tigreal.
Layla understands that Fanny was never looking down on her, only past her at her brother.
Layla proposes they get back to training together.
They say together that they must get stronger, because they are the protectors of all humanity.
Every session since the rooftop opens with the sergeants' line.

rel.t: It takes place on the ruined rooftop.

entries.line: Layla and Fanny's talk on a ruined roof the night of the battle.
entries.short: On a ruined roof after the battle, Fanny tells Layla about her elder brother Tigreal, and the two agree to train together again.
entries.summary: On a ruined roof the night of the battle, Layla admitted that Fanny has skill. Fanny told her about her elder brother, Tigreal. Layla understood that Fanny had never looked down on her, only past her at her brother. Layla proposed they train together again, and they said together that they must get stronger, because they are the protectors of all humanity. Every session since opens with the sergeants' line: "There is no place for mercy on the battlefield."

entries.name: the Science Division entry

facts.t: Chang'e tells Selena the Science Division takes its entry next week.
Getting in is like a children's game to Selena. She finishes the paper early and draws a four-legged machine with a long tail on its back.
Her empty family-name box glows red on the form.
Nobody says anything. The examiner calls the next name.
The result is Science Division.
On her first day the family-name box is green. She never learns who cleared it.

entries.line: Selena's entry test for the Academy's Science Division.
entries.short: Selena's entry test for the Science Division. It is like a children's game to her, but the family-name box on her form is empty.
entries.summary: Chang'e told Selena the Science Division took its entry the next week. To Selena the test was like a children's game. She finished early and drew a four-legged machine with a long tail on the back of the paper. Her empty family-name box glowed red on the form, but nobody said anything, and the examiner called the next name. The result was Science Division. On her first day the box was green, and she never learned who cleared it.

entries.name: the search for Vexana

facts.t: Through it Guinevere said at the long table and in the counseling room that Vexana was alive.
Angela said at the long table, "I came back once. People come back."
All through it the Emblem stayed lit.
The night no call came, Guinevere called Vexana's number out of habit and found the box in her room.
Every morning of the search Guinevere touched her star with two fingers.
For weeks the lit star was her only proof Vexana was alive.

entries.line: The weeks Guinevere kept saying Vexana was alive.
entries.short: The weeks after Vexana goes missing. At the long table and in the counseling room, Guinevere says Vexana is alive.
entries.summary: All through the weeks Vexana was missing, Guinevere said at the long table and in the counseling room that she was alive. Every morning she touched her star with two fingers. It stayed lit the whole time, and for weeks it was her only proof. Angela told the table, "I came back once. People come back." On the night no call came, Guinevere had called Vexana's number out of habit and followed the ring to the box in her room.

entries.name: the seawall raid

facts.t: The fifth raid in nine days, fought in a street of shut shops by the seawall.
Since the newcomers came, the raids have grown fiercer and come nearer the Academy's waterfront.
Vexana takes a claw on her left arm for Guinevere.
Guinevere calls "Did you get it?" without turning round.

Vexana took a claw on her left arm for Guinevere, who called "Did you get it?" without turning round. Vexana dressed the cut herself and hid it for four days, until Guinevere found it and called for the one-arm match.

entries.name: the shopping trip

Two House guards followed them.
Guinevere paid for everything with her black card.
Vexana secretly bought pink and black felt with her own stipend.
Before dawn Vexana left all the bags at Guinevere's door with a note.

entries.name: the siren in the third week

facts.t: In the cadets' third week the sirens went for real, with Enders loose in a far ward.
The instructors herded the cadets into a concrete shelter, and nobody was to leave.
Everyone crowded the window slits except Vexana, who sat still on the bench by the door.
Vexana was the last one out at the all-clear.

entries.line: The cadets' first real siren at the Academy.
entries.short: In the cadets' third week the sirens go for real, and the instructors herd them into a concrete shelter.
entries.summary: In the cadets' third week at the Academy, the sirens went for real: Enders were loose in a far ward. The instructors herded the cadets into a concrete shelter with slits for windows, and nobody was to leave. Everyone crowded to the slits except Vexana, who sat still on the bench by the door with her eyes on it. At the all-clear she was the last one out.

entries.name: the small light in the void

facts.t: Far off in the dark, past the body, burns one small light.
It is not an Ender's; Obsidia knows its kind from every Ender that ever died of it.
It burns in the void, and nothing is dying.
Obsidia marks the place and sends nothing of it up the line.

rows: The void, past the Will's body

rel.t: It burns in the void.

entries.line: A lone light Obsidia sees far off in the void.
entries.short: A small light Obsidia sees far off in the void. It is not an Ender's, and nothing is dying there. She tells no one.
entries.summary: As the Storm Citadel's crossing ended, Obsidia saw one small light far off in the dark, past the body. It was not an Ender's. She knew its kind: she had felt it in every Ender that ever died of it. But here it burned in the void, and nothing was dying. She marked the place and sent nothing of it up the line. Later, in Vexana's hidden hollow, Obsidia says she marked that fold the night her ship came through.

entries.name: the storm night of 983
aka: the night the roof came down

facts.t: In 983, by the prologue's heading, the city's lights go out one street at a time.
The Storm Citadel's violet storm kills every human machine it reaches.
The strike comes after midnight while the humans sleep. Most of the dead wear nightclothes.
Obsidia's Enders walk the ruins.
Obsidia lays the child she made on the scorched ground.
Survivors are laid under a tarp between two broken walls.
When the Storm Citadel leaves, the street lamps flicker back on.
Chapter 1's heading sets the Academy story fourteen years after this night.
Lesley's memory of her home and of the attack is set in Terrinia, 983.
It began on a wet night, when the radio stopped mid-word and the lights went out.
Every street went dark, one after another.
A black cloud with violet light hung over the bay.
A roar came up from the bay, then screaming.
A tall gray Ender broke the wall of Lesley's house and bent toward the bed.
It struck Lesley on the left side of her face as she stood in front of her brother.
Lesley's father, mother and brother were killed.
Smoke rose from every house on the street.
Soldiers of the Shield of Dawnbreak came up the hill after the rain thinned.
Lesley's file records it: family all deceased, Ender attack; left eye lost in the same attack.
The night the roof came down at Lesley's family house, every lamp died, but the clocks her father wound by hand kept ticking.
After midnight in a storm every lamp in the House went out at once, and everything that ran on current died.
Even the sirens died; there was only rain, thunder and a violet light at the edges of the shutters.
Hester carried baby Guinevere to the cellar by one candle, counting the steps.
Guinevere's mother was at the House's bank by the harbor and did not come home.
At dawn her father stood a long time in his office door, then shut it.
After it the Citadel climbed into its cloud and left that world; the seed was planted.
It happens in Terrinia in 983.
Selena wakes in the rain that night.
The street is dark and every window is dark. Rain hisses on scorched ground.
People scream under the roar of the rain, some close, some far away.
Others lie dead in the street in their nightclothes.
Over the water above the roofs hangs a black cloud with violet light in its belly and something vast inside.
The hum climbs, and the black cloud rises into itself and is gone.
Then every dead lamp down the street buzzes and catches.
Obsidia thinks even the storm night was for the seed.
On the storm night Obsidia carried Selena out of the nest and down herself.
That night Selena stood barefoot in a dark street while the hum came down from a black cloud over the bay, with violet light moving in it.
Someone set her down asleep in the mud and went back up into the clouds.
It rained that night as it rains now.
A woman with a lamp knelt in the mud and gathered her up.
Selena's arms went round the woman's neck on their own.

rows: Obsidia, with the Storm Citadel and her Enders
Lesley's father, mother and brother, and many in their nightclothes
Fourteen years later the Academy story begins

It happened on that world.
It struck a street of Terrinia.

entries.line: The night in 983 when Obsidia's storm darkened the city and her Enders struck.
entries.short: In 983 the Storm Citadel's violet storm kills every human machine, and Obsidia's Enders strike the sleeping city after midnight.
entries.summary: In 983 the Storm Citadel came over Terrinia after midnight, a black cloud with violet light over the bay, and its storm killed every lamp, radio and siren, street by street. Obsidia's Enders struck while people slept. A tall gray Ender broke into Lesley's home and took her left eye, and her father, mother and brother were killed. Guinevere's mother never came home. That night Obsidia carried down Selena, the child she had made, and set her in the mud, where a woman with a lamp gathered her up. When the Citadel left, the street lamps came back on.

entries.name: the strike on the Mother Matrix
aka: the strike on the open chest
the charge at the Mother Matrix

facts.t: Layla's plan is to draw the Matrix's fire onto the shield so its chest opens away from the two girls.
Layla's shot and Fanny's arcs strike the crowned head.
The Matrix turns to the platform and its chest plates split.
Guinevere and Vexana dive in, their two lights crossing, a gold star and a violet one.
Guinevere cries, "This strike is for Vexana."
Vexana cries, "This strike is for Guinevere!"
They strike the open chest together, her fist beside Vexana's staff.
Light breaks out of the wound, and the shot that was gathering never leaves.
The Matrix staggers back into the light with its chest plates grinding shut.
After the strike the two are inside the black point's reach.
It takes hold of Vexana, and she has nothing left to fight it with.
Guinevere goes the same way, her light thinned to a faint gold outline.
Vexana says, "Plan B."
Guinevere's light flares up gold.
The dark takes them both.
Vexana and Guinevere were swept into the black hole.
Before the strike Vexana said 'This is the final farewell' over Guinevere's open line.
Lesley watched the Matrix fire on Vexana, then watched Vexana charge it.
Two lights went into the Matrix's open chest together, and the black point took them.
Since the charge the open line has carried Guinevere's laugh.

entries.line: Guinevere and Vexana's double strike at the Mother Matrix's open chest.
entries.short: Layla and Fanny draw the Mother Matrix's fire so its chest opens, and Guinevere and Vexana dive in and strike it together.
entries.summary: Layla's plan drew the Matrix's fire onto the shield, so its chest would open away from the two girls. Layla's shot and Fanny's arcs struck the crowned head, and the chest plates split. Guinevere and Vexana dove in, a gold star and a violet one. "This strike is for Vexana," cried Guinevere. "This strike is for Guinevere!" cried Vexana. Fist beside staff, they hit the open chest, and the Matrix staggered back. Then the black point took hold of them both, and the dark took them.

entries.name: the summer fireworks
aka: the night of the summer fireworks
the fireworks at the dome's edge

facts.t: At the Academy the fireworks start after the curfew bell.
Guinevere asked Vexana to watch them at the dome's edge.
They left by the kitchen yard gate after curfew.
Vexana gripped Guinevere's hand at the first rocket.
A shooting star fell, and Guinevere made a wish.
Vexana smiled, her star went bright, and Guinevere's flared to match.
Guinevere points to the dome's edge where the houses end and plans to watch the fireworks there next year.
Vexana means to give the dolls there.
Long past curfew, on open dark ground at the dome's edge, Guinevere held Vexana's hand as pink and gold bursts cracked overhead.
Guinevere pointed at the sky; Vexana watched her face instead.
Guinevere said they would be just like fireworks, shining at their absolute brightest.
Guinevere spoke of next year as if the fireworks were already booked.
Vexana remembers pink, then gold, breaking over dark grass at the dome's edge, and a face below lit a new color by every burst.
Someone told her there that they would be like fireworks, shining at their brightest.
That someone never said what came after.
Obsidia answers: "Fireworks. Then dark."
The Will saw fireworks at the edge of a dome in Vexana's memories.
Vexana told Obsidia, "Someone told me once that we'd be like fireworks."
After curfew Guinevere pulled Vexana down a corridor by the hand, lamps on Guinevere's side, dark on hers, against every rule Vexana kept.
Under the fireworks Vexana told herself, "Don't get used to this," about her smile.
That night the Emblem shone very bright.
Under the fireworks Guinevere pointed at the sky and said, "We'll be just like fireworks, shining at our absolute brightest!"
Vexana says Guinevere took her to see the summer fireworks.
Guinevere counts it among the things friends should share.

They watched from the dome's edge.

entries.summary: The Academy's summer fireworks start after the curfew bell. Guinevere asked Vexana to watch them at the dome's edge, and they slipped out by the kitchen yard gate. On open dark ground pink and gold bursts cracked overhead, and Vexana gripped Guinevere's hand at the first rocket. Guinevere pointed at the sky, and Vexana watched her face. Guinevere said they would be just like fireworks, shining at their absolute brightest. Vexana smiled, and both stars went bright. When Vexana tells Obsidia of it in the void, Obsidia answers: "Fireworks. Then dark."

facts.t: Guinevere took Vexana to the girls' house and ordered one of everything on the top row.
Vexana paid for the second pot of tea herself.
At the amusement park Hester followed them all afternoon with the cake box.

At the gate the box went to Vexana as a midnight snack.

entries.summary: That summer Guinevere took Vexana to the girls' house, a cake shop under a pink awning, and ordered one of everything on the top row. Vexana paid for the second pot of tea herself. At the amusement park Hester followed them all afternoon with the cake box. Near the way out Guinevere bought matching doll keychains, one black-haired and one pink-haired. At the gate the box went to Vexana as a midnight snack.

entries.name: the taking of Vexana

facts.t: The alarm reports a breach at the dome's seaward foot and Enders in the Investigation Room wing, and calls the watch pair.
Enders climb in through the torn foot of the dome below the Academy's wall.
A small purple-edged door opens in the corridor's white wall behind Guinevere.
The door takes Vexana; for a moment a small gold point still shows where her collar was.
Chang'e says such a small door inside the dome almost never happens and cost the Enders something.
Students say the claw was meant for Baroque and Vexana took it.
Weeks later there has been no trace of Vexana since it.
The telescope search started after it.
The news comes down the halls with the sirens still going: a door opened inside the Academy's walls, and an Ender took Vexana through it.
By evening the board outside the Combat office says VEXANA: MISSING.
Selena thinks Enders do not open doors inside the Academy unless they want something badly.
Obsidia reads in the pulse that it was the Will's first move once the body began its door: take one of the two girls who fought as one, and the other breaks.
A door opened in a corridor of the Academy. The Will reached for the girl with her back to the door, the other stepped in front of her, and either one served.
The Emblem's beep had not come once since the day Vexana was taken.
At the end of the first week after it, Guinevere clipped the black-haired keychain to her arm guard.
Lesley has marked Vexana Missing every morning since the capture.

entries.summary: An alarm reported a breach at the dome's seaward foot and Enders in the Investigation Room wing. In the corridor a small purple-edged door opened in the white wall behind Guinevere. Vexana stepped in front of her, and the door took her. For a moment a small gold point still showed where her collar had been. Chang'e says such a door inside the dome almost never happens. Obsidia reads in the pulse that it was the Will's first move: take one of the two girls who fought as one, and the other breaks. By evening the board said VEXANA: MISSING.

The shot passed a finger from Roger's face.

entries.summary: Team B3's VR drill copied the Academy grounds. Fanny bladed each Ender's open chest as it struck, and Layla fired low charge from a doorway. When Roger ran across open ground, Fanny's cable stopped a claw a meter above his face, and Layla's shot passed Fanny's ear into the core, a finger from Roger's face. entries.name: the team test

facts.t: Guinevere's plan for the day said "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)"
A pair stood in a chalk square while steel dummies came down all six rails at once; a pair was out the moment a steel arm touched either.
In the fourth minute Vexana's staff split and went dark.
Guinevere held the front alone while Vexana mended it.
At the bell every dummy hung dead and both of them were still on their feet.
They won it.
There Vexana knelt behind Guinevere and fitted the brass collar to her staff's cracked grip with her father's screwdriver.
There Guinevere held the front alone for her, calling herself the herald of dawn at the top of her voice.
At the team test, Vexana knelt behind Guinevere and fitted the brass collar to her staff with a little screwdriver while Guinevere held the front alone.

It took place at the Academy.

entries.line: The Academy's pair test against steel dummies on six rails.
entries.short: A pair test. Two stand in a chalk square while steel dummies come down six rails at once, and a pair is out if a steel arm touches either.
entries.summary: In the team test a pair stood in a chalk square while steel dummies came down all six rails at once, and a pair was out the moment a steel arm touched either. Guinevere's plan for the day said "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)" In the fourth minute Vexana's staff split and went dark. Guinevere held the front alone, calling herself the herald of dawn, while Vexana knelt behind her and fitted a brass collar to the grip. At the bell both were still standing. They won.

entries.name: the test match

facts.t: At the week's end Layla and Fanny fight a test match against practice drones in the white training corridor.
A counter over each girl's head shows her kills, and the swarm is shared.
Layla's full-charge shot pulls left past Fanny's shoulder and takes only one drone.
Fanny's counter stops at 0157 and Layla's at 0151.
Fanny later remembers the shot that passed a hand's width from her shoulder.
The last red error line in Layla's log is dated the night of the test match.

rel.t: It takes place in the white training corridor.

entries.line: Layla and Fanny's match against practice drones in the white corridor.

entries.summary: At the week's end Layla and Fanny fought a test match against practice drones in the white training corridor. A counter over each girl's head showed her kills, and the swarm was shared. Layla's full-charge shot pulled left, a hand's width past Fanny's shoulder, and took only one drone. Fanny's counter stopped at 0157 and Layla's at 0151. The last red error line in Layla's log is dated that night.

entries.name: the way home

facts.t: The dark splits open with no violet edge, and cold salt night air and the smell of rain blow through.
The door opens on a rise of dead ground beside the ruined tower.
Vexana's boot comes down on wet stone and it holds.
She thinks once she walks down there, no door opens back in.
She takes one step back.
She returns to the void, and nobody sees her go.

entries.line: A door out of the void that opens onto Vexana's own world.
entries.short: A door opens out of the void onto dead ground beside the ruined tower. Vexana could walk home through it.
entries.summary: The dark split open with no violet edge, and cold salt night air and the smell of rain blew through. The door opened on a rise of dead ground beside the ruined tower. Vexana's boot came down on wet stone, and it held. She thought that once she walked down there, no door would open back in. She took one step back and returned to the void, and nobody saw her go.

entries.name: the Will's vision

facts.t: In the vision a city burns under a black sky, and blasts go off around the ring atop the Academy's tower.
In the vision the sky above the tower tears, and something vast and winged comes down.
In the vision Vexana kneels in rubble, her uniform torn and her gloves gray with dust.
In the vision Guinevere lies face down among broken stones, the others near her, none moving.
In the vision Vexana's Emblem does not light, because nothing answers it.
The Will's words over it call it the end of her future and the universe's predetermined execution.
In the vision the star cracks down its crooked seam and crumbles into sparks.
When it ends, Vexana kneels in the void with the Emblem whole and lit.
Vexana takes from it that even as an Aspirant beside Guinevere, they lose.
Obsidia asks Vexana what the Will showed her.
Vexana answers with its message: the will of the stars has spoken, this world will one day meet its end.
Its words come back to Vexana: "Merely the universe's predetermined execution."
Vexana says it showed her the end and said it was no judgment.
Obsidia says it was no judgment because the judging was done before it came.
Vexana thinks the vision's voice was reading her a verdict that someone else had passed.
The voice in the vision had also said: all returns to chaos.
What the Will said in it went down the pulse like any order.
The Will said, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future."
It named her side before it named her end.
In it Vexana wore her uniform, and Guinevere fell anyway.
In it Guinevere lay broken among the others.
Vexana fears that if Guinevere comes with the whole frontline, they will all stand under the gateway together when the Matrix comes, as in the vision.
Vexana tells Guinevere she has seen the end that awaits them.

rel.t: It shows Vexana the vision after saying "Look."
The Will showed it to Vexana.

entries.line: The vision of the end that the Will of the Planet shows Vexana.
entries.short: The Will of the Planet shows Vexana a burning city, something winged coming down, and Guinevere fallen. It calls this her end.
entries.summary: In the void the Will of the Planet showed Vexana a city burning under a black sky and something vast and winged coming down through the torn sky over the Academy's tower. Vexana knelt in rubble, Guinevere and the others lay without moving, and her star crumbled into sparks. The Will said, "Vexana of The Aspirants, you have reached the end of your future," and called it the universe's predetermined execution. Vexana took from it that even as an Aspirant beside Guinevere, they lose. Obsidia says it was no judgment because the judging was done before.

entries.name: the year's showing

facts.t: Silverbolt stands on a plinth in the hall behind a rope and a crowd.
A Combat Division boy tells Selena she will be a hero, and she says she'll pass.
That week her file gains the line Outstanding Student.
Since the showing, half the Academy knows Selena's name.

entries.line: The Academy's yearly exhibition, where Silverbolt stood on show.
entries.short: The Academy's yearly showing. Selena's machine Silverbolt stands on a plinth in the hall, behind a rope and a crowd.
entries.summary: At the year's showing Silverbolt stood on a plinth in the hall, behind a rope and a crowd. A Combat Division boy told Selena she would be a hero with it, and she said she would pass. That week her file gained the line Outstanding Student, and since then half the Academy knows her name.

entries.name: Vexana's birthday

facts.t: By the lines on her bar, the night at the rail yards is her birthday.
On her birthdays her father took her up the wall stair to look out over the dead ground.

rows: The rail yards north of the dome
entries.line: Vexana's birthday, spent alone in the dead ground.
entries.short: By the lines on her iron bar, Vexana's night at the rail yards falls on her birthday.
entries.summary: Vexana kept count of her days away with lines scratched on an iron bar. By them, the night the Will sent her to the rail yards north of the dome was her birthday. On her birthdays her father had taken her up the wall stair to look out over that same ground. He named the bright stars after guns, and one small one he gave to her.

entries.name: Vexana's stand in the ring

facts.t: The Enders ring Vexana on the platform.
When the Will's mark lets go, the ring closes in to kill.
She fights them with one arm, shot by shot.
She says "Dissolve into the dark of night" and shoots a tall Ender through the chest.
The last Ender falls across her boots.
The fight takes all the power she had gathered.

entries.short: The Enders ring Vexana on the platform. When the Will's mark lets go of her, they close in to kill, and she fights them alone.
entries.summary: The Enders followed Vexana up the stair and made a ring around her on the platform. When the Will's mark, the cold point behind her breastbone, let go, the ring closed in to kill. She fought them with one arm, shot by shot, and said "Dissolve into the dark of night" as she shot a tall Ender through the chest. The last Ender fell across her boots. The fight took all the power she had gathered.

entries.name: Vexana's transformation

facts.t: Cold comes up from her boots to the bone and numbs everything it touches.
The dark pours over her clothes and becomes armor.
Under the plates her own heart is still beating.
Her hair turns blue-lavender, darkening to magenta at the ends.

entries.line: Vexana's change into dark armor in the void.
entries.short: In the void cold comes up through Vexana, and the dark pours over her clothes and becomes armor. Her hair turns blue-lavender.
entries.summary: After she turned back from the way home, cold came up from Vexana's boots to the bone and numbed everything it touched. The dark poured over her clothes and became armor, but under the plates her own heart was still beating. Her hair turned blue-lavender, darkening to magenta at the ends. After it, the black-haired keychain on Guinevere's arm guard no longer looks like her.

Students in matching jackets stamped S·L·K run from the androids.
Ruby watches students fall on Tetra's feed.
Selrick's record shows the small android firing at students.
Ruby names their mark when she asks refuge of their school.
On a record Angela once struck students with red eyes.

Afterward they go out past Chang'e in twos.
A boy at the board says Missing is what they write first.
A girl beside him says Vexana is dead and they just don't print that until later.
They leave when they see Guinevere standing in front of them.
At lunch someone says the claw was meant for Baroque and Vexana took it.
Someone else says "Daddy will buy her a new partner."
They pour out of a ceremony in the hall, cheering.
By morning the students are calling the point of light the Singularity.
The whole stairwell laughs at Selena's promise.
The students call the point over the bay the Singularity.

Someone says behind Guinevere, "She still thinks that thing means she's alive."
Students in suits stand in the frontline ranks.
They pack the dark of the hall under the big display.
The word "Traitor" comes first from them in the hall.

They are the Academy's students.
Its students.
Students of the Academy.

entries.line: The students of Selrick Academy.
entries.short: The young people who study at Selrick Academy. They train against simulated Enders and wear matching jackets stamped S·L·K.
entries.summary: The students of Selrick Academy fight simulated Enders in the VR Battlefield, and half of them wear headgear: ears, horns, visors. They cheer Layla as always No. 1, and they run from Oro's androids when the black ship comes to Terrinia. They are quick to talk: they write Vexana off as dead, whisper that Daddy will buy Guinevere a new partner, and name the point over the bay the Singularity. On the day of the attack some stand in the frontline ranks in suits, and in the hall the word "Traitor" comes first from them.

Half the students wear headgear, which Fanny takes for an Aspirant thing.
The billboard calls Guinevere and Vexana legends even among the Aspirants.

The Support Division mends Aspirants and their suits.

Ever since, when she falls, she gets up and announces it: a lady's refinement, three seconds, the way to regain your elegance. Vexana counts what it really takes and says four. Suits run on it, and it comes from the pilot.

Chang'e's glove and dial measure it.

Guinevere's drones and wings run on hers.

The Emblems of Hope light up when the two partners' powers are in sync.
Chang'e says "The Aspirant power is strong."
Chang'e's paper is titled On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole.

When she reaches out again in the void, her wings spread full of gold.

In her Ender armor her power still answers her, and it is still hers.

Belief woke every Aspirant suit.

A pilot's aspirant power lights a suit's core, and the core moves the suit.

The humans fight back with what they believe.

The suits run on belief, so their power lines are as close as anyone comes to reading it.

entries.line: The belief that runs the mecha suits.

The Academy's oldest records say a planet that holds Balance sends the Enders when a people grows strong enough to endanger others. Chang'e calls that theory.
