The photo of Guinevere and Vexana hand in hand, their badges new, was taken in the hall.
At the year's showing Silverbolt stands on a plinth in it.
Its doors stand open as students pour out of a ceremony, cheering.
The big display there tracks Guinevere.
Students pack the dark under the big display.
Ruby runs through it.
Colored light from its tall window lies across rows of chairs, and five great stars stand at the front. Lesley gave her speech about trust there.
Vexana waited by its door in her school uniform, and Guinevere towed her out by the sleeve into the light.
The word "Traitor" first comes from the hall.
The hall goes silent when Guinevere's signal is lost.
It marks the top of the frontline's ground.
The field's sphere takes in its roofs first.
The ship's underside glows over it.

rel.t: The Academy's hall.
Held in the Academy hall.
It is built over the crater.
It was held in the hall.
It happened in the hall.
It is the Academy's hall.
It is a hall of the Academy.
It hangs in the hall.

entries.line: The Academy's great hall, built over the crater.
entries.short: The Academy's ceremony hall. Rows of chairs face an altar with five great stars above it, and a tall window throws colored light.
entries.summary: The Academy hall rose wall by wall over the crater, which lies under its boards. Rows of chairs face an altar with five great stars above it, and a tall window throws colored light across the floor. Newcomers become Aspirants there, Lesley pins the Best Aspirant Duo badges on its stage, and detention is cleaning it. In the attack students pack the dark under its big display, and the hall goes silent when Guinevere's signal is lost.

entries.name: the Academy hill

facts.t: The Citadel's cloud spreads over it.
The ship fills the sky from the hill to the water.
The field's edge rolls down it toward the water.

rows: Under Selrick Academy, down to the bay
entries.line: The Academy's hill, running down to the water.
entries.short: The hill the Academy stands on. The Storm Citadel's black cloud spreads over it.
entries.summary: The hill the Academy stands on, running down to the water. In the attack the Storm Citadel's black cloud spreads over it, and the ship comes down until it fills the sky from the hill to the water. Then the edge of its field rolls down the hill toward the water.

entries.name: the Academy lawn

facts.t: A tree going yellow shades it, and past the shade the lawn lies bright under a blue sky.
The lunch bell can be heard across it.

rel.t: It happened on the lawn.
Part of the Academy grounds.

entries.line: The Academy lawn under a yellowing tree.
entries.short: The Academy lawn. A tree going yellow shades it, and past the shade it lies bright under a blue sky.
entries.summary: A lawn on the grounds of Selrick Academy. A tree going yellow shades part of it, and past the shade the grass lies bright under a blue sky. Guinevere and Vexana sit there with her drones asleep in the grass, until the lunch bell rings across it.

entries.name: the Academy roofs

facts.t: Jump training is on the Academy roofs. Layla leaps one gap and scores 10 POINTS.
Fanny swings past on her cables over two gaps to a roof two floors higher.

rel.t: They are the Academy's roofs.

entries.line: The Academy roofs, used for jump training.
entries.short: The Academy roofs, where jump training happens. Layla leaps one gap for 10 POINTS.
entries.summary: The roofs of Selrick Academy, where jump training takes place. Layla runs and leaps one gap and scores 10 POINTS. Then Fanny swings past on her cables, over that gap and the next, to a roof two floors higher.

entries.name: the Academy tower

facts.t: Guinevere climbs its stairs to the top at night.
It stands on the Academy's cliff, its white-cyan beam climbing into the night.
In the Will's vision, blasts go off around the ring at its top.
From the dead ground its beam is a thin white line in the dark.
The seam on the Mother Matrix's chest is longer than the Academy's tower is tall.
Vexana pictures it hanging upside down in the Citadel with its white-cyan beam out.
At its top the observation lab is lit.
High on the tower one window is lit, the lab's glass room.
Lightning shows the tower black against the cloud, with one small gold window at the top.
The command deck sits high in it, over the command room and under the glass lab.
The alarm goes up through the tower.

rows: The observation lab, the command deck, the command room

rel.t: It sits at the top of the tower.
It belongs to the tower.
It is the Academy's tower.
The Academy's tower.
At the tower's top.
It is the tower's array.
It sits high in the tower.
It lies in the tower under the deck.

entries.line: The Academy's tall tower.
entries.short: The Academy's tower. Guinevere climbs its stairs to the top at night.
entries.summary: The Academy's tower stands on its cliff, its white-cyan beam climbing into the night. The observation lab, a glass room, sits at its top, with the command deck below it over the command room. Guinevere climbs it at night during the search, and in the Will's vision blasts go off around the ring at its top.

entries.name: the Academy yard

facts.t: Chang'e crosses it at dusk.
Chang'e's family runs across it toward the shelter.
The giant's white beam comes down on it.
Chang'e tests her crescents in it at night, at the crater's edge.
Suits stand among scaffolds in it.
The first intake queue runs the length of it.
The yard inside the gate, where about a hundred children queued for the entrance assessment.
From it a far door leads to the Combat Division's course; those who fail the line go left to the Support Division.

rel.t: The base's yard.
In the base's yard.
It lies inside the gate.

entries.line: The yard inside the old base gate, now the Academy's.
entries.short: The yard inside the research base's gate, on the ground where the Academy now stands. Chang'e crosses it at dusk.
entries.summary: The yard lies inside the gate, first of the research base and then of the Academy. On the night the base fell, Chang'e's family ran across it toward the shelter, and the giant's white beam came down on it. Later Chang'e tested her crescents there at night, at the crater's edge, while suits stood among scaffolds. About a hundred children queued its length for the first entrance assessment.

entries.name: the amusement park

facts.t: Guinevere bought a strip of ride tickets at its gate; at every ride the attendant tore one and handed back the stub.
It has a teacup ride.
A cart there sells paper fans painted with goldfish.
Near the way out a stall sells keychains of big-headed dolls for every hair color.
Guinevere's black-haired keychain came from the park.
It came from a stall there.
Since the day at the park, Vexana put the pink keychain in the white box every night.
At a stall there Guinevere pressed the keychain into Vexana's palm.
Vexana says Guinevere took her there.

entries.line: A fun park in the city with a teacup ride.
entries.short: A fun park in the city, with a teacup ride. Guinevere buys a strip of ride tickets at its gate.
entries.summary: A fun park in the city with a teacup ride, where Guinevere takes Vexana one summer afternoon, Hester two steps behind. Guinevere buys a strip of ride tickets at the gate, and a cart sells paper fans painted with goldfish. At a stall near the way out she presses a doll keychain into Vexana's palm and keeps a black-haired one herself. Every night after, Vexana puts the pink keychain in her white box.

entries.name: the arcade

facts.t: An arcade of shops in the city where Guinevere took Vexana shopping; Vexana stopped in its first doorway.
It has a counter of hair things, where Guinevere found the star clip.
In its middle a fabric stall sells felt in squares of every color.

rel.t: It took place in the arcade.
Shops in the city.

entries.line: A shopping arcade in the city.
entries.short: An arcade of shops in the city, where Guinevere takes Vexana shopping.
entries.summary: An arcade of shops in Terrinia. Guinevere takes Vexana shopping there, and Vexana stops in its first doorway. It has a counter of hair things, where Guinevere finds the star clip, and in its middle a fabric stall sells felt in squares of every color.

entries.name: the armory

facts.t: Lesley hides under its floorboards so the convoy leaves without her, and the sergeant finds her there.
The station keeps its count of dead Enders in chalk on its door.

rel.t: It is the station's armory.

entries.line: The armory of Lesley's Shield station.
entries.short: The station's armory. Lesley hides under its floorboards so the convoy leaves without her.
entries.summary: The armory of the far Shield station where Lesley grows up. She hides flat under its floorboards so the convoy leaves without her, and the sergeant finds her there. The station keeps its count of dead Enders in chalk strokes on its door, and a long row of them is hers.

entries.name: the avenue

facts.t: At the avenue's end the dome comes down to the ground.
A little girl stands crying in the middle of its pavement.
The gold giant's beam burns a line down it.
Afterward ash lies over it and coats cover some of the shapes along the wall.
That night rescue crews' floodlights go up it in pairs.
Outside the base's gate it runs down to the water, where iron doors open in the seawall.
Enders fill it from wall to wall.
Lesley knows the range to every step of it.
The giant falls across its top.
At dawn Chang'e sits on a broken curb at its foot.
Angela remembers the dark there, a child crying, and androids with her face lying around her in the smoke.
There she called Ruby's name and the red went out of Ruby's eye.
On the day of the breach Joe knelt there over a girl with a pink rabbit before a slab came down on him.

rel.t: It runs to the dome in the Northeastern sector.
It opens off the avenue.
It stands on the avenue near the breach.
A street in the city.
At the avenue's foot.

entries.line: The street at the Northeastern breach.
entries.short: The street in the Northeastern sector where the dome comes down to the ground. A little girl stands crying on its pavement.
entries.summary: The avenue in the Northeastern sector runs to where the dome comes down to the ground. On the day of the breach a little girl stands crying on its pavement, and Joe kneels over her and her pink rabbit before a slab comes down on him. The gold giant's beam burns a line down it, and afterward ash lies over it and coats cover some of the shapes along the wall. That night rescue crews' floodlights go up it in pairs.

entries.name: the baker's

facts.t: Crossing to the baker's, Lesley's brother squeezed her hand as a cart came down the hill too fast.

entries.line: The baker's shop on Lesley's childhood street.
entries.short: The baker's on Lesley's street. Crossing to it, her little brother squeezed her hand when a cart came too fast.
entries.summary: A baker's shop on the street where Lesley grew up. Once, crossing to it, a cart came down the hill too fast, and her little brother's hand went inside hers and squeezed. "You're squashing," said Lesley.

entries.name: the base shelter

facts.t: Chang'e's father says it is fifty steps away.
Lesley paced the fifty steps to it herself on her first morning at the base.
It lies fifty steps from the lab door; twenty steps short of it, the ground is gone.
Chang'e's mother never reached it.
Weeks later Lesley walks the old line toward it; at thirty steps the ground falls away.
The first intake queue runs across the old fifty steps.
By morning the living are moved to a shelter, a long hall of cots and wet blankets.
A volunteer offers the child broth, and someone puts a dry blanket on her shoulders.
All day people search the cots for faces. None stop at hers.
Years later, after the raid, Selena walks to the shelter by herself.

rel.t: The base's shelter.

entries.line: The research base's raid shelter.
entries.short: The research base's raid shelter, fifty steps from the lab door.
entries.summary: The research base's shelter lies fifty steps from the lab door, and Lesley paced them herself on her first morning. On the night the base fell, twenty steps short of it the ground was gone, and Chang'e's mother never reached it. Weeks later Lesley walks the old line, and at thirty steps the ground falls away. The Academy's first intake queue runs across those fifty steps.

entries.name: the base's outer fence

facts.t: A blonde girl comes most evenings to watch the base's machines through its wire.

rel.t: The base's outer fence.

entries.line: The wire fence around the research base.
entries.short: The research base's outer fence. A blonde girl comes most evenings to watch the base's machines through its wire.
entries.summary: The wire outer fence around Terrinia's research base. A blonde girl, older than Chang'e, comes most evenings to watch the base's machines through its wire. Chang'e waves at her. The girl does not wave back.

entries.name: the bay

facts.t: The Storm Citadel hangs over the bay inside its own black cloud.
Lesley's street ran downhill to it.
On the night of the attack a black cloud with violet light inside hung over it.
The Ender's roar came up the street from it.
By morning the black cloud over it was gone.
The base lies down by the water.
Lesley runs over the rooftops toward the water.
Boats go out on it at first light.
The moon hangs over it from Lesley's tower window.
After dark the wind comes off the water.
The sun comes up over it the morning after the Enders return.
The city runs down to the bay.
Crowds watch the summer fireworks from the bay front.
Through the crack in the void Vexana sees night sky over black water and lights along the shore: the bay below the Academy.
Watched from the dead shore, its water is empty under an empty sky.
At dawn the lamps along its shore go out one by one.
The telescope points out over it, toward the hidden crack.
The crack shows Obsidia night, a bay and the lights of a city.
Through the crack the bay shows at night.
Vexana pictures the body's wings above the bay.
The pull draws Selena toward the sky over the bay.
Beyond the dome's edge it runs gray to the sky.
A faint point of light hangs over it.
Behind the crack lies a bay.
Vexana knows the body will hang over the bay, whole, the next day.
The Singularity comes out over the bay, past the dome's seaward edge.
The command deck's long window faces it.
Half of the Mother Matrix already fills the sky over the bay.
The gap in the platforms goes all the way down to the bay.
The Singularity burns over it.
Enders drop over it from the small ships.
Rain hisses on it when the street goes quiet.
The wind carries the burning Citadel back out over it.

rel.t: It lies at the foot of the city's streets.
Beside the city.
Up the curve of the bay.
It lies below the Academy.
It hangs over the bay.
The city lies on the bay.

entries.line: The bay at the foot of Terrinia.
entries.short: The bay beside Terrinia. In the prologue the Storm Citadel hangs over it inside its own black cloud.
entries.summary: The bay lies at the foot of Terrinia's streets, below the Academy, where boats go out at first light and crowds watch the summer fireworks. In 983 the Storm Citadel hung over it in a black cloud with violet light inside. From the void a hidden crack looks out on it, and in the great attack the Singularity opens over it and the Mother Matrix fills its sky. At the end the wind carries the burning Citadel back out over it.

entries.name: the bay road

facts.t: Enders come down along it.
Fanny takes it at roof height.
For a moment it is nearly clear.
Its lamps still burn after the field.
Slabs hang turning in the air over it.
The slabs fall when the hum stops.
Vexana's giants hold it in the last fight.

entries.line: The road along Terrinia's bay.
entries.short: The road that runs along Terrinia's bay. In the attack, Enders come down along it.
entries.summary: The bay road runs along the water at the foot of the Academy district. In the attack Enders come down along it, Fanny takes it at roof height, and slabs hang turning in the air over it until the hum stops. In the last fight Vexana's giants hold it.

entries.name: the bay road cut

facts.t: It is a narrow street that climbs from the water to the shelters.
The field's edge reaches its top first.
Guinevere falls at its mouth.
Lesley orders the frontline back into it to hold one street.
In one narrow street with the shelters at its back, people on foot can hold.
Fanny builds the wall where its houses stand closest.
It is too narrow for four long-legged Enders, whose legs tangle at its mouth.
They hold it for minutes.
They fight on at its mouth.

rel.t: It stands across the cut.

entries.line: A narrow street climbing from the bay to the shelters.
entries.short: A narrow street that climbs from the water to the shelters.
entries.summary: The bay road cut is a narrow street that climbs from the water to the shelters, and Guinevere falls at its mouth. With aspirant power gone, Lesley orders the frontline back into it, since people on foot can hold one narrow street with the shelters at their back. Fanny builds a wall where its houses stand closest, and four long-legged Enders tangle their legs at its mouth. They hold it for minutes, and fight on at its mouth.

entries.name: the bell tower

facts.t: A bell tower of white stone rises over the Academy. Fanny marks it as high ground.
From its roof the smell of wet earth climbs up from the courtyard's flower beds.
A stair nobody uses climbs past the bell to a hatch onto its tiles.
From it the whole city lies under her, out to the dome's edge, and the bay beyond.
Selena thinks: mine.
Silverbolt follows her up its stair.
She climbs out onto its tiles in storms, since thunder puts her bones at rest.
She watched the Northeastern breach from its tiles.
She reads the pull's direction from it.
Selena sits on its tiles during the attack.
Her boots hang over a drop full of sirens, with Silverbolt's claws hooked over the gutter.
Fanny sees Selena sitting there with her heels against the stone.
Selena watches the battle from its tiles.
Selena sits at its very edge with her legs over the air.
It looks small under the Citadel.
Lightning crawls over its roof, then climbs up off the tiles.
It stands right under the glowing ship.
Selena steps off it.
It stands high and clear over the Academy's roofs and is where Selena always does her thinking.
From the Citadel it looks the size of a hand.
After the throne is cut its roof is empty.

rel.t: It rises over the Academy.
The Academy's bell tower.
It stands over the Academy.
It stands over the Academy's roofs.

entries.line: The white stone bell tower over the Academy.
entries.short: The white stone bell tower over the Academy's roofs. Selena climbs out on its tiles to do her thinking.
entries.summary: A bell tower of white stone rises high and clear over the Academy's roofs, and from its tiles the whole city lies below, out to the bay. A stair nobody uses climbs past the bell to a hatch, and there Selena always does her thinking, in storms too, with Silverbolt beside her. She watches the great attack from its edge and steps off it when the Citadel hangs overhead. After the throne is cut its roof is empty.

entries.sub: place in space that swallows light
entries.name: the black hole

facts.t: Chang'e says a black hole is a place in space so heavy it swallows whatever comes too near; nothing seen falling in has come back out, not even light.
Chang'e's paper says it tears apart whatever falls in, the body first.
The paper says an Aspirant's light would shine on inside one and find its way home.
Guinevere remembers Chang'e saying in class that not even light comes back out.
Obsidia says the great door she woke beside had a red drain at its heart.
At the middle of the star the shore lights bend aside, the way water parts around a stone. In the bend there is no light.
Obsidia says a door held this wide for this long grows a drain at its center, a black hole.
Obsidia says it grows with the door, reaches only a short way, and takes only what has no strength left to hold against it.
Obsidia says the body and her ship keep to its rim. Whatever crosses the middle, it unmakes.
Obsidia says nothing made of matter ever comes back out of one, and that she woke at the edge of one.
Vexana remembers a paper of Chang'e's saying an Aspirant's light would shine on inside a black hole and come home.
A small black point shows in the dark middle of the Singularity beside the Matrix's chest, and the clouds bend around it.

Obsidia told Vexana that a door held open this wide and long grows a drain at its center, a black hole, that reaches a short way, takes only what has no strength left to hold against it, and unmakes whatever crosses the middle.
Obsidia says nothing made of matter ever comes back out of it.
Teacher Chang'e's untested paper says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole and find its way home.
It pulls on Guinevere's wings, stronger than the wind and one way only.
Light runs into it and Guinevere sees none come out.
When the Matrix goes back into the light, only the black point is left, and the two girls are inside its reach.
The dark takes Guinevere and Vexana both.
Inside it there is no up, no down and no sound.
Inside it speaking and thinking feel the same.
Vexana and Guinevere were swept into it.
Vexana calls it an empty, dark void.
It sits at the middle of the Singularity.
No reading had ever come back out of one before the two signals.
Obsidia had said nothing made of matter ever comes back out.
Two lights came back out of it, and the body gave way before them.
It takes the wrecked Citadel, which breaks apart and blows up inside.

rel.t: It grows at the gateway's center.
It grows at the door's center.
It sits at the Singularity's middle.

entries.line: A place in space that swallows everything, even light.
entries.short: A place in space so heavy it swallows whatever comes too near. Nothing seen falling in has come back out, not even light.
entries.summary: Chang'e teaches that a black hole swallows whatever comes too near and lets nothing out, not even light, and her untested paper says an Aspirant's light would shine on inside one and find its way home. Obsidia says a door held wide for long grows one at its center, that it unmakes whatever crosses its middle, and that she woke at the edge of one. One opens at the middle of the Singularity and takes Guinevere and Vexana into a void with no up, no down and no sound. Then two lights come back out, and at the end it takes the wrecked Citadel.

entries.name: the board's long room

facts.t: From her chair at its back Guinevere sees only the top of her father's chair, a fur collar over it, and one hand on the papers.

rel.t: Where the House's board meets.

entries.line: The long room where House Baroque's board meets.
entries.short: The room where House Baroque's board meets. Guinevere's father sits at the head of its long table.
entries.summary: The long room where the board of House Baroque meets. When Guinevere was older, a chair was set for her at its back. From there she saw only the top of her father's chair at the head of the table, a fur collar over it, and one hand on the papers. The board talked in numbers, loans for the dome and for wards rebuilt after raids, and Guinevere counted the people inside them.

entries.name: the broken bridge

facts.t: Chased up a tower by Angela's pink light, Ruby comes down on a broken bridge above the avenue.

rel.t: It spans the avenue.

entries.line: A broken bridge high above the burning avenue.
entries.short: A broken bridge above the avenue. Ruby lands on it when Angela's pink light chases her up a tower.
entries.summary: A broken bridge spans the avenue in Terrinia. On the evening Oro's ships landed, Angela turned on Ruby, cold and blank. Her pink light chased Ruby up the side of a tower, and Ruby came down on the broken bridge. Angela waited below in the dust.

entries.name: the broken wall

facts.t: After the first run, Selena and Silverbolt stop on top of it and sit until the storm moves off.
Selena opens her own thread to the Enders from it, on the next storm.
On storm nights there she lays out in her head everything she has sold.
Rain hammers it as she sends a report and waits for the slack.
On it Selena once thought she would break the field herself if anyone pointed it at the Academy.

rel.t: It stands in the outskirts.

entries.line: A broken wall where Selena sits out a storm.
entries.short: A broken wall where Selena and Silverbolt sit until the storm moves off after their first run.
entries.summary: A broken wall in Terrinia's outskirts, where Selena and Silverbolt sit until the storm moves off after their first run. On storm nights there she opens her thread to the Enders, sends her reports through the rain and lays out in her head everything she has sold. There she once thought she would break the field herself if anyone pointed it at the Academy.

entries.name: the bunker

facts.t: In a raid Lesley, the only child, is meant to go to the bunker, but she goes up the wall instead.
When an Ender crosses the wall, the soldiers fall back to the bunker line, firing.

rel.t: It is the station's shelter.

entries.line: The raid shelter of the Shield station on the gray plain.
entries.short: The station's raid shelter. Lesley, the only child there, is meant to go to it in a raid. She goes up the wall instead.
entries.summary: The bunker is the raid shelter of the Shield station where Lesley lived as a child. She was the only child at the station, and in a raid she was meant to go there. She went up the wall instead. The first time, the sergeant carried her down; after that he only looked. When an Ender crossed the wall, the soldiers fell back to the bunker line, firing, while Lesley lay flat on the wall walk and loaded.

entries.name: the burning avenue

facts.t: Ruby's ship comes down in the middle of it, the ramp opening on smoke.
Farther down, Oro's first ship hangs low between broken towers.
Ruby's last swing lights it white.
At its end stands a barrel guarded by a boy in a Selrick uniform.
Angela wakes on its stones among the cut-down androids.
People hide behind every wall along it.
There Ruby's rage came once, with Angela lying still behind her.
There it took Angela's shout to bring Ruby back.
There Angela asked how to stop it, and Ruby had no answer.

rel.t: It is a street in Terrinia.
It spans the avenue.

entries.line: The burning street where Ruby's ship comes down.
entries.short: A burning street in Terrinia where Ruby's ship comes down, with Oro's first ship hanging low between broken towers.
entries.summary: Ruby's ship comes down in the middle of this burning avenue, with Oro's first ship hanging low between broken towers. Ruby's rage comes there: she cuts down the androids, her last swing lights the street white, and Angela wakes on its stones and calls her name to bring her back. Oro's soldiers come down it to arrest them while people hide behind every wall. There Angela asks how to stop the rage, and Ruby has no answer.

entries.name: the bus stop

facts.t: The road to it runs between fences hung with signs: NO CROSSING, CAUTION.
At the metal fence with the NEXT STOP sign, Selena's first red alert buzzes.
Selena thinks the Enders got near her fine, at a bus stop.

entries.line: The stop on Selena's road to school where her first red alert came.
entries.short: A stop on Selena's road to school, by a fence with a NEXT STOP sign. Her first red alert buzzed there.
entries.summary: A bus stop on Selena's road to school. The road runs between fences hung with signs: NO CROSSING, CAUTION. At the metal fence with the NEXT STOP sign her phone buzzed with her first red alert, and something tugged at every cell in her. That same day, when Chang'e said nobody can get near the void, Selena thought it had got near her fine, at a bus stop.

entries.name: the canal

facts.t: Enders cross it on the night the base fell.
One Ender stands on the canal bridge until Lesley drops it.

rel.t: In the city.

entries.line: A canal through Terrinia, with a bridge over it.
entries.short: A canal in Terrinia. On the night the base fell, Enders came over it, and Lesley shot one off its bridge.
entries.summary: A canal runs through Terrinia, with a bridge across it. On the night the research base fell, voices on the radio shouted that the Enders were over the canal. One stood on the canal bridge until Lesley, firing from a parapet, put it down.

entries.name: the children's homes

facts.t: The researcher tells Chang'e there is a home in the city for children, with beds and someone who cooks.
Lesley walks the city's children's homes for weeks, choosing children for the first intake.

rel.t: In the city.

entries.line: Homes in Terrinia for children with nobody left.
entries.short: A home in the city for children. A researcher tells Chang'e it has beds and someone who cooks.
entries.summary: Terrinia has homes for children who have lost their families. After the base fell, a researcher told Chang'e there was one in the city, with beds and someone who cooks. Chang'e only asked, "Who would finish it?" Later Lesley walked the city's children's homes for weeks with stamped sheets, choosing the children for the Academy's first intake.

entries.name: the cistern

facts.t: While the feeders work, Vexana eats from cans in dead kitchens and drinks from a cistern.

rel.t: It lies among the ruins.

entries.line: A water cistern among the ruins outside the dome.
entries.short: A cistern in the ruins outside the dome. Vexana drinks from it while the feeders strip the dead houses.
entries.summary: A water cistern out in the dead ground. In her first weeks away, Vexana went out with the feeders wherever the Will sent her. While they worked, she ate from cans in dead kitchens and drank from the cistern.

entries.name: the Citadel's highest deck

facts.t: Obsidia stands at its edge as the door closes behind the ship.
She speaks to it empty: "It's... quiet..."

rel.t: It is the ship's highest deck.

entries.line: The top deck of the Storm Citadel, where Obsidia stands alone.
entries.short: The highest deck of Obsidia's ship. She stands at its edge alone and tells the empty deck that it is quiet.
entries.summary: The highest deck of the Storm Citadel. Obsidia stood at its edge as the door closed behind her ship and the Citadel hung in the void. Nothing aboard made a sound. "It's... quiet..." she said to the empty deck. She had absolute control of everything aboard, and it brought her no satisfaction.

entries.name: the Citadel's holds

facts.t: Thousands of gray Enders stand still in them.

entries.summary: The holds of the Storm Citadel. Thousands of gray Enders stood still in them, and nothing made a sound. When the pulse changed, Obsidia told the holds, "The Matrix is transmitting," and the crossing began. entries.summary: The city library of Terrinia. A notice from the Shield of Dawnbreak hangs inside its door, telling people what to do in a raid. After an Ender looked right at Selena and walked on, she went there to learn why. The notice said Enders do not attack each other. Around her, people turned pages at the long tables, and a girl read aloud to her mother.

On storm nights she runs the roofs of its shady streets, and at its far end, where the lit streets give out, she reads the pull. Beyond lie blocks the raids left without roofs.

Everyone crowded to the slits, Guinevere too. Vexana sat alone on the bench by the door, her hands flat on her knees, and she was the last one out at the all-clear.

When the dome tears over its stalls, the keepers run at the siren and leave their aprons on the hooks. Enders drop through the tear and burst the crates under their feet. When the fight ends, the last of them lies among the fish.

Cadets fill their flasks there and whisper about Baroque money. The morning run passes it, and Guinevere once nearly ran into it while talking. Vexana remembers that the word at the fountain was "bought," and that it was a lie.

A stair climbs its side from the seawall.

entries.summary: The gap is where the platforms split under the falling Guinevere, all the way down to the bay. Enders fill the air over it, more every moment. Guinevere goes up it from the water instead, and a stair climbs its side from the seawall to the platform.

entries.name: the garden stair

facts.t: Small Guinevere runs down it too fast and lands on both knees on the stone.

entries.short: Stone garden steps at Guinevere's home. As a small girl she falls on them, and Hester counts her up.
entries.summary: The garden stair at the House on the hill. When Guinevere was small, she ran down it too fast, caught her toe and landed on both knees on the stone. Hester, of the House's guard, knelt on the step below her and counted: one, two, three. Guinevere stood on three. Hester was the first person who ever counted for her.

entries.name: the Gardens

It is Ruby's secret base: a stream between two hills under a roof of glass hexagons, with white flowers in the grass.
Sunlight falls through the glass and gives Angela her first warmth.
On the ninth evening Angela sits beside Ruby there.
After her reboot Angela asks whether the Gardens are true.
Angela remembers the Gardens in the sun, Ruby's hand in hers, and every promise they made there.

entries.short: Ruby's secret base on Oro: a stream between two hills under a roof of glass hexagons, with white flowers in the grass.
entries.summary: The Gardens lie behind a plain gray door on Oro. A stream runs between two hills under a roof of glass hexagons, and white flowers grow in the grass. There sunlight gives Angela her first warmth, and she sits beside Ruby in the evenings. Angela keeps the memory of the Gardens in the sun, Ruby's hand in hers, and every promise they made there.

official.text: Ruby's and Angela's secret base with beautiful scenery.

entries.summary: The gate office of the research base. Chang'e borrowed the Shield's rulebook from it and read it cover to cover, looking for a gift Lesley could not hand back as not regulation. The book said a Shield rifle was worked by hand and needed nothing else.

entries.name: the giants' front

entries.summary: The giants' front was the fighting against the giant Enders in Terrinia, on the day Oro's black ships landed. Lesley, the Chief Combat Instructor, came in from it to the monitor room, her white coat scorched at the hem and a long rifle on her back.

entries.name: the girls' house

facts.t: A cake shop halfway down the hill from the Academy, under a pink awning, where only girls go in.
Half the girls at the Academy go there on rest days, and all of them know what to order.
The white box came out of it with eight cakes in it.

Guinevere says she took Vexana to all the best girl hangout spots.

entries.summary: The girls' house is a cake shop under a pink awning, halfway down the hill from the Academy. Only girls go in, and half the girls at the Academy go there on rest days. Guinevere took Vexana there, and a white box of eight cakes came out of it. Later Guinevere says she took Vexana to all the best girl hangout spots.

Vexana used to wait at its corridor window in her running things, turning a page.
On the night of the lamp, Guinevere's window is the only lit square along it.
From the ruined tower Vexana finds it without looking for it.
From the dead ground one window in it is lit.
Only one girl in it would still be up so late.
On one night every window in it is dark at the old hour.
Every window in the girls' wing is dark on the night before the attack.

entries.summary: The girls' wing is the Academy's dormitory for girls, and Guinevere's and Vexana's rooms lie along one of its corridors. Vexana used to wait at its corridor window in her running things. While she is missing she watches it from the ruined tower, and often Guinevere's window is the only one lit. On the night before the attack every window in it is dark.

entries.name: the grass behind the hall

facts.t: After the test match Fanny lies alone on the grass behind the hall.
Birds cross high over it, their shadows sliding across the field.
She stays until the dome's light is the only light left.
After detention Fanny lies in the sunny grass behind the hall, and Layla lies down an arm's length away.

Behind the Academy hall.

entries.line: The grass field behind the Academy hall.
entries.short: A field of grass behind the hall. After the test match Fanny lies there alone in the sun.
entries.summary: A field of grass behind the Academy hall. After the test match Fanny lay there alone in the sun. Birds crossed high over her, their shadows sliding across the field, and she stayed until the dome's light was the only light left. After a detention, much later, she lay in the sunny grass again, and Layla lay down an arm's length away.

entries.name: the great door

facts.t: Obsidia once kept her post at its edge among drifting stones, a red drain burning in its middle, while a world below went dark.

entries.line: A great door Obsidia once guarded, with a red drain at its heart.
entries.short: A great door among drifting stones, with a red drain burning in it. Obsidia once kept her post at its edge.
entries.summary: A great door Obsidia remembers from long before Dawnbreak. She kept her post at its edge among drifting stones, with a red drain burning in its middle, while a world under her went dark. Obsidia says she woke there, on the day she noticed she was the one doing the watching.

entries.name: the gun pit

Vexana's father hummed his march there.

entries.short: Vexana's father's post on the wall. He takes her there on rest days and hums an old march while he works.
entries.summary: The gun pit was Vexana's father's post up on the city wall. On rest days he took her there and hummed while he worked, always the same old march, and he always stopped in the same place. On the night before the attack, Vexana found herself humming his march, and she stopped where he always stopped.

entries.summary: A long hall of tall white windows below the Laboratory on Oro. The androids of Project Angel stand there in rows: the Council's androids, hundreds of the same girl with animal ears. When woken, their eyes glow magenta.

entries.name: the hangar

facts.t: A cold hangar where black ships stand with their ramps down and the android company waits in columns.

entries.short: A cold hangar on Oro. Black ships stand there with their ramps down, and the android company waits in columns.
entries.summary: A cold hangar on Oro. Black ships stood there with their ramps down while the android company waited in columns, girls with magenta eyes. An officer read the orders off a slate: Planet Dawnbreak, save the Rioters and restore balance. There Ruby gave Angela Tetra.

No Ender is sent into the hollow, and outside it the star never leaves her sleeve.
From the hollow she can see the rows of the nest.
From the hollow the crack looks small.
Vexana thinks of it as the one place nothing comes.
Obsidia says she marked this fold the night her ship came through.
No eyes from the rows have been in it.
Far out past the body, in her hollow, Vexana's light burns.
To the Will, a few machines in a hollow change nothing.
Nothing in the hollow answers when Vexana speaks.
Obsidia recalls that a machine of Ender plates stayed dead under her own hand in the hollow, until a human's belief lit it.

entries.summary: The hollow is a fold of the void that no Ender is ever sent into. While she is missing, Vexana keeps her school clothes there, with the pink-haired keychain on top. She trains there and builds her machines, with her four Guards behind her. Obsidia says she marked the fold the night her ship came through.

She counted the steps out loud so the child would not cry. Years later, walking away from Hester at the Academy gate, Guinevere counted her own steps under her breath the same way.

entries.summary: The terrace of the House on the hill. Guinevere fell on its steps once and was up before Hester reached her. Every summer of her childhood she watched the fireworks from it, with a guard at each end; from up there they were no bigger than her thumbnail. On the day the Academy opened she ran out onto it and saw people flying over the hill on wings of light.

entries.summary: The yard of the House on the hill. The guards drilled there at dawn while young Guinevere watched from the steps and pestered Hester every morning, until Hester gave in and taught her to punch. One bright morning the guards shouted in the yard as figures on wings of light crossed the sky.

entries.summary: The infirmary of Selrick Academy. On the morning the sky opened, it was one of the posts that reported in on the channel. Its answer, like every other, came back clean: "Infirmary, clear."

entries.summary: The long hall belongs to the master of the House, and the guards never come in. Tall windows line one side, Guinevere's mother's portrait hangs at the far end, and her father's office opens off it. Across from the office door stands the bench where Guinevere once did her sums. A square of sun crawls across its marble through the day, and at dusk a servant lights its lamps down to the portrait.

entries.name: the long table

facts.t: Guinevere said "She's alive" there during the search.
Angela put down her spoon there and said, "I came back once. People come back."

entries.line: A long dining table at the Academy.
entries.short: A long table at the Academy. In the weeks of the search, Guinevere said there that Vexana was alive.
entries.summary: A long table at Selrick Academy where meals are eaten. In the weeks of the search for Vexana, Guinevere said there that she was alive. Angela put down her spoon there and said, "I came back once. People come back."

entries.name: the main stairs

facts.t: Every cadet comes down them sooner or later, so Guinevere waited at the top with a speech.
A window looks out from the landing.
There a boy called Selena dangerous, and she answered 'One day, when the haze clears...'

rel.t: Stairs inside the Academy.

entries.line: The main stairway of Selrick Academy.
entries.short: The Academy's main stairs. Every cadet comes down them sooner or later, so Guinevere waits at the top with a speech.
entries.summary: The main stairs of Selrick Academy, with a window on the landing. Every cadet came down them sooner or later, so Guinevere waited at the top with a four-point speech to ask Vexana to be her partner. Vexana looked past her at the landing window. Another time, on the stairs, a boy called Selena dangerous, and she waved her lollipop over her shoulder: "One day, when the haze clears..." Everybody laughed.

entries.name: the monitor room

facts.t: Fanny and Layla come there after the battle, still in their suits, to learn what landed.
Its wall screen shows the camera records of the battle.
Lesley and Chang'e join them there and have the screen cleared.

entries.line: An Academy room with a wall screen of camera records.
entries.short: An Academy room whose wall screen shows the camera records of the battle.
entries.summary: A room at Selrick Academy with a wall screen. After the battle with Oro's androids, Fanny and Layla came there still in their suits to learn what had landed. The screen showed a girl with a scythe and a smaller girl with a shield fighting a giant Ender back to back. Lesley and Chang'e joined them and had the screen cleared.

entries.name: the nest

facts.t: Obsidia's kind sleep in the nest until they are needed.
Obsidia grew the child there.
Obsidia says the nest is where the body grows new Enders and keeps them in rows until they are sent.
Vexana has seen the rows from the hollow but never walked among them.
Twice she has gone to the rows and kept to their edge. Every Ender in them has eyes.
The rows run on past sight, with gray Enders lying in them by the thousand, side by side, still.
Under the rows, purple tissue spreads like roots from the body's flank. Each Ender lies sunk in it to the shoulders.
At the near end, tissue hangs in long purple ropes, and new shapes swell at their ends.
One girder drifting in still has a balcony bracket bolted to it.
Obsidia says there is no row for her.
Selena had no name there.
It holds rows of shells that never held, and a small place pressed into the body's tissue where Selena slept curled while her body grew.
Obsidia stopped at Selena's empty place there with Vexana beside her.
Vexana kept to the edge of the rows so the Enders' eyes would not stay on her.
Obsidia spoke a rule among the rows.
Vexana told Obsidia there, "Someone told me once that we'd be like fireworks."
Among the rows Obsidia said of something she made that if it slips beyond control there is only one outcome.
Obsidia remembers Selena curled like a sad girl at the end of a row in the nest.

entries.line: The place where Obsidia's kind sleep until they are needed.
entries.short: The place where Obsidia's kind sleep until they are needed. Obsidia grew a thing of her own there that looks like a little girl.
entries.summary: The nest is where the body grows new Enders and keeps them in rows until they are sent, Obsidia says. Thousands of gray Enders lie there, sunk to the shoulders in purple tissue, and every one has eyes. New shells swell at the near end on long purple ropes. Obsidia grew Selena there, curled at the end of a row of shells that never held.

entries.name: the Northeastern sector

facts.t: Ultra Enders attack the dome over Terrinia's Northeastern sector and rip a breach eight meters by two.
The portal lets out into its smoke, which smells of hot metal and real fire.
On the fifth day of the rebuilding, Fanny and Layla carry panels up the scaffold of one of its ruined buildings.
The new patch of dome over it shines brighter than the rest.
Demolition crews drop another wall there every nine minutes, shaking the Science Division building.
The dome's shell was torn there.
Selena remembers the day the dome tore in the northeast.

It stands near the breach.

entries.line: A district of Terrinia where Ultra Enders tore the dome open.

entries.summary: The Northeastern sector is a district of Terrinia. Ultra Enders tore a breach eight meters by two in the dome over it, and the tutors came through the portal into its smoke. Guinevere and Vexana fought there too, and held their end until the last Ender fell. Afterward crews rebuilt its ruined buildings, and the new patch of dome over it shines brighter than the rest.

Ruby and Angela keep the tower's sensor array running there at night.
It is closed at night.
Vexana had never seen a light up there at night until the night Guinevere's lamp burned in it.
At the top of the Academy's tower it is lit. Behind the glass a telescope creeps along the sky, and a pink ponytail hangs over the eyepiece.
The telescope search started after Vexana was taken.
The telescope turns a little farther in the lit glass.
Selena tilts her lollipop at its window.
Its window at the top of the tower stays lit through the night.
In the glass lab at the top of the tower, not one screen flickers through the storm.
The lamp beside its telescope has been lit most nights since Guinevere first climbed up.
Ruby and Angela keep the tower's sensor array running there.
The command deck lies under it.

entries.summary: The observation lab is a glass room under the beam at the top of the Academy's tower, with a long telescope at the glass. Ruby and Angela keep the tower's sensor array running there. After Vexana is taken, Guinevere searches the sky with its telescope, and its lamp burns most nights. Through the storm on the morning of the attack, not one of its screens flickers.

entries.name: the office tower

facts.t: Layla runs up its fire stairs three steps at a time to find a line of fire.
From its roof she sees only the Ender's head. A second tower with a glass top floor, and the WELCOME TO TERRINIA billboard, stand between.
Layla fires from its roof through the billboard and both walls of glass into the Ender's core.

entries.short: A tower near the breach. Layla runs up its fire stairs, three steps at a time, to find a line of fire.
entries.summary: An office tower near the breach in the Northeastern sector. Layla ran up its fire stairs three steps at a time to find a line of fire. From the roof she could see only the Ender's head, with a second, glass-topped tower and the WELCOME TO TERRINIA billboard in between. She fired through the billboard and both walls of glass into the Ender's core.

entries.name: the old market

facts.t: Karina says the cellars flooded in the old market and her team got everyone out.
Enders land in the wards past it.

entries.line: An old market district of Terrinia.
entries.short: The old market, a district of Terrinia. When its cellars flooded, Karina's team got everyone out.
entries.summary: The old market is a district of Terrinia. When its cellars flooded, Karina's team got everyone out. On the day of the attack, Enders dropped from the ships into the wards past it, on streets Selena had raced through on storm nights.

entries.name: the old pumping station

facts.t: Feeders tear cable out of it far out in the dead ground.

rel.t: It lies in the dead ground.

entries.line: A ruined pumping station far out in the dead ground.
entries.short: An old pumping station far out in the dead ground, where the feeders tear out cable.
entries.summary: A ruined pumping station far out in the dead ground. Some nights after an errand, the feeders were tearing cable out of it while Vexana climbed the ruined tower alone.

entries.name: the old rail yard

facts.t: An old rail yard at the city's edge, with rusted wagons and a signal tower.
Lesley stands up on the signal tower so the Ender comes for her, not the squad.
The Ender's blow hits the tower, and the steel jumps under her.
The gray-bearded officer knows Lesley by the rail yard.

At the city's edge.

entries.line: An old rail yard at the city's edge, with rusted wagons and a signal tower.
entries.short: An old rail yard at the city's edge, with rusted wagons and a signal tower. Lesley fights Enders there.
entries.summary: The old rail yard lies at the city's edge, with rusted wagons and a signal tower. When Enders walked in among the wagons, Lesley stood up on the signal tower so one would come for her instead of the squad. Its blow hit the tower, and the steel jumped under her. Afterward a gray-bearded officer knew her by the rail yard.

entries.name: the old tower

facts.t: Lesley asks the Shield for a room at the top of this old tower across the water.
It is cold, and nobody wants it.
Its window faces the lab's.
It stands up the curve of the bay, so the avenue lies side-on to its window.
Chang'e sees its open lit window high across the bay with the moon beside it.
Small craft fire at it, the window flashes, and it stays empty.
Lesley once thought her vow there, across the water, with the rifle in her hands.
On the night the Enders came back, Chang'e looked straight up at it from the avenue, knowing which window it was.

rows: Up the curve of the bay, across the water from the lab

entries.line: An old tower across the water, where Lesley keeps a room.
entries.short: An old tower across the water. Lesley asks the Shield for its cold top room, because its window faces the lab's.
entries.summary: The old tower stands up the curve of the bay, across the water from the lab. Its top room is cold and nobody wants it, but Lesley asks the Shield for it because its window faces the lab's. Lesley once thought her vow there with the rifle in her hands. On the night the Enders came back, Chang'e looked straight up at its lit window from the avenue and knew which one it was.

entries.name: the old water tower

facts.t: Lightning strikes it, and in the flash Silverbolt's plates go silver.

entries.line: An old water tower in the roofless blocks of the outskirts.
entries.short: An old water tower. Lightning strikes it, and in the flash the plates of Selena's frame go silver.
entries.summary: An old water tower in the blocks the raids left without roofs, out past the last lit streets. One stormy night Selena rode her frame there. Lightning struck the tower across the block, and in the flash the frame's plates went silver from nose to tail. Silverbolt, she thought, and that became its name.

entries.name: the outer ward's fence

facts.t: Past it the dome comes down to the dead ground.
It is wire, twice Guinevere's height, with one lamp burning over its gate.
At its gate Vexana could give her name and have the guards call the Academy.
Selena sells salvage at the crews' yard outside it.
Vexana thinks one word at its gate would bring Guinevere over the fence by morning.

It lies outside the outer fence.

entries.line: A wire fence at the city's edge, where the dome meets the dead ground.
entries.short: A wire fence twice Guinevere's height, with one lamp over its gate. Past it the dome comes down to the dead ground.
entries.summary: The outer ward's fence is wire, twice Guinevere's height, with one lamp over its gate. Past it the dome comes down to the dead ground, and Selena sells salvage at the crews' yard outside it. While Vexana is missing, she knows one word at its gate would bring Guinevere over the fence by morning.

entries.name: the platforms

facts.t: They are the broad stone tiers that join the city's wards above the bay. The three giants wait on the high ledges over them.
Guinevere lands on a cracked stone platform there with her back to a pillar.
They split under Guinevere, and the gap goes down to the bay.
Under the place where Guinevere and Vexana met in the air, the stone is scorched black in a wide ring.
The platform is black glass and cracked stone, with gray wreckage heaped in the middle.
From above, the platform shrinks to a slab of black glass with four small figures under a glow of pink.
On the platform Vexana's hand had been burned raw.
Fanny stands at the platform's rail after the charge.
Below its broken edge lies rubble where the giants lay.
The frontline turns there to meet the Citadel's Enders.
Fanny comes down off them into the district.

rel.t: They join the city's wards.
It splits the platforms.

entries.line: Broad stone tiers that join the city's wards above the bay.
entries.short: The broad stone tiers that join the city's wards above the bay. Three giants wait on the high ledges over them.
entries.summary: The platforms are the broad stone tiers that join Terrinia's wards above the bay. In the attack they split under Guinevere, and a gap opens down to the water. Where she and Vexana met in the air, the stone is scorched black in a wide ring, and gray wreckage lies heaped on black glass. Later the frontline turns there to meet the Citadel's Enders.

entries.name: the prison cell

facts.t: Ruby told the story of her childhood only once, to the floor of a cell with no window.
A cell with no window and no vent. When the door closes, all sound from the hall stops.
The lock's wires lie inside the door's seam.
A screen on the security wall shows it.

rel.t: It is inside the facility.

entries.line: A cell on Oro with no window and no vent.
entries.short: A cell in a secret facility on Oro, with no window and no vent. Ruby and Angela are shut in it for treason.
entries.summary: The cell lies inside a secret facility on Oro. It has no window and no vent, and when the door closes all sound from the hall stops. Ruby and Angela are shut in it, but the lock's wires lie inside the door's seam, and an alarm rings when the door opens. Ruby later tells the story of her childhood once, to its floor.

entries.name: the prow

facts.t: The prow is the foremost of the Citadel's black blocks, reaching out of the storm toward the gate.
No Ender stands on it. In its middle lies a slab of black plate holding a scorched Aspirant suit.
A low hum comes up through it that Vexana feels in her teeth.
For a long moment nothing on it makes a sound.
A gray Ender stands on it, and Obsidia sees through its eyes.
The dead suit Obsidia tested her field on sits on it.
There Obsidia told Vexana about the black hole.
On it Obsidia had told the girl beside her that nothing made of matter ever comes back out.
It tips toward the star of sky as the ship wakes.

It is the front of the ship.
It sits on the prow.

entries.line: The foremost black block of the Storm Citadel.
entries.short: The foremost of the Storm Citadel's black blocks, reaching out of the storm. A scorched Aspirant suit lies on a slab in its middle.
entries.summary: The prow is the front of the Storm Citadel, reaching out of the storm toward the gateway. A low hum comes up through it. In its middle a scorched Aspirant suit lies on a slab of black plate, and Obsidia tests her field on it. There she told Vexana about the black hole, and that nothing made of matter ever comes back out.

entries.name: the rail yards north of the dome

The Will sends Vexana there at dusk.
The feeders tear at a fallen crane there.

entries.summary: The rail yards lie north of the dome, far out among cinders and rusted track. The Will sent Vexana there at dusk, and the feeders tore at a fallen crane. By the lines on her iron bar, that night was her birthday. Far off ran the dark line of the city wall, where her father used to take her on her birthdays.

entries.summary: A railroad cut north of the old bridge, out in the dead ground. At the crews' yard, Vexana offered Selena places where wreckage lay before the crews found it. The first she named: two dead Enders in the railroad cut, whole. Selena smiled and made the deal.

entries.name: the repair room

facts.t: It lies behind the training hall, with a hooded lamp and a soldering iron that nobody liked.
Guinevere soldered the Emblems of Hope there through the night.

entries.short: A repair room behind the training hall, with a hooded lamp and a soldering iron that nobody likes.
entries.summary: The repair room lies behind the training hall, with a hooded lamp and a soldering iron that nobody liked. Guinevere had never soldered anything in her life, but she worked there through the night on the Emblems of Hope. By the eighth seam she had band-aids on five fingers.

entries.name: the research base

facts.t: Before the Academy there was a research base, with Chang'e and her parents in it and later Lesley at the door.
It has two chief scientists and a child they have taken in.
The two scientists in white coats meet Lesley at its gate.
It is all grown-ups and machines, with gray plates from dead Enders on the long benches.
There are no other children on it.
It keeps a file on everyone who comes through the gate.
A blonde girl watches its machines through its outer fence most evenings.
It can call Lesley on its own channel.
It lies far behind the city's edge, down by the water; its radio never reached the edge.
On the night it falls the giant walks straight to it.
That night its gate stands open; the storehouse burns but the lab still stands.
A week after the fall Lesley has two trusted soldiers posted on its gate.
Weeks after the Enders return its gate hangs crooked on one hinge.
It becomes Selrick Academy, with new letters over the old gate.
Lesley never found out why the giant went for it.
As a girl Selena stood at its outer fence at dusk. Something on the benches inside hummed almost like her own bones.
One evening a small girl in a child-sized lab coat, a white robot rabbit at her shoulder, crossed its yard with an armful of parts.
That girl waved to Selena through the fence. Selena did not wave back.
It stood in the far half of the city, which burned.
Days after the fall, scavengers picked through its burned buildings.
A week later the Shield put guards on its ruins.
Years after the fall a new hall rose on its ruins, named Selrick Academy.
Years ago, while every defender ran to the swarms, one giant walked through the middle of the city and the blow fell on the base by the water. Lesley came too late.
Chang'e built Lesley's machine eye there, before there were any suits.

entries.summary: Terrinia's research base lay down by the water, far behind the city's edge. Two chief scientists ran it with a child they had taken in, Chang'e, and Lesley was posted there to keep them alive. One night, while every defender ran to the swarms, a giant walked straight to it, and Lesley never found out why. Years later a new hall rose on its ruins, named Selrick Academy.

entries.name: the ruined rooftop

facts.t: The roof has lost its north parapet. Layla sits on the south one with her boots over a two-story drop.
Fanny stands at its broken edge.
Layla drops from its parapet into the dark street, and Fanny jumps after her.

entries.short: A roof that has lost its north parapet, above the dark avenue after the battle. Layla sits on its south edge, Fanny at the broken one.
entries.summary: The ruined rooftop looks over the dark avenue after the battle in the Northeastern sector. It has lost its north parapet. Layla sits on the south one with her boots over a two-story drop, while Fanny stands at the broken edge. At last Layla drops from the parapet into the dark street, and Fanny jumps after her.

entries.name: the ruined tower

facts.t: It lost its roof long ago; its top floor ends in broken stone high above the dead ground.
It rises beside the place where the way home opened, its windows empty.
Vexana climbs it stair by broken stair to look at the girls' wing.
It is where she stands at the hour she used to call.
It stands roofless on a rise in the dead ground past the dome's landward edge. Nothing shows on it tonight. Once, something had.
One storm night lightning showed a figure on its top floor with a staff and long blowing hair, facing the Academy.
The next flash showed only broken stone.
Selena tilts her lollipop at it in the dark.
It stands on a rise beyond the dome, over the dead ground.
Its stair has no rail and half its steps.
Vexana spends the whole night before the attack there, watching the Academy.
For weeks Vexana watched the city from it, beyond the beep's reach.

It stands in the dead ground.

entries.short: A tower in the dead ground that lost its roof long ago. Its top floor ends in broken stone high above the ruins.
entries.summary: The ruined tower stands roofless on a rise in the dead ground, past the dome's landward edge. While she is missing, Vexana climbs its broken stair to watch the girls' wing at the hour she used to call. She spends the whole night before the attack there. One storm night Selena saw a figure with a staff on its top floor, facing the Academy.

entries.name: the ruins east of the dome

facts.t: The Will sends Vexana there one night, and feeders strip its fallen houses.
The Will orders Vexana there at night: "The ruins east of the dome. Tonight."

entries.line: Fallen houses in the dead ground east of the dome.
entries.short: Ruins east of the dome. The Will sends Vexana there at night, and the feeders strip its fallen houses.
entries.summary: Ruins east of the dome, out in the dead ground. In her first weeks away, the Will ordered Vexana there one night. A door opened, and the feeders tore girders out of the fallen houses and dragged dead Enders out of the weeds. On the day before the attack, the Will sent her there again at night.

entries.name: the salvage stall

facts.t: A trestle table at the city's edge where an old servo turns its arm on the corner.
Her crate at the city's edge, where the salvage crews dragged in their finds, became a trestle table under a tarp, with the mended servo on its corner.
Chang'e first stops at it as a small girl and picks up the servo.
Selena sits on her crate with the candies in her fist after Chang'e leaves.
Vexana steps out of the dark into the lamp there.

entries.summary: Selena's stall at the city's edge, where the salvage crews dragged in their finds. It began as her crate and became a trestle table under a tarp, with her mended servo turning its arm on the corner as a sign. Chang'e first stopped there as a small girl and paid for the servo with her coins and two jelly candies. Long after, Vexana stepped out of the dark into its lamp.

entries.name: the sand outside the dome

facts.t: Out on the sand beyond the dome, the gold giant stands up.
All her life Fanny had wanted to see what lay past the dome. It was sand.
The heat cracks her lips.
A swarm comes over the dunes. Out here there is no narrow place to hold.
As the sun sinks the swarm draws back, but most of it is still out there.
There Fanny first fought back to back with Layla and told her which side was hers.

entries.line: The open desert of sand and dunes beyond Terrinia's dome.
entries.short: The open sand beyond the dome. Something gold and giant stands up out there.
entries.summary: Beyond the dome lies sand. All her life Fanny had wanted to see what lay past the dome, and it was this. The heat cracks her lips, and when a swarm comes over the dunes there is no narrow place to hold. There Fanny first fought back to back with Layla and told her which side was hers.

entries.name: the school roof

facts.t: Late for class, Layla gallops along it, thinking nobody checks the roof.
Fanny lands on her back there.

entries.short: The school roof. Layla gallops along it when she is late for class, and Fanny lands on her back.
entries.summary: The roof of the school at Selrick Academy. Four minutes late for class, Layla galloped along it bent low, thinking nobody checks the roof. Fanny landed on her back and flattened her on the tiles, warning her she would be in detention all day if they were found.

entries.name: the Science Division workshop

facts.t: The last lamp in the workshop hangs over the long bench.
Selena sorts salvage plates there late at night for the night's sale.
Selena first lays her palm on Frame Nine's core the night it empties.
Long past midnight it is empty, the lamp over the long bench off and the windows black glass.
In one window Selena sees her reflection stop and look back.

entries.short: The Science Division's workshop. Its last lamp hangs over a long bench, where Selena sorts salvage plates late at night.
entries.summary: The workshop belongs to the Science Division, and its last lamp hangs over the long bench. Late at night Selena sorts salvage plates there for the night's sale. The first night it emptied, she laid her palm on Frame Nine's core. Long past midnight one night it stands empty and dark, and in one black window a girl in a wet uniform stops and looks back.

entries.name: the sea in Angela's memory

facts.t: Angela remembers a sun rising over a sea, black to gold.

entries.line: A sea at sunrise that Angela remembers.
entries.short: A sea Angela remembers, with a sun rising over it, black to gold.
entries.summary: A memory Angela carries: a sun rising over a sea, black to gold. After the sixth return from the Balance Keepers' landings, while Ruby slept at her bench, Angela went to the Laboratory window and laid her palm on the glass. She remembered the sea, and asked, "Will a dawn come for me, too?"

entries.name: the sea of stars

facts.t: Obsidia took the Citadel far out into it to watch from there what grew from the seed.

entries.line: Far open space, where Obsidia took her ship to wait.
entries.short: Space far from any world. Obsidia took the Storm Citadel out into it to watch, from there, what grew from her seed.
entries.summary: The far open dark among the stars. After the storm night, Obsidia took the Storm Citadel far out into the sea of stars to watch from there what grew from the seed she had planted. Close by, her own hand would spoil the result. There she waited year after year, reading the pulse each day.

entries.name: the seawall

facts.t: Angela's shield stands on the broken seawall around the four of them.
Enders come down it and up out of the bay.
A stair climbs the side of the gap from the seawall.
There Guinevere told Layla, 'Her name is Vexana.'
There Layla called Vexana a traitor to Guinevere's face.

rel.t: It runs along the waterfront.

entries.line: The broken wall along the bay's waterfront.
entries.short: The broken wall along the waterfront. Angela holds her shield there around the four of them while Enders climb out of the bay.
entries.summary: The seawall runs along the waterfront, broken in the attack. Angela's shield stands on it around the four of them while Enders climb up out of the bay. There Layla called Vexana a traitor to Guinevere's face, and Guinevere told her, chin up, "Her name is Vexana."

entries.name: the seawall shelter

facts.t: A pair of iron doors in the seawall at the foot of the avenue, with a warden at one.
Chang'e takes her place in front of the doors as they bang shut and the bar drops.
Everyone from the nearby streets is behind its doors when the giant falls.
At dawn the doors open and people come out, blinking.

rows: The seawall, at the foot of the avenue

At the avenue's foot.

entries.line: A shelter behind iron doors in the seawall.
entries.short: A shelter behind a pair of iron doors in the seawall, at the foot of the avenue. A warden stands at one door.
entries.summary: The seawall shelter lies behind a pair of iron doors at the foot of the avenue. On the night the Enders came back, Chang'e took her place in front of the doors as they banged shut and the bar dropped. Everyone from the nearby streets was behind them when the giant fell. At dawn the doors opened, and people came out, blinking.

entries.name: the seawall street

facts.t: A street of shut shops by the seawall, where the fifth raid in nine days is fought.
Guinevere remembers it when she finds Vexana's wound.

It lies by the city's seawall.

entries.line: A street of shut shops by Terrinia's seawall.
entries.short: A street of shut shops by the seawall, where the fifth raid in nine days is fought.
entries.summary: A street of shut shops by the seawall. Vexana and Guinevere fought the fifth raid in nine days there, back to back. Afterward Guinevere found a bandage under Vexana's sleeve and remembered that street. Vexana had held the arm in close on the runs for four days, and Guinevere had never turned round.

entries.name: the secret facility

facts.t: A place of gray halls on Oro with a wide window onto a launch bay.
From the launch bay to the cell: left at the third door, the long hall, right.
Its security wall shows the halls and the cell on small screens.
A red lamp turns and an alarm rings through it when the cell door opens.

It is inside the facility.
He watches the facility's halls from its security wall.

entries.line: A prison base of gray halls on Oro, beside a launch bay.
entries.short: A place of gray halls on Oro, with a wide window onto a launch bay. Ruby and Angela are held in its cell.
entries.summary: The secret facility is a place of gray halls on Oro, with a wide window onto a launch bay. From the bay to its cell the way runs left at the third door, down the long hall, then right. Its security wall shows the halls and the cell on small screens. When the cell door opens, a red lamp turns and an alarm rings through it.

entries.name: the shelter by the wall

facts.t: A shelter at the end of the row of Shield houses, with a bench by the door.
During the attack it was full of strangers; the walls shook, dust fell at every boom and a woman cried into her hands.
Vexana slipped out of it under the arm of a man carrying a child.
Vexana thinks of herself as the girl who ran out of the shelter by the wall.
Breaking curfew with Guinevere brings its door back to her.
It shook with every blast, and strangers cried in the dark.
Vexana dates her debt of a life from it.
Vexana says her father told her to stay back there; she did not, so he came back for her.

rows: End of the Shield houses, by the city wall

rel.t: It stands at the end of the row.
It stood by the wall.

entries.line: The shelter at the end of the Shield houses by the city wall.
entries.short: A shelter at the end of the row of Shield houses, with a bench by its door. On the night of the attack it fills with strangers.
entries.summary: The shelter stands at the end of the row of Shield houses by the city wall. On the night of the attack it was full of strangers, and dust fell at every boom. Vexana's father had told her to stay back, but she slipped out to be with him, and he came back for her. She dates her debt of a life from that night.

entries.name: the shelters above the cut

They stand at the top of the bay road cut.
A small boy cries in a shelter doorway.
The wounded lie along the house fronts below them.

entries.summary: The shelters stand at the top of the bay road cut, a narrow street that climbs from the water. On the day of the attack they were full, at the frontline's back, and Angela held her shield over the wounded at the top of the cut. A small boy cried in a shelter doorway. Later the wounded lay along the house fronts below them.

A row of houses for Shield soldiers in the wall's shadow, where Vexana lived with her father.
The wall houses had drills, with a drill bell.
On the night of the attack strangers from the streets along the wall crowded into their shelter.
They stand in the shadow of the city wall; Vexana lived there with her father.

They stand in the wall's shadow.
It stands at the end of the row.
It struck the wall houses.
She lived there with her father.

entries.short: A row of houses for Shield soldiers in the shadow of the city wall. Vexana lived there with her father.
entries.summary: The Shield houses are a row of homes for Shield soldiers in the shadow of the city wall. Vexana lived there with her father. The wall houses had drills, with a drill bell, and a shelter at the end of the row. On the night of the attack, strangers from the streets along the wall crowded into it.

entries.name: the Shield station

facts.t: The road from Terrinia ends there after three days.
A ring of earth walls and gun pits on a plain of gray grass: an unknown corner of the world.
Lesley hides in its storeroom when she arrives.
It has no clocks.
Lesley hides under its armory floorboards to avoid the convoy home.
Once a week at noon the gunners test-fire its wall guns.
In raids people go to its bunker.
It was among the last far stations to close.

entries.short: A Shield fort three days' drive from Terrinia: a ring of earth walls and gun pits on a plain of gray grass.
entries.summary: The Shield station lies where the road from Terrinia ends, three days out. It is a ring of earth walls and gun pits on a plain of gray grass, and it has no clocks. Lesley arrives hidden in its storeroom, and later hides under its armory floorboards to escape the convoy home. It was among the last of the far stations to close.

entries.name: the Shield's barracks

Their roofs block the view from the home's yard.

entries.line: The barracks of the Shield of Dawnbreak.
entries.short: The Shield's barracks. The Shield's home for soldiers' children stands behind them.
entries.summary: The barracks of the Shield of Dawnbreak. The Shield's home for soldiers' children stands behind them, and Vexana came to it with one bag after she lost her father. From the home's yard the barracks roofs blocked the view, so she never found her star there.

entries.name: the Shield's home
aka: the Shield's home for soldiers' children

facts.t: It stands behind the Shield's barracks and runs on bells; most children there had lost someone to the Enders.
It held drills too, but nobody came to find Vexana after them.
From its yard you cannot see past the barracks roofs.
Vexana trained at dawn in its yard while the other children slept.
Lesley watched Vexana from the yard's railings.
Food there came on a tray when the bell rang.
The children there mended their own clothes.
Nobody there touched anyone's hair, except to cut it.
From its yard, the barracks roofs hid the star Vexana's father had given her.
A soldier brought her father's toolbox there and set it by her cot.
Vexana had a cot there. Her father's toolbox was set down beside it.

rel.t: They live at the home.
She grew up there after her father died.
The Shield runs it for its soldiers' children.
She lived at the home.
She slept on a cot at the home after her father died.
She had a cot there.
The Shield's own home.

entries.line: The Shield's home for soldiers' children, behind its barracks.
entries.short: The Shield's home for soldiers' children, behind its barracks. It runs on bells, and most children there lost someone to the Enders.
entries.summary: The Shield's home stands behind the Shield's barracks and runs on bells. Most of its children have lost someone to the Enders. Food comes on a tray when the bell rings, the children mend their own clothes, and nobody touches anyone's hair except to cut it. Vexana had a cot there beside her father's toolbox, and she trained at dawn in its yard while Lesley watched from the railings.

entries.name: the shore ward

facts.t: The raid that matters is on a shore ward.
Selena types the hour the shore ward changes its watch, then deletes it.

rel.t: On a shore ward.
A ward of the city.

entries.line: A ward of Terrinia on the shore.
entries.short: A ward of Terrinia on the shore. The raid there that mattered was fought at the fish market.
entries.summary: A ward of Terrinia on the shore. The raid that mattered there was at the fish market, where the dome tore over the stalls; at the gate portal before it, Guinevere first introduced herself to Layla. Later Selena typed the hour the shore ward changed its watch into a message she meant to trade, then deleted it. She never gave away a place where people die.

entries.name: the side street

facts.t: Joe turns the crowd into a side street.
Roger drags Joe toward it.
Fanny sets the girl down behind a van in a side street.
The giant's chest swings toward the side street and the van.
A thin sound comes from it that does not stop.
Fanny sets the rabbit on the broken wall at its mouth.
The thin sound from it has not stopped since dusk.
