entries.line: A side street off the avenue near the breach.
entries.short: A side street off the avenue. Joe turns the fleeing crowd into it.
entries.summary: A side street that opens off the avenue near the breach. Joe turned the crowd into it, and after the slab fell Roger dragged Joe toward it. Fanny set a girl down behind a van there, and the giant's chest swung toward it. After the battle a thin sound came from the street and did not stop. Fanny set the girl's rabbit on the broken wall at its mouth, where a mother coming back would see it.

entries.name: the Singularity

facts.t: It hangs in the dark shaped like a four-pointed star, showing night sky over the bay below the Academy.
It is a door the Enders are widening between their dark and Vexana's world; from the void it looks like torn sky.
Each time Vexana looks it is wider; she measures it against her thumb and uses it as her clock.
From the city nothing shows of it yet.
By the last weeks it no longer hides behind her thumb; when it goes pale with dawn she scratches a line on her bar.
It is the Mother Matrix's gateway, a door the body is widening into that world.
The pulse changed when the body began it.
The Storm Citadel ends its crossing in front of it.
Far off beyond the Citadel's storm hangs the crack of human sky.
It was already there when the dark took Vexana. She thinks it opened after the win at the breach.
Up close, its four points run off into the dark farther than she can follow.
Through it lie the bay at night and the shore lights of Terrinia.
A wind comes through it that smells of rain on stone.
Its torn edges tremble, and each time they settle more sky shows.
Each time Vexana sees it, there is less time left to search.
Obsidia says whatever is in its mouth must clear it before another can pass, one at a time.
Obsidia says it is the body's door, so the body goes through first.
Rain runs down the human sky on its other side.
A faint point of light hangs over the bay, past the dome's seaward edge.
It came out this week where there had never been a star. On Chang'e's screens it will not hold still.
Chang'e says every reading runs off the scale there and calls it a singularity.
Nobody knows what it is. By morning the students call it the Singularity.
It is too faint and far to fight, so the Academy only watches it, and the cliff watch lamps are doubled.
The pull in Selena's cells comes from near it.
Selena's two lines of the pull cross on the water where it hangs.
Selena feels the huntress waiting right behind it.
In the gray morning of the day before, Selena thinks it is brighter than yesterday.
Seen from the void side, the door is nearly whole.
The crack has grown into a star of human sky with four points torn wide, and behind it lie a gray morning, a bay and a domed city.
It is the body's door, and it passes one at a time.
Vexana's whole hand at arm's length no longer covers it.
From the dead ground it shows as a small pale point over the bay.
For a week a faint point of light has stood over the bay, past the dome's seaward edge, and the students call it the Singularity.
In the telescope it burns magenta, with four points, flashing.
It flashes in time with Guinevere's Emblem, and its four points begin to pull apart.
Its points pull away from each other and the sky tears into a ragged mouth rimmed in magenta. The morning goes dark as dusk.
It tears the dome open over the waterfront.
The big display shows it as a four-pointed rift in a swirl of pink and violet.
It tears wider into a star, and one point reaches across the sky until it hangs low over the platforms.
The sky over the platforms tears open into a star, and the Mother Matrix comes through it.
A voice from everywhere says the gateway is near completion.
It stands wider than before, and the Mother Matrix steps out of it whole.
Its torn edges are bright, its middle has no light, and a black point shows there.
It burns over the bay with the Mother Matrix at its edge and the black point at its middle.
It flares white before the two lights come out.
After the Matrix goes back, the mouth burns empty.
Black cloud still pours from it.
From the Citadel it looks like a star of human sky.
Its rim, magenta all morning, burns red, and its four points drag wider as the sky tears.
The Citadel comes through it wrapped in its own storm.
It still hangs open with the Matrix's signature faint behind its light.
All day the wind blew toward it.
Light tears across it from rim to rim when the Citadel blows up inside.
Vexana says it is torn, not closed.
Cracks of light split its red face and the whole mouth flickers.

rows: Over Terrinia's bay, past the dome's seaward edge
Torn but not closed, Vexana says

rel.t: It is widening the gateway into that world.
Obsidia calls it the body's door.
It grows at the gateway's center.
It hangs over the bay.
The door is the body's.
It waits just behind the mouth.
It grows at the door's center.
It sits at the Singularity's middle.

entries.line: A four-pointed tear between the dark and the sky over the bay.
entries.short: A tear shaped like a four-pointed star, showing night sky over the bay. The Enders are widening it into a door to Vexana's world.
entries.summary: The Singularity is the Mother Matrix's gateway, a four-pointed tear between the void and the sky over Terrinia's bay. The body widens it week by week, and from the city it shows as a faint point that Chang'e calls a singularity. It tears the dome open, and the Mother Matrix and then the Storm Citadel come through it. The Citadel blows up inside it, but Vexana says it is torn, not closed.

entries.name: the small room where the family ate

facts.t: The family eats in a small room; Lesley stands at its door at supper to watch the corridor and the table.
The fourth plate is set there every night Lesley is away.

Set at the family table.

entries.line: The small room where Chang'e's family ate at the base.
entries.short: The small room where Chang'e's family eats. Lesley takes her supper standing at its door, watching the corridor too.
entries.summary: The small room at the research base where Chang'e's family ate. Lesley took her supper standing at its door, where she could watch the corridor and the table both. Chang'e's mother set out a fourth plate for her, and kept setting it every night Lesley was away.

entries.name: the station wall

facts.t: For years Lesley watched Ender cores die from it.
Years on the wall taught her to aim at the middle of an Ender's chest.
She knows the Enders' roar from it.
On the wall she waited years for an Ender's chest to open.

entries.line: The wall of the Shield station where Lesley kept watch for years.
entries.short: The wall of Lesley's old Shield station. For years she watched Ender cores die from it.
entries.summary: The wall of the Shield station where Lesley grew up. For years she watched Ender cores die from it, and the years taught her to aim at the middle of an Ender's chest. There she learned the Enders' roar. On the wall she waited years for a chest to open, and on the night the base fell, the opening came at last, out of any rifle's range.

entries.name: the storehouse

facts.t: It stands across the yard; a flying craft fires into it, and its roof goes up in a sheet of flame.
It burns while the lab still stands.
Weeks later it is a black shell by the water.
A storehouse with no roof at the base's ruins, where Selena found the servo under a fallen rack.

rel.t: Across the base's yard.
A building at its edge.

entries.line: A storehouse across the research base's yard.
entries.short: A storehouse across the research base's yard. A flying craft fires into it, and its roof goes up in flame.
entries.summary: A storehouse across the yard of the research base, by the water. On the night the base fell, a flying craft fired into it, and its roof went up in a sheet of flame. Weeks later it was a black shell. Under a fallen rack in that roofless storehouse, Selena found the servo she would mend.

entries.name: the storeroom

facts.t: When the crates come off the truck, Lesley slides behind the stack in the storeroom and stays when the trucks leave.

entries.line: The storeroom of the Shield station.
entries.short: The storeroom at the Shield station. Lesley hides behind the crates in it and stays when the trucks leave.
entries.summary: The storeroom of a far Shield station on a plain of gray grass. When the crates came off the truck, young Lesley slid behind the stack in it, and she stayed when the trucks left at dawn. The sergeant found her that afternoon.

entries.short: The research base's stores. Chang'e carries an armful of springs from them.
entries.summary: The stores of the research base. At dusk Chang'e crossed the yard from them in her child-sized lab coat, with an armful of springs and Mr. Bunny floating at her shoulder.

entries.name: the street at the dome's foot

facts.t: Guinevere took this street alone, and a claw raked her right arm. When she opened her eyes, Vexana stood over her holding out a hand.
Vexana said to her there, "Stay with me, Guinevere."
There they fought back to back for the first time, and the street held.
Guinevere repeats Vexana's words from that street on the platform.

entries.line: Where Vexana first held out a hand to the fallen Guinevere.
entries.short: A street at the dome's foot where a claw raked Guinevere's arm, and Vexana stood over her holding out a hand.
entries.summary: Guinevere took this street at the dome's foot alone, and a claw raked her right arm. When she opened her eyes, Vexana stood over her holding out a hand, and said, "Stay with me, Guinevere." There they fought back to back for the first time, and the street held. Guinevere repeats those words on the platform.

entries.name: the street of repair shops

facts.t: A narrow street of repair shops running downhill to the bay. Each shop had a bench in its window and someone at it mending something.
After the attack, smoke rose from every house on it.
Years later it still ran downhill to the bay. Most of it was new, and a clock ticked in one window.

rows: Terrinia, running down to the bay

rel.t: It is in Terrinia.
It stood on that street.

entries.line: Lesley's childhood street, running downhill to the bay.
entries.short: A narrow street of repair shops running downhill to the bay, where Lesley grew up. Someone mends things at each shop's window.
entries.summary: A narrow street of repair shops runs downhill to the bay in Terrinia. Each shop had a bench in its window and someone at it mending something, and Lesley's house stood on it. After the attack, smoke rose from every house on it. Years later Lesley walked it once: most of it was new, and a clock ticked in one window.

entries.name: the street three streets west

facts.t: Guinevere's point comes back on the map there.
The ward camera shows an empty road, a low wall and a small gold glow behind it.
The Matrix's beam melts a stripe of the road to glass.
A stair to the platforms stands at its end.
The glass stripe runs straight across the stones and stops at the wall.
Vexana laid Guinevere behind its low wall, where no eye on the platforms could find her.

rel.t: It lies west of the platforms.

entries.line: An empty road three streets west of the city platforms.
entries.short: An empty road three streets west of the platforms. Guinevere's point comes back on the map there.
entries.summary: A road three streets west of the city platforms, with a low wall and a stair to the platforms at its end. Vexana laid Guinevere down behind the low wall, where no eye on the platforms could find her. Guinevere's point came back on the map there, and the ward camera showed a small gold glow. The Matrix's beam melted a stripe of the road to glass, straight across the stones to the wall.

entries.sub: Citadel block from a lost city
entries.name: the street with doors her height

facts.t: Its doors are cut for Vexana's height, each stair fits her stride and is worn into a dip, a lamp post leans with its glass gone, and a shop sign is in letters she can almost read.
She tries to read the sign, and the letters will not come.
Obsidia says it belonged to a people much like Vexana's, whom she helped end.
Obsidia says that people lived under the same sky as Vexana's.
Vexana sets her boot in the worn dip of a stair, and it fits.
Obsidia says it is a piece of their city, and the few left alive kept no cities and no records.

entries.line: A block of the Storm Citadel taken from a lost people's city.
entries.short: A street in the Storm Citadel with doors cut for Vexana's height. Obsidia says it belonged to a people much like hers, whom she helped end.
entries.summary: This street is a block of the Storm Citadel. Its doors are cut for Vexana's height, and each worn stair fits her stride. Over one shop hangs a sign in letters she can almost read. Obsidia says it came from a people much like Vexana's, under the same sky, whom she helped end.

entries.name: the tarp shelter

facts.t: After the strike the woman lays the living under a tarp between two broken walls, with the child at the end of the row.
A tarp lashed between two broken walls, with the living lying in a row beneath it as rain drums on it.
The child curls up there on the wet ground, alone.

rows: The ruined streets of Terrinia, between two broken walls

entries.line: A tarp between two broken walls, where the living lie after a strike.
entries.short: A tarp lashed between two broken walls after the night strike. A woman lays the living under it, with a child alone at the end of the row.
entries.summary: A tarp lashed between two broken walls in the ruined streets of Terrinia, on the night of a strike. The woman with the lamp lays the living under it in a row while rain drums on it, then takes her lamp back out to look for more. The child she found in the mud lies at the end of the row, curled up alone on the wet ground. The woman is Karina, and the child is Selena.

entries.summary: The test floor of the Science Division. Selena tested her frame there, and the tests went badly: at a full run its left hind leg sheared off and skidded under a bench. Her report said only: Left hind leg. Came off. Replaced.

Selena draws in class on the clear screen set into her desk.

Selena sits in the front row.

entries.summary: A classroom at Selrick Academy, under one of its roofs. Chang'e had Ruby and Angela sit in the third-year class beside Layla and Fanny. Every desk has its own glass screen, lit faintly from underneath, that can raise a turning model into the air. Selena sits in the front row, comes in late with her guardian's note and sleeps on her arms until Layla's paper plane hits her head; once she showed the class her suit turning above her desk. After Vexana goes missing, Guinevere sits in the second row beside the empty desk and watches the window.

facts.t: Layla sits alone on the sofa by its window, holding down a slat of the blinds to watch the sun set over the city.
After a raid Layla and Fanny share its sofa.
From its window Layla sees the new patch over the Northeastern sector and the first stars.

entries.short: The third years' lounge. Layla sits alone on its sofa, holding down a slat of the blinds to watch the sun set.
entries.summary: The third-year students' lounge at Selrick Academy, with a sofa by a window with blinds. Layla sat there alone, holding down a slat to watch the sun set over the city. One evening after a raid she and Fanny shared the sofa, Fanny oiling a blade, and through the window Layla saw the new patch over the Northeastern sector and the first stars.

entries.name: the throne hall

facts.t: Vexana asks where Obsidia sits when she commands the ship.
Obsidia says it is where no one finds her, unless she calls them.
Any one of the hanging blocks could hide it.
Obsidia's throne hall lies deep among the Storm Citadel's hanging blocks, with no way in from outside.
Obsidia's weapon hangs across the hall from her.
Obsidia stands at the top of its steps, deep among the hanging blocks.
Selena enters through a gap between two black ribs.

entries.summary: Aspirant suits are armored mecha built from Ender wreckage and woken by belief: a pilot's aspirant power lights the core, and the core moves the suit. Chang'e finished the first ones, but no Shield soldier could make them move until Lesley chose instructors with the dial. On the Academy's opening day they flew over the city on wings of light. Professor Joe says two who trust each other pull more from a suit than the same two apart, which is why Aspirants fight in pairs. Under the Storm Citadel's field every suit went dark.

entries.name: black ships

facts.t: The Balance Keepers take Angela from planet to planet in black ships.

One opens its hatch onto a burning street in Terrinia and the androids walk out.

Ruby's scythe hangs on a rack by the hatch.
Oro's first ship hangs low between broken towers, its hatch open.
One has a white hold lined with soldiers.
Nine stand on their pads in the secret facility's launch bay.
Ruby and Angela escape Oro in the ship that brought them back.
On Dawnbreak everyone knows the ships came from beyond the sky, and nobody knows more.
One settles on the dirt of a cleared lot by the dome, and Ruby and Angela walk down its ramp.
On the day the black ships landed, Guinevere and Vexana held the giants' front.
Days later a black ship settled at a cleared lot, and two girls came down its ramp.
Two girls came off a black ship at the lot by the dome's foot, and soldiers raised their rifles at them.

entries.summary: Oro's black ships carry the Balance Keepers from planet to planet, and Angela with them. One crossed the stars to Planet Dawnbreak with androids standing in its dark hold, and opened its hatch on a burning street in Terrinia. Nine stand on their pads in the secret facility's launch bay. Ruby and Angela escaped Oro in the ship that had brought them back, and it settled on a cleared lot by the dome's foot. On Dawnbreak everyone knows the ships came from beyond the sky, and nobody knows more.

Selena tears the nearest point apart with her claws.
Her lightning breaks them to pieces.

entries.summary: Chains of bone that Obsidia raised out of the floor behind Selena, joint after joint, each ending in a spike. She never once looked at them. They coiled round Selena's ankle and waist, lifted her off the floor and pinned her arms, and the nearest point rested cold against her throat. But her hands were free. She tore the nearest point apart with her claws, and her lightning broke the chains to pieces.

entries.name: caramel pudding

facts.t: A pudding cup is left outside Chang'e's lab door with no note, the spoon across the lid at a right angle. It is caramel, the right flavor.
Lesley left it there.
At the base, late nights ended with pudding, one cup each, eaten at the bench.
Over caramel pudding, Chang'e's mother tapped her cup against Chang'e's before she ate.
After the first light Chang'e's mother takes three caramel puddings from the cold box under the bench to celebrate.
Chang'e writes SIS on the lid of a fourth cup and puts it at the front of the cold box.
After the fall she pushes the SIS cup to the back, where nobody will see it.
On the founding night Lesley leaves a cup outside the lab door, the spoon laid square across the lid, with no note.
It is the flavor Chang'e's mother handed round, one cup each.
An empty pudding cup sits beside the photograph the next morning.
Chang'e drops her spoon into her pudding when the frame walks in.
Selena bets two puddings that her knee joint won't crack.
Chang'e pushes the puddings across one at a time and sighs over each.
Halfway through the first, Selena's phone flashes red.
Chang'e says 'You owe me a pudding.'
Since the founding a caramel cup has turned up outside the lab door after every long night, the spoon laid square across the lid, never a note.
Lesley answers 'Two.'

Chang'e wrote SIS on a fourth cup for Lesley, and after her parents died she pushed it to the back of the cold box. Since the founding night a cup has turned up outside her lab door after every long night, the spoon laid square across the lid, never a note. Lesley leaves them. At the end Chang'e says she is owed a pudding, and Lesley answers, "Two."

entries.name: Chang'e's console

facts.t: A second line climbs on it behind the first wave, slow and larger than anything it has shown.
Its map shows the red marks come in at the waterfront and turn inland.
Down one side runs a column of thin lines, one for the power of every suit in the city.
The lines fall all at once, frontline and rear.
Guinevere's point on its map drops into the gap and is gone.
The lines stop falling, though none climbs yet.
Every suit's line on it turns and climbs after the pair return.
Thin lines run down its side, one for every suit in the city.
Its lines fall flat in the order the field reaches them, a speck of gold last.
Chang'e lays the new hum over the ship's outline on its screen.
When the field dies every flat line jumps at once, a gold one first.
A thin trace from the morning still runs at its bottom, still with no name.

entries.line: Chang'e's console on the command deck.
entries.short: Chang'e's console on the command deck. Its map tracks the Enders, and thin lines down its side show the power of every suit in the city.
entries.summary: Chang'e's console on the command deck. Its map tracks the Enders' red marks, and a column of thin lines shows the power of every suit in the city, as close as anyone comes to reading belief. When the Mother Matrix came, the lines fell all at once, and they climbed again after Guinevere and Vexana returned. Under the Storm Citadel's field they went flat, a speck of gold last, and when it died they jumped at once, the gold one first. A thin trace from the morning still runs at its bottom, with no name.

After her parents died, Chang'e wrote under it in letters twice the size: Make it something a soldier can wear.

Guinevere vows to find a way to destroy it.
Smashing it is Guinevere's Plan A.

Guinevere swore she would find a way to destroy it.
Because the Will broke into that memory, Vexana thinks the Core is real and matters to it.
Vexana means to take it first if it lies anywhere in the void.

entries.summary: Chang'e says the Control Core is whatever steers all the Enders, hidden in the Will of the Planet's dark void, and that only destroying it can defeat the Will. Smashing it was Guinevere's Plan A, and Vexana searched the void for it and found only dark. Obsidia says it is the knot where the Will's threads to every Ender meet: break it and the Will has no hands, hold it and the Enders answer whoever holds it. entries.name: crescents

facts.t: Chang'e designs them under the heading OBJECTIVE: KEEP HERSELF SAFE.
They are crescent pieces, white edged with pink, built in the test ring.
At the first test they rise a hand's width and drop.
At the crater's edge, on her words "Aspirant power, guide me," they rise and circle her until the yard shines white and pink.
Lesley sees a weapon that guards the one inside it and needs nobody else.
They wait for an opening: when an Ender's chest splits to strike, a crescent is already in it, then snaps back into the ring.
One crescent cracks taking a blow meant for Chang'e, and its light goes out.
The gear keeps a running log that records every word, as in every test.
With Lesley at Chang'e's back they fly farther than ever and come back brighter, though she changed nothing.
At dawn they lie dark beside her, one short.
Small crescents that float around Chang'e's chair drop and ring on the floor under the field.
When the field dies they lift one by one, white edged with pink, and turn around her again.

One cracked taking a blow meant for her. With Lesley at her back they fly farther and come back brighter. Under the Storm Citadel's field they fell ringing to the floor, and when it died they lifted again.

entries.name: Defensive Bubble

facts.t: A dome of light stands over Terrinia. Above the western wards one patch shines brighter: new light over a tear from the last attack.

At dusk it turns to pale light against the dark, with faint stars past it.
Ultra Enders rip a breach in it eight meters by two in the Northeastern sector.
Where it meets the ground it is a wall of pale hexagons, which crack white where claws strike.
The gold giant breaks it apart in a ring.
Fanny had always wanted to see what lay past it.
The Energy System's light runs into its dark hexagons one by one, and each comes back pale.
The new patch over the Northeastern sector shines brighter than the rest.
Terrinia's dome is broken and still being mended.
From above, the city lies under a dome of light.
Smoke stands over its western edge, with sirens and a giant shape.
A cleared lot lies at its foot.
Instructors on the field roster fight Enders outside it.
Its pale light shines on the grass behind the Academy hall.

House Baroque's board talks of loans for the dome.

Outside it, the Enders come out of portals.

The sun goes down behind its curve.

None of the Will's errands send Vexana inside it.

Past its seaward edge hangs the faint point over the bay.

The humans once broke the body's army at a hole in their dome.
Inside the shell the city stays lit, street after street.
It is the energy shell over all of Terrinia. Until the attack an army had to claw its way in from outside.
The Singularity tears it open over the waterfront.

Enders land on towers almost at its landward edge.

entries.line: The dome of light over Terrinia that keeps the Enders out.

entries.name: Emblems of Hope

facts.t: Two five-pointed stars Guinevere cut from thin gold plate and soldered by hand.

After the corridor, Guinevere's star stays lit and warm.
It cannot tell Guinevere where Vexana is.
On the roof it beeped when Vexana came within half a roof of Guinevere.

Searching for Vexana, she put a red cross through each square she had flown. In time every square had three red crosses, and all that was left lay past the outer ward's fence, where the dome came down to the dead ground.

On the day of the team test it said only "Team test. Win it. (I mean it.)"

entries.name: headgear

The blonde girl's headgear carries a horned crest.

entries.summary: A hologram wall in a corridor of Selrick Academy. It shows the day's attendance record, a long list of names in white, and students crowd under it between classes. Guinevere passed it at the same hour every day and stopped at the same line: Vexana: Absent, in red. When the alarm went, everyone crowded it.

She pins it on and lets her own two horns grow up through her hair in front of it, so they pass as part of it. Before Karina's stair she draws the horns back in and puts the headband in her bag. Guinevere took Selena's horns for part of the headband, until the day the headband was gone.

entries.summary: A note Vexana wrote in small square letters and left on top of the gift bags she carried back to Guinevere's door before dawn. To her, everything anyone gave you was a debt. Guinevere crumpled it in her fist. Later, at the keychain stall, the old words came up in Vexana again, and she did not say them. She clipped the keychain to her belt instead.

entries.name: jelly candies

entries.short: Chang'e's jelly candies. She holds up two to buy Selena's trick, then closes her fist on them.
entries.summary: Chang'e's jelly candies. As a small girl she bought Selena's mended servo with every coin she had and two jelly candies, and when Selena said they were not money, she said, "They're better." Years later in her lab she held up two to buy Selena's trick, then closed her fist on them. At last she tipped them into Selena's palm for a lollipop.

entries.name: Karina's coat

facts.t: The child keeps one fist closed in its hem at the shelter.
Karina keeps sweets in its pocket for the children she carries out.
Karina mends its torn pocket at the table.
The child closes her fist in it, as at the shelter, before saying her first word.
Karina takes the last fruit drop from the pocket she mended years ago.
Selena's free hand closes in its hem without her knowing.
Selena opens her fingers one at a time and lets it go.

entries.short: The coat Karina wears on rescues. She keeps sweets in its pocket for the children she carries out, and the child holds its hem in her fist.
entries.summary: Karina wears her coat when she carries survivors out of the ruins, and keeps sweets in its pocket for the children. At the shelter the child Selena keeps one fist closed in its hem, and does it again before she says her first word. Karina mends its torn pocket at the table. Years later, on the day before the attack, Karina takes the last fruit drop from that pocket. Selena's hand closes in the hem without her knowing, then lets it go one finger at a time.

entries.name: Karina's lamp

facts.t: A lamp with a flame behind glass. Obsidia's storm cannot kill a flame.
Its light finds the child in the street.
The woman takes it back out to look for more survivors.
It swings as it comes and squeaks. Its small flame leans inside the glass. Every other light in the street has died, but not this one.
Its light slides over the mud and finds the child.
The child watches its flame go doorway by doorway until the street swallows it.
One of the rescue lamps in the wards would be Karina's.
On the night of the mud a lamp swung down a dark street, its flame leaning in the glass, and the hot glass hung by Selena's cheek.
Karina carries a lamp from door to door in the flooded wards.

Karina carries it.
She carries a lamp from door to door.

entries.summary: Karina carries a lamp with a flame behind glass on her rescues. On the night of the mud, Obsidia's storm killed every other light in the street, but it could not kill a flame. The lamp swung and squeaked down the dark street and found the child Selena in the mud. Then it went back out, doorway by doorway, to look for more survivors. On the night of the attack Karina carries it again from door to door in the flooded wards.

entries.name: Layla's cannon

facts.t: Layla swings it up to her shoulder and charges it until the muzzle burns blue.
At gear check Layla opens it, works a hot pen at its cells and shuts it again.
Layla built it. Low charge shoots true. Full charge pulled left, a hand's width at two hundred meters.
Layla rebuilt its barrel and sight twice. The fault was somewhere in how the power came up.
It is as tall as Layla, white with a teal strip. Cyan cells on its stock fill one by one, and lightning crawls around the muzzle.
Layla calls it her magic gun.
A row of cyan cells on the stock shows the charge, and a dial sets it.
At the breach Layla will not use the big shot when Fanny calls for it, saying she is saving it for something big.
Its full charge makes a blue-white line with lightning spreading off it like wings.
In the lab it lies across two desks with its casing off.
Layla fixed its drift by making the faster half of the charge wait nine thousandths of a second.
A long cannon catches the lightning in the courtyard ranks.
Layla carries it on her shoulder.
It roars as Layla answers the deck.
Its shot is a thin cyan line.
It hisses as it cools against her cheek.
The cyan cells on its stock fill one after another before she fires.
Under the field its cells go dark one by one, counting the wrong way, and it gives nothing.
It hangs dead on her back at the wall.
It wakes on her back, its cells lighting cyan from the bottom up.

entries.line: The tall cannon Layla built herself.

entries.summary: Layla built her cannon herself. It is as tall as she is, white with a teal strip, with a row of cyan cells on the stock that shows the charge and a dial that sets it. Its full charge pulled left until she made the faster half of the charge wait nine thousandths of a second. A full shot is a blue-white line with lightning spreading off it like wings. Under Obsidia's field its cells go dark one by one, and when the field dies they light again from the bottom up.

Fanny tells it kindly that it must be lost.

entries.summary: Layla keeps three black drones in her lab, each with an angry face she drew in cyan marker. For three mornings one filmed Fanny's drills from the gallery, rising over the rail to keep her in frame. Fanny told it kindly that it must be lost, and Layla called it home with two taps. When Fanny later comes to the lab, the drones rise to meet her, and she knows the one from the gallery.

entries.name: Lesley's comm

facts.t: It sits at Lesley's collar with a small green light; the base and the Shield can both reach her on it.
On the road Lesley says she is switching to stealth mode and turns it off, and the green light goes out.
It stays off for the whole mission, so no word comes.
It has two channels, the base's and the Shield's.
From the city's edge it cannot reach the base.
Lesley turns its dial to the Shield's channel and leaves it there through the fight.
Before dawn she turns it back to the base's channel; nobody calls.
Years later it stays on the base's channel; her thumb rests on the call switch, but she does not press it.

entries.summary: Lesley's comm sits at her collar with a small green light, and it has two channels, the base's and the Shield's. On the road out she switched to stealth mode and turned it off, so no word came home. At the city's edge it could not reach the base, so she turned it to the Shield's channel through the fight. Before dawn she turned it back to the base's channel, and nobody called. Years later it is still on that channel, her thumb resting on the call switch.

Chang'e decides to build it after reading that Lesley lost her left eye in the Ender attack.
Chang'e's father set its smallest parts with tweezers.
The first eye lit, flickered and died with a pop.
The seventh cracked down the middle with nine days left.
The eighth worked.
A small metal eye with a teal light in the middle.
Chang'e clicks it into Lesley's empty socket.
It draws what it sees in thin teal lines.
It keeps what it sees, but it cannot see Lesley herself.
The year before, Chang'e's father set its smallest parts.
Lesley sights with it and her real eye both open.
It sits on Lesley's left side and draws the rim of an Ender's core in one thin teal line.
It rings the giant's distant glow in a teal ring no bigger than a coin.
From across the water it draws Chang'e's circling crescents in thin teal lines.
Through it Lesley sees Chang'e strike the stones far across the bay.
It draws the deck in thin teal lines; Chang'e built it at the old base before there were suits, and nothing in it runs on aspirant power.
It finds the climbing Ender first.

It draws what it sees in thin teal lines and keeps what it sees, but it cannot see Lesley, so Chang'e loaded a birthday recording into it. Chang'e, who had known her mother's password since she could read, climbed onto her mother's chair and opened Lesley's. It held a date of birth months away and two short lines: Family: all deceased. Ender attack. Left eye: lost in the same attack.

entries.name: Lesley's rifle
aka: the rifle Chang'e had built her

facts.t: Lesley carries a long rifle on her back.
It lies on a roof parapet covering the lot.
It leans within reach of her right hand while she sleeps.

Lesley keeps the old action and wants the new coil fitted on top.
She falls asleep with it across her knees, its bolt drawn back.
Its barrel is longer than Chang'e is tall; the test ring holds it while she solders, and she files the bolt smooth twice.
It is red and gold, a gift for Lesley's birthday.
Its bolt slides like a door on good hinges and locks home with a clack.
It has no cell and no cable: only a spring, a pin and a bolt, cocked by hand and fired by finger.
Lesley thinks it will still work in the dark.
Chang'e made it regulation by following the Shield's rulebook.
On the night the base fell its barrel grows hot enough to burn through Lesley's glove.
No rifle Lesley has fired can reach the giant's chest from the rooftops.
Before her longest shot Lesley tells it that distance is just a number.
Lesley fits the new coil on top of its old action.
Lesley keeps the old action because Chang'e built it.
She carries it on her shoulder on the deck.
Its bolt sits under the coil, the old action.
It has been on Ruby since the day Ruby landed.
No rifle could cross the range to the Matrix.
Under its dead coil the old action still slides back and locks by hand.
The day Chang'e gave it to her, Lesley thought it would still work in the dark.
It is a spring, a pin, a bolt and plain rounds.
Its round goes into the Ender's open core.

It has no cell and no cable: a spring, a pin and a bolt, cocked by hand and fired by finger, and Lesley thought it would still work in the dark. Years later Lesley has a new coil fitted on top but keeps the old action because Chang'e built it. entries.name: lollipop

facts.t: One melts slowly in Selena's cheek on the bell tower.
Selena lays one on Chang'e's bench in trade for the jelly candies.
Selena never bites one. She lets it melt down to the stick.
Selena waves one over her shoulder at the boy who calls her dangerous.
She tilts one at the observation lab window and at the ruined tower.
It has worn down by half, and Selena is making it last.
She takes it out, looks at it and tells it 'Not yet.'
Its stick stops moving in her mouth when Guinevere falls.
Guinevere knows the stick before she knows Selena's face.
Selena always lets them melt.
She bites this one and it cracks between her fangs.

entries.summary: Selena always has a lollipop. She never bites one but lets it melt down to the stick. She waves one at a boy who calls her dangerous, and trades one for Chang'e's jelly candies. On the day of the attack she makes one last and tells it, not yet. When it is worn to a sliver she bites it at last, and it cracks between her fangs.

entries.name: night log

facts.t: Guinevere writes one word in it beside Ruby's console: Nothing.
It fills up with Nothing.

On the morning of the attack its last lines read Point over the bay. Faint. No change. Under them she wrote Flashing.

entries.name: Obsidia's field

facts.t: Obsidia built it because her storm could not touch cores lit by belief.
It lies asleep in the hum under her throne. Let out through the spine it would spread over the whole city, and wherever it reached aspirant power would go out, and nothing else.
It grew from the light her Enders died of, from Selena's reports and from the dead suit on her prow. Selena's numbers told her how hard it must press.
For weeks Obsidia laid the hum on the dead suit until it went only into the core and left plate and metal alone.
Obsidia waits behind the mouth with the field ready.
It sleeps in the bone of the throne until Obsidia wakes it.
Its hum is deeper than the ship's own, felt in the chest before it is heard.
Under it rubble rises off the road and hangs in the air, turning.
It is a magenta sphere under the ship, its edge crawling with flickering squares, spreading over the roofs and streets.
It puts out Angela's shield.
It drains Layla's cannon.
It silences Fanny's rig and cable.
It kills Guinevere's drones and wings.
Comms still work under it, but suits do not.
Chang'e traces its hum to one long thing in the middle of the ship.
Selena feels it is made of what she is made of.
It passes through Selena bone by bone and finds nothing to take.
Selena thinks it was built from the numbers she sold, as a floor, plus a margin.
It finds nothing to put out in Ruby's scythe, which uses no aspirant power.
It does not stop Angela's body, which runs on her own cell.
Selena realizes it is kept in the throne.
When the throne is cut its hum stops, the magenta leaves the air and the hanging slabs fall.
Chang'e reads it as dead at its source.

rows: A magenta sphere, its edge crawling with flickering squares

rel.t: She built the field.
It sleeps in the throne's hum.
It sleeps in the throne's bone.
Obsidia wakes it.

entries.line: A field Obsidia built to put out aspirant power.
entries.short: A field Obsidia built, asleep under her throne. Let out over the city, it would put out aspirant power wherever it reached, and nothing else.
entries.summary: Obsidia built the field because her storm could not touch cores lit by belief. It grew from the light her Enders died of, from Selena's reports and from a dead suit on her prow, and Selena's numbers told her how hard it must press. It sleeps in the throne's hum until she wakes it, then spreads under the ship as a magenta sphere. Suits, drones, shields and cannons die under it, but comms still work, and nothing that runs without aspirant power is touched. When Selena cuts the throne, it dies at its source.

entries.name: Obsidia's new form

facts.t: Gold fire breaks out of Obsidia and wraps her as her shape changes.

It is a taller figure of silver and gold plate with a crown of silver points, magenta light in its joints, and purple and yellow wings of energy wider than the storm, each with a dark eye ringed in gold.
It is the strongest thing Selena has ever seen.
Obsidia's voice does not change in it.

weapons.name: Wings of energy
weapons.note: Purple and yellow wings wider than the storm, each with a dark eye ringed in gold.

weapons.name: Crown
weapons.note: A crown of silver points.

entries.line: The taller shape Obsidia takes in gold fire.
entries.short: A taller figure of silver and gold plate that Obsidia becomes in gold fire, with a crown of silver points and wings of energy wider than the storm.
entries.summary: In her duel with Selena, gold fire breaks out of Obsidia and wraps her as her shape changes. She becomes a taller figure of silver and gold plate, with a crown of silver points and magenta light in its joints. Wings of purple and yellow energy, wider than the storm, spread from her, each with a dark eye ringed in gold. Selena thinks it is the strongest thing she has ever seen. Obsidia's voice does not change.

entries.name: Obsidia's pink star

facts.t: A pink star shines at Obsidia's chest, where an Ender's core would sit.
Vexana sees its glow among her Guards, where no light but hers had ever burned.
In the void it is the only light besides the far violet of the rows.

entries.line: The pink star that shines at Obsidia's chest.

entries.name: Obsidia's storm

facts.t: A black cloud hung over the bay with violet light moving inside it, and something in it too big for any cloud.
The Ender stood in its violet light.
By morning it was gone.
Loosed on a city, it kills machines that run on current while it hangs over them. A core lit by belief runs on none, so the storm cannot touch it.
It runs ahead of the Citadel and comes through the crack a little at a time: clouds, lightning and rain on the bay.
From the city it looks like any other storm.
Cloud pours through the crack into the sky over the bay with lightning in it.
On Joe's last slide every machine under it had died, but on the eve of the attack the city's lamps still burn.
Vexana thinks this is only its weather, and the ship is still behind the sky.
It does not stop all night, yet not one screen in the glass lab flickers.
Chang'e matches its readings to an old film and calls it the Storm Citadel's storm.
Violet light moves inside its black cloud over the water.
Lesley says the records say it kills every machine under it, yet every post reports clean.
Lesley last saw that violet from a windowsill, as a radio downstairs stopped in the middle of a word.
Chang'e says it is only the edge of it.
When the Mother Matrix steps out whole, the clouds tear apart and clear.
It winds in close around the hull as the ship wakes.
Its black cloud pours from the mouth and spreads low across the water.
It rolls out across the bay ahead of the ship.
The cloud sinks and the Citadel comes down out of it over the Academy.
It strikes at nothing, because the spine cannot feed it and the field at once.
Selena's route goes straight up through it.
It thins to rags, and without it the ship sinks.
It comes apart beneath Selena and Obsidia.

rows: Kills machines that run on current

rel.t: Her storm runs ahead of her ship.
It is Obsidia's storm.
It is the Citadel's storm, hung around its blades.
It surrounds the ship.

entries.line: A black storm cloud with violet light moving inside it.
entries.short: A black cloud over the bay with violet light moving inside it, and something in it too big for any cloud.
entries.summary: Obsidia's storm is the black cloud with violet light inside that hangs around the Storm Citadel. Loosed on a city, it kills every machine that runs on current while it hangs over them, but it cannot touch a core lit by belief. Lesley saw it once from a windowsill, long ago, the night the radio stopped in the middle of a word. Before the attack it comes through the crack ahead of the ship and looks like any other storm, yet this time the city's lamps and screens keep working. At the end it thins to rags, and without it the ship sinks.

entries.name: Obsidia's throne

facts.t: One gray cord runs beneath the Citadel's foundations. Every block hangs from it. It is the only thing aboard that moves like flesh, swelling and sinking as if it breathes.
Between the streets, in the dark, it breathes on.
The throne is the Storm Citadel's spine. It comes up out of the floor and runs into the dark of the roof, and every block of the ship hangs from it.
It hums, low and even, and Obsidia sits where a neck would be.
Obsidia's field lies asleep in its hum, to be let out through the spine.
Obsidia lays her palm flat on the spine to move the ship.
At her word its hum rises and changes its note.
It climbs out of sight, bone over bone; the body grew it for Obsidia when she woke.
Under Obsidia's palm it is warm and hums.
The field sleeps in its bone.
When Obsidia closes her fingers on it, the whole ship wakes.
The red heart burns far along it.
It cannot feed the storm and the field at once.
A new hum runs down it into every block.
It is one long thing running through the ship; every block hangs off it.
It reads alive, like an Ender's insides, and Chang'e calls it a spine.
Nothing they have can hit it from the deck.
It is a column of joints lit violet from inside, and it hums.
Selena finds that the field is kept there.
Its hum quiets Selena's blood.
Selena could climb it and take Obsidia's place, as she once thought she would if she had to.
Cut through at the base, it falls into a heap of pale plates.
When it falls, the hum stops.
After the throne is cut it reads nothing.
Chang'e thinks somebody cut it.
Selena calls it the chair as the Citadel bursts.

rows: The throne hall of the Storm Citadel

rel.t: Every block hangs from it.
It is the ship's spine.
It sleeps in the throne's hum.
It grew Obsidia's throne.
It sleeps in the throne's bone.

It stands at the top of the hall's stairs.

entries.line: A gray cord under the Storm Citadel that breathes like flesh.
entries.short: The Storm Citadel's spine, a humming column every block of the ship hangs from. Obsidia sits on it where a neck would be and moves the ship by touch.
entries.summary: Obsidia's throne is the spine of the Storm Citadel, a column of joints that the body grew for her when she woke. Every block of the ship hangs from it, and it breathes and hums like something alive. Obsidia sits where a neck would be and moves the ship with her palm on it, and her field sleeps in its bone. It cannot feed the storm and the field at once. Selena cuts it through at the base with the blade on her arm, it falls into a heap of pale plates, and the hum stops.

entries.name: Obsidia's weapon

facts.t: A long weapon of silver and pink comes out of the dark to Obsidia's hand. She strokes it once along its length, as someone strokes a cat.
It follows Obsidia into the dark.
It turns in the air beside her until its point faces Vexana, then turns away.
When Obsidia lifts a hand it comes to her across the hall and hangs at her shoulder, its point toward the dark, untouched.
It glides out of the dark and settles under Obsidia's hand; she draws her claws down it and it goes still.
Obsidia talks to it.
It is long and silver-pink.
At the lift of one finger it lashes out across the hall; where it meets Selena's blade the hall flashes white.
It goes through Selena's side.
It fires bolt after bolt.
Its tip flares gold and fires once more, point-blank.

rel.t: It comes to her hand.
It comes to Obsidia's hand.

entries.line: A long weapon of silver and pink that comes to Obsidia's hand.
entries.short: Obsidia's long silver-pink weapon. It comes to her hand out of the dark, and at the lift of one finger it lashes out across the hall.
entries.summary: Obsidia's weapon is long and silver-pink. It comes out of the dark to her hand, hangs at her shoulder untouched, and goes still when she strokes it, as someone strokes a cat. She talks to it. At the lift of one finger it lashes out, and where it meets Selena's blade the hall flashes white. In the duel it goes through Selena's side and fires bolt after bolt, and at last its tip flares gold and fires once more, point-blank.

entries.name: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole

facts.t: Chang'e mentions one idea in a paper on black holes but will not teach it, since it is untested.
Its heading reads: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole. A theory of the void. Status: untested.
Most of it is readings and numbers; it says a black hole tears apart whatever falls in, the body first.
Its key line says an Aspirant's light would shine on inside a black hole and find its way home.
Vexana knows it by heart.
It reports a test in which a lit core sealed in an airless glass chamber kept its light.
It says would, not will.
Vexana remembers a paper with Chang'e's name on it, marked Status: untested. One line said an Aspirant's light would shine on inside a black hole and come home.

Vexana found it in the Academy library, the third paper on the void, with Teacher Chang'e's name and "Status: untested." It says an Aspirant's light would go on shining inside a black hole and find its way home.
Vexana does not know if it is true. Nobody does.
Vexana told Guinevere about it on the green-railed roof.
Vexana said it never says two, but she thought two would shine brighter.
Vexana recalls it saying that in the black hole the body goes first.
Vexana read the page twice in the library.
Vexana recalls it saying the consciousness of the Aspirants would bloom inside the black hole and pierce the void, reconnecting with the human world.
Guinevere remembers Vexana saying that Aspirant power piercing the black hole lets them return.
Chang'e says it was only a guess.
Lesley says it is now tested and tells her to log it.

It is the paper's key line.
Her paper reports it.
It bears Chang'e's name.
The paper has her name on it.
It is the paper's idea.
She wrote the paper on the black hole.

entries.summary: On Aspirant Power and the Black Hole is Chang'e's theory of the void, marked Status: untested. Most of it is readings and numbers. It says a black hole tears apart whatever falls in, the body first, but that an Aspirant's light would shine on inside it and find its way home. It says would, not will. Vexana found it in the Academy library and knows it by heart. After she and Guinevere come home through the black hole, Chang'e says it was only a guess, and Lesley tells her it is tested now and to log it.

In the hollow it lies on top of her folded clothes.

entries.summary: The pink-haired keychain is a little doll of Guinevere with a small face. Guinevere pressed it into Vexana's palm at a stall: "Now you have me on yours." Dark plate trimmed with silver closes up her ribs and throat, pale shards of armor stand off her shoulders and a long cloak runs from purple into blue.
Two small horns grow out of her blonde hair.
She has ears that come to points and hands that end in black claws.
She shows fangs when she smiles.
Selena calls it the real her.
Her full true form is plate of white, blue and gold with a large pale mane, four black-and-gold blades in the air and a blade of light along one arm.

entries.summary: Selena's true form is the shape she feels folded small under her skin. When it comes out, dark plate edged in silver closes over her, pale shards stand off her shoulders, and two small horns, pointed ears, black claws and fangs show. In full it is plate of white, blue and gold with a large pale mane, four black-and-gold blades in the air and a blade of light along one arm. It is the suit she once showed the class as Ender plating, her own design. She had never let it all out before, and it fits.

A machine shaped like a silver dragon, with blue light along its seams and an empty seat on its back, that clicks at Selena's heel.

It clicks along at Selena's heel.
A dragon-shaped machine Selena rebuilt herself, with blue light along its seams. Nobody else can make it move.
Deep in its chest its motor hums like a purr.
It began as Frame Nine, a compact gray Academy training frame: a seat and a core on two squat legs, registered to Selena.

Selena filed a report for the name: Frame Nine. Name: Silverbolt.

It unfolds from the wall at the foot of Karina's stair.

Chang'e calls it Selena's frame and says it is fast.

entries.name: star clip

entries.summary: A hair clip shaped like a star, from a counter of hair things. Guinevere held it against Vexana's black hair, and the little star looked lit. Vexana went very still over it, then sent it back with every other gift, on its little card, holding it a moment longer than the rest.
